```ts
    }
  });

  it('CR and surrounding whitespace are malformed', () => {
    const rows: [string, number][] = [
      ['{"generation":1}\r\n', 1], [' {"generation":1}', 1], ['{"generation":1} ', 1], ['\t{"generation":1}\n', 1],
      ['{"generation":1}\n{"generation":2}\r\n', 2], ['{"generation":1,\r"x":2}', 1], ['\ufeff{"generation":1}', 1],
    ];
    for (const [text, record] of rows) {
      expect(parseCollectLaneJournal(text), JSON.stringify(text)).toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', fault: 'blank', record });
    }
  });

  it('truncation and non-objects are malformed', () => {
    const rows: [string, 'json' | 'shape', number][] = [
      ['{"generation":', 'json', 1], ['{"generation":1', 'json', 1], ['{"generation":1}\n{"gen', 'json', 2],
      ['[1]', 'shape', 1], ['null', 'shape', 1], ['"x"', 'shape', 1], ['7', 'shape', 1], ['[{"generation":1}]', 'shape', 1],
    ];
    for (const [text, fault, record] of rows) {
      expect(parseCollectLaneJournal(text), JSON.stringify(text)).toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', fault, record });
    }
  });

  it('every generation not a positive safe integer is malformed', () => {
    const rows = ['{"generation":0}', '{"generation":-1}', '{"generation":1.5}', '{"generation":"1"}',
      '{"generation":9007199254740993}', '{"generation":1e400}', '{"generation":null}', '{"generation":true}', '{}',
      '{"Generation":1}', '{"__proto__":{"generation":1}}'];
    for (const text of rows) {
      expect(parseCollectLaneJournal(text), text).toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', fault: 'generation', record: 1 });
    }
    expect(parseCollectLaneJournal('{"generation":3}\n{"generation":0}\n'))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', fault: 'generation', record: 2 });
  });

  it('duplicate and non-increasing generations are malformed', () => {
    expect(parseCollectLaneJournal('{"generation":1}\n{"generation":1}\n'))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', fault: 'order', record: 2 });
    expect(parseCollectLaneJournal('{"generation":2}\n{"generation":1}\n'))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', fault: 'order', record: 2 });
    expect(parseCollectLaneJournal('{"generation":1}\n{"generation":3}\n{"generation":2}\n'))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', fault: 'order', record: 3 });
    expect(parseCollectLaneJournal('{"generation":1}\n{"generation":4}\n'), 'a gap is a repair above both maxima')
      .toEqual({ kind: 'ok', max: 4, records: 2 });
  });

  it('extra properties are ignored', () => {
    expect(parseCollectLaneJournal('{"generation":2,"x":1}\n')).toEqual({ kind: 'ok', max: 2, records: 1 });
    expect(parseCollectLaneJournal('{"x":{"y":[1]},"generation":3}')).toEqual({ kind: 'ok', max: 3, records: 1 });
  });

  it('it is total: hostile text answers malformed and never throws', () => {
    const rows = ['\u0000', '{"generation":1}\u2028', '}{', '{"generation":1}{"generation":2}\n', 'x'.repeat(4096)];
    for (const text of rows) expect(parseCollectLaneJournal(text).kind, JSON.stringify(text.slice(0, 40))).toBe('malformed');
  });
});

describe('the row is measured exactly (§5.2)', () => {
  it('the exact seed, read as bigints, is the seed', () => {
    expect(measureCollectLaneRow(raw())).toEqual({ kind: 'seed', row: SEED_ROW });
    expect(measureCollectLaneRow(raw({ generation: 0, updatedAt: 0 })), 'the same values as numbers')
      .toEqual({ kind: 'seed', row: SEED_ROW });
  });

  it('each single-field deviation is a row, not the seed', () => {
    const rows: [Partial<CollectLaneRowRaw>, Partial<CollectLaneRow>][] = [
      [{ updatedAt: 1n }, { updatedAt: 1 }], [{ generation: 1n }, { generation: 1 }],
      [{ fleetNodeId: 'n' }, { fleetNodeId: 'n' }], [{ markerRetiredAt: 5n }, { markerRetiredAt: 5 }],
      [{ choice: 'live' }, { choice: 'live' }],
    ];
    for (const [o, want] of rows) {
      expect(measureCollectLaneRow(raw(o)), show(o)).toEqual({ kind: 'row', row: { ...SEED_ROW, ...want } });
    }
  });

  it('malformed fields are named', () => {
    const rows: [Partial<CollectLaneRowRaw>, CollectLaneRowField][] = [
      [{ generation: '0' }, 'generation'], [{ generation: -1n }, 'generation'],
      [{ generation: 9223372036854775807n }, 'generation'], [{ generation: 1.5 }, 'generation'],
      [{ generation: null }, 'generation'],
      [{ choice: 1 }, 'choice'], [{ choice: null }, 'choice'], [{ choice: 1n }, 'choice'],
      [{ fleetNodeId: '' }, 'fleetNodeId'], [{ fleetNodeId: 7n }, 'fleetNodeId'],
      [{ markerRetiredAt: 0n }, 'markerRetiredAt'], [{ markerRetiredAt: -5n }, 'markerRetiredAt'],
      [{ markerRetiredAt: '5' }, 'markerRetiredAt'], [{ markerRetiredAt: 9223372036854775807n }, 'markerRetiredAt'],
      [{ updatedAt: -1n }, 'updatedAt'], [{ updatedAt: 9223372036854775807n }, 'updatedAt'], [{ updatedAt: null }, 'updatedAt'],
    ];
    for (const [o, field] of rows) expect(measureCollectLaneRow(raw(o)), show(o)).toEqual({ kind: 'malformed', field });
  });

  it('a future choice token is readable', () => {
    for (const choice of ['LIVE', 'toString', 'shadowed', '', ' live']) {
      expect(measureCollectLaneRow(raw({ choice })), JSON.stringify(choice)).toEqual({ kind: 'row', row: { ...SEED_ROW, choice } });
    }
  });

  it('absent and unreadable pass through, never folded', () => {
    expect(measureCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'absent' })).toEqual({ kind: 'absent' });
    expect(measureCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'no such table: collect_lane_settings' }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'no such table: collect_lane_settings' });
  });
});

describe('coherence is exact equality; the seed with no journal is the one bootstrap (§5.2)', () => {
  it('seed and missing is coherent at 0, bootstrap', () => {
    expect(control(raw(), MISSING)).toEqual({ kind: 'coherent', row: SEED_ROW, generation: 0, bootstrap: true });
  });

  it('a non-seed row with a missing journal is journal-missing', () => {
    for (const o of [...SEED_DEVIATIONS, { choice: 'LIVE' }]) {
      expect(control(raw(o), MISSING), show(o)).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'journal-missing' });
    }
  });

  it('{journal:4,row:5} and {journal:5,row:4} are mismatches', () => {
    expect(control(liveRow(5), ok(4)), 'the named regression: row == max(journal, row) would call this coherent')
      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'mismatch', journalMax: 4, rowGeneration: 5 });
    expect(control(liveRow(4), ok(5))).toMatchObject({ kind: 'mismatch', journalMax: 5, rowGeneration: 4 });
    expect(control(raw(), ok(1)), 'the seed beside a used journal: a database restored to its seed')
      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'mismatch', journalMax: 1, rowGeneration: 0 });
  });

  it('equal is coherent', () => {
    expect(control(liveRow(5), ok(5, 5))).toEqual({
      kind: 'coherent', generation: 5, bootstrap: false,
      row: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 5, updatedAt: 5 },
    });
  });

  it('each journal arm maps to its own why', () => {
    const rows: [CollectLaneJournalRead, CollectLaneUnmeasurable][] = [
      [{ kind: 'malformed', fault: 'json', record: 2 }, 'journal-malformed'],
      [{ kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EACCES' }, 'journal-unreadable'],
      [{ kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'symlink' }, 'journal-not-regular'],
      [{ kind: 'not-configured' }, 'journal-not-configured'],
    ];
    for (const [journal, why] of rows) {
      expect(control(raw(), journal), `${journal.kind} beside the seed`).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why });
      expect(control(liveRow(3), journal), `${journal.kind} beside a used row`).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why });
    }
  });

  it('an ok journal beside an absent row is row-absent', () => {
    expect(control({ kind: 'absent' }, ok(3))).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'row-absent' });
    expect(control({ kind: 'absent' }, MISSING), 'never the bootstrap').toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'row-absent' });
    expect(control({ kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'x' }, ok(3))).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'row-unreadable' });
    expect(control(raw({ generation: '3' }), ok(3))).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'row-malformed' });
  });

  it('the next generation is max plus one, null past the safe range', () => {
    const next = (c: CollectLaneControl): number | null => {
      if (c.kind === 'unmeasurable') throw new Error(`expected a measured control state, got ${c.why}`);
      return collectLaneNextGeneration(c);
    };
    const MAX = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
    expect(next(control(raw(), MISSING)), 'the bootstrap').toBe(1);
    expect(next(control(liveRow(3), ok(3)))).toBe(4);
    expect(next(control(liveRow(5), ok(4))), 'above the row').toBe(6);
    expect(next(control(liveRow(3), ok(7))), 'above the journal').toBe(8);
    expect(next(control(liveRow(MAX - 1), ok(MAX - 1)))).toBe(MAX);
    expect(next(control(liveRow(MAX), ok(MAX)))).toBeNull();
    expect(next(control(liveRow(3), ok(MAX)))).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('the two reads compare as read, before any measure (path-identity spec §5.6)', () => {
  it('rows compare every raw value, a bigint meeting a bigint, and other reads by kind', () => {
    expect(sameCollectLaneRow(liveRow(3), liveRow(3))).toBe(true);
    const variants: Partial<CollectLaneRowRaw>[] =
      [{ choice: 'off' }, { fleetNodeId: NODE_B }, { markerRetiredAt: 1n }, { generation: 4n }, { updatedAt: 6n }];
    for (const v of variants) expect(sameCollectLaneRow(liveRow(3), liveRow(3, v)), show(v)).toBe(false);
    expect(sameCollectLaneRow(liveRow(3), liveRow(3, { generation: 3 })), 'a number never meets a bigint').toBe(false);
    expect(sameCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'absent' }, { kind: 'absent' })).toBe(true);
    expect(sameCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'a' }, { kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'b' }), 'by kind').toBe(true);
    expect(sameCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'absent' }, { kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'a' })).toBe(false);
    expect(sameCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'absent' }, raw())).toBe(false);
  });

  it('journals compare by kind and every field of their arm', () => {
    const reads: CollectLaneJournalRead[] = [
      MISSING, ok(3, 3), ok(3, 2), ok(4, 3),
      { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'json', record: 1 }, { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'json', record: 2 },
      { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'blank', record: 1 },
      { kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EACCES' }, { kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EFBIG' },
      { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'symlink' }, { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'directory' },
      { kind: 'not-configured' },
    ];
    reads.forEach((a, i) => reads.forEach((b, j) => {
      expect(sameCollectLaneJournal(a, b), `${show(a)} vs ${show(b)}`).toBe(i === j);
    }));
    expect(sameCollectLaneJournal({ kind: 'ok', max: 3, records: 3 }, ok(3, 3)), 'a structural copy').toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('the write decision (§5.2, §5.4, §5.6)', () => {
  const decide = (req: CollectLaneWriteRequest, before: CollectLaneRowRead, journal: CollectLaneJournalRead,
    at: number = AT): CollectLaneWriteDecision => decideCollectLaneWrite(req, before, journal, at);
  /** The latch, set. */
  const L: Partial<CollectLaneRowRaw> = { markerRetiredAt: LATCH_N };

  describe('live', () => {
    it('conflicts on a raw row change', () => {
      const naming = expect.stringMatching(/\brow\b/);
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3), ok(3)), liveRow(3, { updatedAt: 6n }), ok(3)), 'one raw value moved')
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict', detail: naming });
      expect(decide(live(raw(), MISSING), liveRow(1), MISSING), 'the seed the route read is gone')
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict', detail: naming });
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3, { generation: 3 }), ok(3)), liveRow(3), ok(3)), 'compared as read, never parsed')
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict', detail: naming });
    });

    it('conflicts on a journal change', () => {
      const naming = expect.stringMatching(/\bjournal\b/);
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3), ok(3)), liveRow(3), ok(4, 2)))
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict', detail: naming });
      expect(decide(live(raw(), MISSING), raw(), ok(1)), 'a journal appeared beside the seed')
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict', detail: naming });
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3), ok(3, 3)), liveRow(3), ok(3, 2)), 'the same maximum over other records')
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict', detail: naming });
    });

    it('is unchanged when coherent and exactly live for that node', () => {
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3), ok(3)), liveRow(3), ok(3))).toEqual({ kind: 'unchanged' });
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3, L), ok(3)), liveRow(3, L), ok(3)), 'latch set').toEqual({ kind: 'unchanged' });
    });

    it('otherwise writes live for the node at the next generation, the latch kept', () => {
      expect(decide(live(raw(), MISSING), raw(), MISSING), 'the bootstrap seed')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 1, next: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: null } });
      const offRow = raw({ markerRetiredAt: LATCH_N, generation: 2n, updatedAt: 9n });
      expect(decide(live(offRow, ok(2)), offRow, ok(2)), 'over a latched off')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 3, next: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: LATCH } });
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3), ok(3), NODE_B), liveRow(3), ok(3)), 'for another node')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 4, next: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_B, markerRetiredAt: null } });
    });

    it('repairs a mismatch at max+1', () => {
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(5), ok(4)), liveRow(5), ok(4)), 'a journal behind, the row already live for the node')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 6, next: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: null } });
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(3), ok(7)), liveRow(3), ok(7)), 'a journal ahead')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 8, next: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: null } });
      expect(decide(live(liveRow(5, L), ok(4)), liveRow(5, L), ok(4)), 'the latch kept')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 6, next: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: LATCH } });
    });

    it('refuses state-unmeasurable when control is unmeasurable', () => {
      const cases: [CollectLaneRowRead, CollectLaneJournalRead][] = [
        [liveRow(3), { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'blank', record: 1 }],
        [liveRow(3), { kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EACCES' }],
        [liveRow(3), { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'directory' }],
        [raw(), { kind: 'not-configured' }],
        [liveRow(3), MISSING],
        [{ kind: 'absent' }, ok(3)],
        [{ kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'disk I/O error' }, ok(3)],
        [raw({ generation: -1n }), ok(3)],
      ];
      for (const [row, journal] of cases) {
        expect(decide(live(row, journal), row, journal), `${show(row)} beside ${show(journal)}`)
          .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'state-unmeasurable' });
      }
    });

    it('refuses an empty node: no row the reader calls malformed is ever written', () => {
      expect(decide(live(raw(), MISSING, ''), raw(), MISSING)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'state-unmeasurable' });
    });
  });

  describe('off', () => {
    it('refuses marker-still-controls while the latch is null, coherent or mismatched', () => {
      const refused = { kind: 'refuse', code: 'marker-still-controls' };
      expect(decide(OFF, raw(), MISSING), 'the seed').toMatchObject(refused);
      expect(decide(OFF, liveRow(3), ok(3)), 'coherent Live').toMatchObject(refused);
      expect(decide(OFF, liveRow(5), ok(4)), 'a journal behind').toMatchObject(refused);
      expect(decide(OFF, liveRow(3), ok(7)), 'a journal ahead').toMatchObject(refused);
    });

    it('is unchanged on a coherent off with a null node', () => {
      const offRow = raw({ markerRetiredAt: LATCH_N, generation: 2n, updatedAt: 9n });
      expect(decide(OFF, offRow, ok(2))).toEqual({ kind: 'unchanged' });
    });

    it('otherwise writes off, no node and the latch kept, at max+1', () => {
      const next = { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: LATCH };
      expect(decide(OFF, liveRow(3, L), ok(3)), 'coherent Live').toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 4, next });
      expect(decide(OFF, liveRow(5, L), ok(4)), 'a journal behind, repaired').toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 6, next });
      expect(decide(OFF, liveRow(3, L), ok(7)), 'a journal ahead, repaired').toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 8, next });
      expect(decide(OFF, raw({ markerRetiredAt: LATCH_N, generation: 2n, fleetNodeId: NODE }), ok(2)), 'off with a node')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 3, next });
      expect(decide(OFF, raw({ choice: 'LIVE', markerRetiredAt: LATCH_N, generation: 2n }), ok(2)), 'a future token')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 3, next });
      expect(decide(OFF, raw({ markerRetiredAt: LATCH_N, generation: 2n }), ok(3)), 'an off row behind its journal')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 4, next });
    });

    it('takes no expected compare, so it wins over a stale live', () => {
      // The route read Live for NODE at generation 3; a Live for NODE_B landed at 4 before this transaction.
      const routeRead = liveRow(3, L);
      const now = liveRow(4, { fleetNodeId: NODE_B, markerRetiredAt: LATCH_N });
      expect(decide(live(routeRead, ok(3)), now, ok(4)), 'a Live on that stale read conflicts')
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict' });
      expect(decide(OFF, now, ok(4)), 'Off writes over it')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 5, next: { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: LATCH } });
      expect(Object.keys(OFF), 'Off carries no expectation').toEqual(['kind']);
    });
  });

  describe('retire', () => {
    it('conflicts on a changed expectation', () => {
      expect(decide(retire(raw(), MISSING), raw({ choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, generation: 1n, updatedAt: 5n }), ok(1)),
        'the row').toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict' });
      expect(decide(retire(liveRow(3), ok(3)), liveRow(3), ok(4, 2)), 'the journal')
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'conflict' });
    });

    it('refuses not-coherent on either direction of mismatch', () => {
      const refused = { kind: 'refuse', code: 'not-coherent' };
      expect(decide(retire(liveRow(5), ok(4)), liveRow(5), ok(4)), 'a journal behind').toMatchObject(refused);
      expect(decide(retire(liveRow(4), ok(5)), liveRow(4), ok(5)), 'a journal ahead').toMatchObject(refused);
      expect(decide(retire(raw(), ok(1)), raw(), ok(1)), 'a seed beside a used journal').toMatchObject(refused);
    });

    it('is unchanged when the latch is already set', () => {
      const row = liveRow(3, L);
      expect(decide(retire(row, ok(3)), row, ok(3))).toEqual({ kind: 'unchanged' });
    });

    it('otherwise writes the latch at at, keeping the choice and node, a future token included', () => {
      expect(decide(retire(raw(), MISSING), raw(), MISSING), 'the bootstrap seed')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 1, next: { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: AT } });
      expect(decide(retire(liveRow(3), ok(3)), liveRow(3), ok(3)))
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 4, next: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: AT } });
      const future = raw({ choice: 'LIVE', fleetNodeId: NODE, generation: 2n, updatedAt: 7n });
      expect(decide(retire(future, ok(2)), future, ok(2)))
        .toEqual({ kind: 'write', generation: 3, next: { choice: 'LIVE', fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: AT } });
    });

    it('refuses state-unmeasurable on an unmeasurable state, and writes nothing there', () => {
      const bad: CollectLaneJournalRead = { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'order', record: 2 };
      expect(decide(retire(liveRow(3), bad), liveRow(3), bad)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'state-unmeasurable' });
      expect(decide(retire({ kind: 'absent' }, MISSING), { kind: 'absent' }, MISSING))
        .toMatchObject({ kind: 'refuse', code: 'state-unmeasurable' });
    });
  });

  it('at below 1 refuses state-unmeasurable', () => {
    // No latch, and no updatedAt, the reader would call malformed is ever written.
    const latched = liveRow(3, L);
    for (const at of [0, -1, 1.5, Number.NaN, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1]) {
      expect(verdictOf(decide(retire(raw(), MISSING), raw(), MISSING, at)), `retire at ${at}`).toBe('state-unmeasurable');
      expect(verdictOf(decide(live(raw(), MISSING), raw(), MISSING, at)), `live at ${at}`).toBe('state-unmeasurable');
      expect(verdictOf(decide(OFF, latched, ok(3), at)), `off at ${at}`).toBe('state-unmeasurable');
    }
    expect(verdictOf(decide(retire(raw(), MISSING), raw(), MISSING, 1)), 'the floor itself writes').toBe('write');
  });

  it('no arm writes markerRetiredAt null over a set value', () => {
    const bases: Partial<CollectLaneRowRaw>[] = [
      {}, { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, generation: 3n, updatedAt: 5n },
      { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, generation: 5n, updatedAt: 5n }, { choice: 'LIVE', generation: 3n },
      { fleetNodeId: NODE, generation: 3n },
    ];
    const journals: CollectLaneJournalRead[] = [MISSING, ok(3), ok(4), ok(5), ok(7)];
    let overASetLatch = 0;
    for (const base of bases) {
      for (const latch of [null, LATCH_N, 1n]) {
        const before = raw({ ...base, markerRetiredAt: latch });
        for (const journal of journals) {
          for (const req of [OFF, live(before, journal), live(before, journal, NODE_B), retire(before, journal)]) {
            const d = decide(req, before, journal);
            if (d.kind !== 'write') continue;
            const why = `${req.kind} over ${show(latch)} beside ${show(journal)}`;
            if (latch === null) {
              expect(d.next.markerRetiredAt, why).toBe(req.kind === 'retire' ? AT : null);
            } else {
              overASetLatch += 1;
              expect(d.next.markerRetiredAt, why).toBe(Number(latch));
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    expect(overASetLatch, 'the loop reaches writes over a set latch (116 when drafted)').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(100);
  });

  it('isCollectLaneKebab admits every word the tables declare, and nothing else', () => {
    // The words as test DATA, bound to the derived lists first: a guard read from the lists alone would admit nothing,
    // and stay green, on a tree where a table lost its keys.
    const JOURNAL_KINDS = ['missing', 'ok', 'malformed', 'unreadable', 'not-regular', 'not-configured'];
    const FAULTS = ['empty', 'blank', 'json', 'shape', 'generation', 'order'];
    const WHYS = ['row-absent', 'row-unreadable', 'row-malformed', 'journal-missing', 'journal-malformed',
      'journal-unreadable', 'journal-not-regular', 'journal-not-configured'];
    const REFUSALS = ['conflict', 'marker-still-controls', 'state-unmeasurable', 'not-coherent'];
    const LATCH_KINDS = ['not-due', 'retired', 'refused', 'failed', 'store-threw'];
    expect([...COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_KINDS].sort()).toEqual([...JOURNAL_KINDS].sort());
    expect([...COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_FAULTS].sort()).toEqual([...FAULTS].sort());
    expect([...COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_WHYS].sort()).toEqual([...WHYS].sort());
    expect([...COLLECT_LANE_WRITE_REFUSALS].sort()).toEqual([...REFUSALS].sort());
    expect([...COLLECT_LATCH_OUTCOME_KINDS].sort()).toEqual([...LATCH_KINDS].sort());
    for (const w of [...LATCH_KINDS, ...JOURNAL_KINDS, ...FAULTS, ...WHYS, ...REFUSALS]) {
      expect(isCollectLaneKebab(w), w).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const w of ['', 'toString', 'constructor', '__proto__', 'hasOwnProperty', 'confirm-stale', 'confirm-required',
```

```ts
// ── the Settings switch's durable state (path-identity spec §5.2) ───────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// The switch's control state is ONE database row and ONE generation journal, read together (path-identity spec
// 2026-10-12 §5.2). This section decides what each read means, whether the two agree, and what one write would do. It
// reads neither: the store (`coord/store.ts`) and the journal adapter (`coord/collectLaneJournal.ts`) measure, and hand
// their reads in as arguments.
// - The row is measured EXACTLY. The seed is `{off, null, null, 0, 0}` and nothing else, and a field outside its
//   domain is named, never cast.
// - The journal's grammar is STRICT. A blank, padded, torn or out-of-order record makes the whole file malformed, and
//   nothing here rebuilds a journal from the row it exists to distrust.
// - Coherence is EXACT EQUALITY of the journal's maximum and the row's generation. The untouched seed beside a missing
//   journal is the one bootstrap. The maximum allocates the next generation; it never proves one.
// - The write decision runs INSIDE the store's transaction, on the row and journal it re-read there.

/** The `collect_lane_settings` row as the store reads it, every value `unknown`: `measureCollectLaneRow` decides what
 *  each one means. The store reads with `setReadBigInts(true)`, so an INTEGER column arrives as a `bigint`. */
export interface CollectLaneRowRaw {
  readonly choice: unknown; readonly fleetNodeId: unknown; readonly markerRetiredAt: unknown;
  readonly generation: unknown; readonly updatedAt: unknown;
}
/** The store's read of the row: a row, no row, or a read that failed (a missing table, a driver throw). Three words,
 *  never one `null`. */
export type CollectLaneRowRead =
  | { readonly kind: 'row'; readonly row: CollectLaneRowRaw } | { readonly kind: 'absent' }
  | { readonly kind: 'unreadable'; readonly detail: string };
/** A measured row (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2):
 *  - `choice` is the raw stored token. Only exact `live` arms through Settings; any other string reads, and arms nothing;
 *  - `fleetNodeId` is null or a non-empty string, which arms only by exact equality with the directly measured node;
 *  - `markerRetiredAt` is null until a listing proves the legacy marker absent, and is never cleared once set;
 *  - `generation` is the database half of the generation proof; `updatedAt` is diagnostic, never an arming input. */
export interface CollectLaneRow {
  readonly choice: string; readonly fleetNodeId: string | null; readonly markerRetiredAt: number | null;
  readonly generation: number; readonly updatedAt: number;
}
export type CollectLaneRowField = 'choice' | 'fleetNodeId' | 'markerRetiredAt' | 'generation' | 'updatedAt';
/** The row, measured. `seed` is EXACTLY `{off, null, null, 0, 0}`; `malformed` names the first field, in column order,
 *  outside its domain. `absent` and `unreadable` pass through: neither is the seed, and neither arms anything. */
export type CollectLaneRowMeasure =
  | { readonly kind: 'seed'; readonly row: CollectLaneRow }
  | { readonly kind: 'row'; readonly row: CollectLaneRow }
  | { readonly kind: 'malformed'; readonly field: CollectLaneRowField }
  | { readonly kind: 'absent' } | { readonly kind: 'unreadable'; readonly detail: string };

/** The two stored choices this section writes, typed by L0's vocabulary. */
const COLLECT_CHOICE_OFF: CollectLaneChoice = 'off';
const COLLECT_CHOICE_LIVE: CollectLaneChoice = 'live';
const COLLECT_SAFE_MIN = BigInt(Number.MIN_SAFE_INTEGER);
const COLLECT_SAFE_MAX = BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
/** A `bigint` inside the safe-integer range becomes a `number`; any other `bigint` stays one, which every domain below
 *  refuses. Every other value passes through as read. A copy of `coord/stallsettings.ts`'s module-private `fromStore`:
 *  this L1 file imports nothing from `coord/`. */
function collectFromStore(v: unknown): unknown {
  if (typeof v !== 'bigint') return v;
  return v >= COLLECT_SAFE_MIN && v <= COLLECT_SAFE_MAX ? Number(v) : v;
}
/** `generation` and `updatedAt`: a safe integer, zero or more. `undefined` is outside the domain. */
function collectCountOf(v: unknown): number | undefined {
  const n = collectFromStore(v);
  return typeof n === 'number' && Number.isSafeInteger(n) && n >= 0 ? n : undefined;
}
/** `fleetNodeId`: null, or any non-empty string. `undefined` is outside the domain. */
function collectNodeOf(v: unknown): string | null | undefined {
  return v === null ? null : typeof v === 'string' && v !== '' ? v : undefined;
}
/** `markerRetiredAt`: null, or a positive safe integer. `undefined` is outside the domain. */
function collectLatchOf(v: unknown): number | null | undefined {
  const n = collectFromStore(v);
  return n === null ? null : isPositiveDecimalSafeInteger(n) ? n : undefined;
}

/** THE ROW'S ONE MEASURE (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). `choice` is any string; `fleetNodeId` null or a
 *  non-empty string; `markerRetiredAt` null or a positive safe integer; `generation` and `updatedAt` safe integers, zero
 *  or more. A bigint converts only inside the safe range. Never throws, never casts. */
export function measureCollectLaneRow(read: CollectLaneRowRead): CollectLaneRowMeasure {
  if (read.kind !== 'row') return read;
  const { choice } = read.row;
  if (typeof choice !== 'string') return { kind: 'malformed', field: 'choice' };
  const fleetNodeId = collectNodeOf(read.row.fleetNodeId);
  if (fleetNodeId === undefined) return { kind: 'malformed', field: 'fleetNodeId' };
  const markerRetiredAt = collectLatchOf(read.row.markerRetiredAt);
  if (markerRetiredAt === undefined) return { kind: 'malformed', field: 'markerRetiredAt' };
  const generation = collectCountOf(read.row.generation);
  if (generation === undefined) return { kind: 'malformed', field: 'generation' };
  const updatedAt = collectCountOf(read.row.updatedAt);
  if (updatedAt === undefined) return { kind: 'malformed', field: 'updatedAt' };
  const row: CollectLaneRow = { choice, fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt, generation, updatedAt };
  const seed = choice === COLLECT_CHOICE_OFF && fleetNodeId === null && markerRetiredAt === null && generation === 0
    && updatedAt === 0;
  return seed ? { kind: 'seed', row } : { kind: 'row', row };
}

/** Why a journal is malformed (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.9):
 *  - `empty`: an existing file with no bytes;
 *  - `blank`: a record that is empty, is padded by whitespace at either end, or carries a carriage return;
 *  - `json`: a record that does not parse, a torn tail included;
 *  - `shape`: a record that parses to anything but an object;
 *  - `generation`: an object whose own `generation` is not a positive safe integer;
 *  - `order`: a generation not above the record before it. */
export type CollectLaneJournalFault = 'empty' | 'blank' | 'json' | 'shape' | 'generation' | 'order';
const COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_FAULT_TABLE: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneJournalFault, true>> = {
  empty: true, blank: true, json: true, shape: true, generation: true, order: true,
};
export const COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_FAULTS: readonly CollectLaneJournalFault[] =
  Object.keys(COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_FAULT_TABLE) as CollectLaneJournalFault[];

/** The journal as its adapter measured it (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). Never one `null`:
 *  - `missing`: a PROVEN ENOENT only. It is generation 0 beside the exact seed, and unmeasurable beside anything else;
 *  - `ok`: every record parsed, and `max` is the last, largest generation;
 *  - `malformed`: the first fault, at its 1-based record;
 *  - `unreadable`: an errno word only, never a message or a path (`EFBIG` past the adapter's read cap);
 *  - `not-regular`: a symlink, a directory or anything else at the path, never followed and never read;
 *  - `not-configured`: no journal was wired (the executor's control read only). It is never `missing`. */
export type CollectLaneJournalRead =
  | { readonly kind: 'missing' }
  | { readonly kind: 'ok'; readonly max: number; readonly records: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'malformed'; readonly fault: CollectLaneJournalFault; readonly record: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'unreadable'; readonly code: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'not-regular'; readonly fileKind: 'symlink' | 'directory' | 'other' }
  | { readonly kind: 'not-configured' };
const COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_KIND_TABLE: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneJournalRead['kind'], true>> = {
  missing: true, ok: true, malformed: true, unreadable: true, 'not-regular': true, 'not-configured': true,
};
export const COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_KINDS: readonly CollectLaneJournalRead['kind'][] =
  Object.keys(COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_KIND_TABLE) as CollectLaneJournalRead['kind'][];

/** A record padded by whitespace at either end, or carrying a carriage return anywhere. */
const COLLECT_JOURNAL_BLANK = /^\s|\s$|\r/;

/** THE JOURNAL'S ONE PARSE (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.9). Total over every string; never throws. It splits
 *  on newlines and drops exactly one trailing empty string, so a final newline is allowed and never required. Every
 *  record is one JSON object whose own `generation` is a positive safe integer above the record before it; any other
 *  property is ignored. The first fault answers, at its 1-based record. */
export function parseCollectLaneJournal(text: string): Extract<CollectLaneJournalRead, { kind: 'ok' | 'malformed' }> {
  if (text === '') return { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'empty', record: 1 };
  const records = text.split('\n');
  if (records[records.length - 1] === '') records.pop();
  let max = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i += 1) {
    const rec = records[i];
    const record = i + 1;
    if (rec === '' || COLLECT_JOURNAL_BLANK.test(rec)) return { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'blank', record };
    let doc: unknown;
    try { doc = JSON.parse(rec); } catch { return { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'json', record }; }
    if (!isObject(doc)) return { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'shape', record };
    const generation = hasOwn(doc, 'generation') ? doc.generation : undefined;
    if (!isPositiveDecimalSafeInteger(generation)) return { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'generation', record };
    if (generation <= max) return { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'order', record };
    max = generation;
  }
  return { kind: 'ok', max, records: records.length };
}

/** The generation journal: an L2 port declared by its consumers (the store's one writer, the executor's final re-read,
 *  the route). `read` never throws. `appendGeneration` writes exactly `{"generation":g}` and a newline, with a leading
 *  newline first when the file lacks a final one, fsynced before it returns. It throws, with an errno `code`, on any
 *  failure. */
export interface CollectLaneJournal { read(): CollectLaneJournalRead; appendGeneration(generation: number): void }

/** Why the control state cannot be measured: the row's read, or the journal's, by its own word. */
export type CollectLaneUnmeasurable =
  | 'row-absent' | 'row-unreadable' | 'row-malformed' | 'journal-missing' | 'journal-malformed'
  | 'journal-unreadable' | 'journal-not-regular' | 'journal-not-configured';
const COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_TABLE: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneUnmeasurable, true>> = {
  'row-absent': true, 'row-unreadable': true, 'row-malformed': true, 'journal-missing': true,
  'journal-malformed': true, 'journal-unreadable': true, 'journal-not-regular': true, 'journal-not-configured': true,
};
export const COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_WHYS: readonly CollectLaneUnmeasurable[] =
  Object.keys(COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_TABLE) as CollectLaneUnmeasurable[];
/** Each journal read that can never be proof, and its own why. `missing` is decided beside the row; `ok` is compared. */
const COLLECT_JOURNAL_UNMEASURABLE:
  Readonly<Record<Exclude<CollectLaneJournalRead['kind'], 'missing' | 'ok'>, CollectLaneUnmeasurable>> = {
    malformed: 'journal-malformed', unreadable: 'journal-unreadable', 'not-regular': 'journal-not-regular',
    'not-configured': 'journal-not-configured',
  };

/** The switch's control state (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2):
 *  - `coherent`: the journal's maximum EQUALS the row's generation, or the exact seed stands beside a missing journal
 *    (`bootstrap`, generation 0);
 *  - `mismatch`: both are measurable and differ, in either direction. It arms nothing, and only a fresh operator write
 *    repairs it;
 *  - `unmeasurable`: the row or the journal cannot be measured. It arms nothing and refuses every write. */
export type CollectLaneControl =
  | { readonly kind: 'coherent'; readonly row: CollectLaneRow; readonly generation: number; readonly bootstrap: boolean }
  | { readonly kind: 'mismatch'; readonly row: CollectLaneRow; readonly journalMax: number; readonly rowGeneration: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'unmeasurable'; readonly why: CollectLaneUnmeasurable };

/** THE COHERENCE RULE (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2): exact equality. Never `row == max(journal, row)`, which would
 *  accept a database generation the journal never recorded. The row is measured first. */
export function collectLaneControl(row: CollectLaneRowMeasure, journal: CollectLaneJournalRead): CollectLaneControl {
  if (row.kind === 'absent') return { kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'row-absent' };
  if (row.kind === 'unreadable') return { kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'row-unreadable' };
  if (row.kind === 'malformed') return { kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'row-malformed' };
  if (journal.kind === 'missing') {
    return row.kind === 'seed' ? { kind: 'coherent', row: row.row, generation: 0, bootstrap: true }
      : { kind: 'unmeasurable', why: 'journal-missing' };
  }
  if (journal.kind !== 'ok') return { kind: 'unmeasurable', why: COLLECT_JOURNAL_UNMEASURABLE[journal.kind] };
  return journal.max === row.row.generation
    ? { kind: 'coherent', row: row.row, generation: journal.max, bootstrap: false }
    : { kind: 'mismatch', row: row.row, journalMax: journal.max, rowGeneration: row.row.generation };
}

/** The next generation, for ALLOCATION only: `max(journalMax, rowGeneration) + 1`, so a repair lands above both. null
 *  when that would pass `Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER`. */
export function collectLaneNextGeneration(c: Extract<CollectLaneControl, { kind: 'coherent' | 'mismatch' }>): number | null {
  const top = c.kind === 'coherent' ? Math.max(c.generation, c.row.generation) : Math.max(c.journalMax, c.rowGeneration);
  return top >= Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER ? null : top + 1;
}

/** One request to the switch's one writer (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.4, §5.6):
 *  - `live`: arm for `fleetNodeId`, only if the row and journal the transaction re-reads are still exactly the ones the
 *    caller read (`expected`, `expectedJournal`);
 *  - `off`: no expectation, so Off wins over a concurrent Live: it takes the latest row, clears the node and keeps the
 *    latch;
 *  - `retire`: the automatic latch, from the one latch helper, on the pair it read. It has no repair authority. */
export type CollectLaneWriteRequest =
  | { readonly kind: 'live'; readonly fleetNodeId: string; readonly expected: CollectLaneRowRead; readonly expectedJournal: CollectLaneJournalRead }
  | { readonly kind: 'off' }
  | { readonly kind: 'retire'; readonly expected: CollectLaneRowRead; readonly expectedJournal: CollectLaneJournalRead };
/** Why the writer wrote nothing (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.4, §5.6). None consumes a generation:
 *  - `conflict`: a Live or a retire whose expected row or journal is not what the transaction re-read;
 *  - `marker-still-controls`: Off while `markerRetiredAt` is null, whatever any listing says;
 *  - `state-unmeasurable`: the row or journal is unmeasurable, the write instant is not a positive safe integer, the
 *    node to arm is empty, or the next generation would pass the safe range;
 *  - `not-coherent`: a retire over a mismatch. The latch never heals one. */
export type CollectLaneWriteRefusal = 'conflict' | 'marker-still-controls' | 'state-unmeasurable' | 'not-coherent';
const COLLECT_LANE_WRITE_REFUSAL_TABLE: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneWriteRefusal, true>> = {
  conflict: true, 'marker-still-controls': true, 'state-unmeasurable': true, 'not-coherent': true,
};
export const COLLECT_LANE_WRITE_REFUSALS: readonly CollectLaneWriteRefusal[] =
  Object.keys(COLLECT_LANE_WRITE_REFUSAL_TABLE) as CollectLaneWriteRefusal[];
/** The writer's decision: refuse (with a bounded detail that names no path), leave the row as it stands, or write the
 *  complete row's three intent fields at `generation`. The store writes `updatedAt` from the same instant. */
export type CollectLaneWriteDecision =
  | { readonly kind: 'refuse'; readonly code: CollectLaneWriteRefusal; readonly detail: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'unchanged' }
  | { readonly kind: 'write'; readonly generation: number;
      readonly next: { readonly choice: string; readonly fleetNodeId: string | null; readonly markerRetiredAt: number | null } };

const COLLECT_LANE_UNCHANGED: CollectLaneWriteDecision = { kind: 'unchanged' };
const collectRefuse = (code: CollectLaneWriteRefusal, detail: string): CollectLaneWriteDecision =>
  ({ kind: 'refuse', code, detail });
/** A write of `next` at the next generation, or `state-unmeasurable` when none is left in the safe range. */
function collectWriteNext(control: Extract<CollectLaneControl, { kind: 'coherent' | 'mismatch' }>,
  next: { readonly choice: string; readonly fleetNodeId: string | null; readonly markerRetiredAt: number | null }): CollectLaneWriteDecision {
  const generation = collectLaneNextGeneration(control);
  return generation === null
    ? collectRefuse('state-unmeasurable', 'the next generation would pass the safe-integer range')
    : { kind: 'write', generation, next };
}

/** THE WRITE DECISION (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.4, §5.6). The store runs it INSIDE its transaction, on the
 *  row and journal it re-read there. In order:
 *  1. the write instant must be a positive safe integer, and a Live's node non-empty, else `state-unmeasurable`;
 *  2. Live and retire compare the row, then the journal, AS READ with what the caller read; a change is `conflict`;
 *  3. an unmeasurable control state is `state-unmeasurable`, for every request (an absent row is never inserted);
 *  4. the request's own rule:
 *     - Off: a null latch is `marker-still-controls`; a coherent `off` with no node is unchanged; otherwise
 *       `{off, null, latch kept}`, which repairs a mismatch;
 *     - Live: a coherent row already `live` for the node is unchanged; otherwise `{live, node, latch kept}`, which
 *       repairs a mismatch;
 *     - retire: a mismatch is `not-coherent`; a set latch is unchanged; otherwise the latch at `at`, with the choice and
 *       node kept as stored, a future token included.
 *  A refusal and a no-op allocate nothing, and every write is at `max(journal, row) + 1`. No arm writes `markerRetiredAt`
 *  null over a set value: Off and Live copy it, and retire writes only over null. */
export function decideCollectLaneWrite(req: CollectLaneWriteRequest, before: CollectLaneRowRead,
  journal: CollectLaneJournalRead, at: number): CollectLaneWriteDecision {
  if (!isPositiveDecimalSafeInteger(at)) {
    return collectRefuse('state-unmeasurable', 'the write instant is not a positive safe integer');
  }
  if (req.kind === 'live' && req.fleetNodeId === '') return collectRefuse('state-unmeasurable', 'the node to arm is empty');
  if (req.kind !== 'off') {
    if (!sameCollectLaneRow(before, req.expected)) return collectRefuse('conflict', 'the row changed after it was read');
    if (!sameCollectLaneJournal(journal, req.expectedJournal)) {
      return collectRefuse('conflict', 'the generation journal changed after it was read');
    }
  }
  const control = collectLaneControl(measureCollectLaneRow(before), journal);
  if (control.kind === 'unmeasurable') {
    return collectRefuse('state-unmeasurable', `the switch state is unmeasurable: ${control.why}`);
  }
  const { row } = control;
  switch (req.kind) {
    case 'off':
      if (row.markerRetiredAt === null) {
        return collectRefuse('marker-still-controls', 'the legacy marker file has not been retired');
      }
      if (control.kind === 'coherent' && row.choice === COLLECT_CHOICE_OFF && row.fleetNodeId === null) {
        return COLLECT_LANE_UNCHANGED;
      }
      return collectWriteNext(control, { choice: COLLECT_CHOICE_OFF, fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: row.markerRetiredAt });
    case 'live':
      if (control.kind === 'coherent' && row.choice === COLLECT_CHOICE_LIVE && row.fleetNodeId === req.fleetNodeId) {
        return COLLECT_LANE_UNCHANGED;
      }
      return collectWriteNext(control,
        { choice: COLLECT_CHOICE_LIVE, fleetNodeId: req.fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt: row.markerRetiredAt });
    case 'retire':
      if (control.kind !== 'coherent') {
        return collectRefuse('not-coherent', 'the journal and the row disagree, and the latch never heals them');
      }
      if (row.markerRetiredAt !== null) return COLLECT_LANE_UNCHANGED;
      return collectWriteNext(control, { choice: row.choice, fleetNodeId: row.fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt: at });
    default: { const unnamed: never = req; return unnamed; }
  }
}

/** The one latch helper's answer (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.4). It is declared here so that its kinds come from an
 *  L1 table, and the executor's `collectRetireLatch` (`coord/collectTempRoot.ts`) returns it:
 *  - `not-due`: the listing or the control state did not prove the marker retirable, and the store was not asked;
 *  - `retired`: the store wrote the latch;
 *  - `refused`: the store refused the retire request, with its word;
 *  - `failed`: the store failed at a phase after its decision;
 *  - `store-threw`: the store threw BEFORE its append (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE` busy past its timeout, an I/O fault at
 *    `BEGIN`, a read or a decision that threw), which `setCollectLane` propagates by design. Nothing was appended or
 *    written. The helper answers it rather than rethrowing, so its callers re-read and go on (R16's extension, the
 *    coordinator, 2026-10-12). */
export type CollectLatchOutcome =
  | { readonly kind: 'not-due' } | { readonly kind: 'retired' }
  | { readonly kind: 'refused'; readonly code: CollectLaneWriteRefusal }
  | { readonly kind: 'failed'; readonly phase: 'append' | 'update' | 'commit' }
  | { readonly kind: 'store-threw' };
const COLLECT_LATCH_OUTCOME_KIND_TABLE: Readonly<Record<CollectLatchOutcome['kind'], true>> = {
  'not-due': true, retired: true, refused: true, failed: true, 'store-threw': true,
};
export const COLLECT_LATCH_OUTCOME_KINDS: readonly CollectLatchOutcome['kind'][] =
  Object.keys(COLLECT_LATCH_OUTCOME_KIND_TABLE) as CollectLatchOutcome['kind'][];

/** Whether two row reads are the same state, compared AS READ, before any measure, so a `bigint` meets a `bigint`: the
 *  same kind and, for a row, the same five raw values. Two reads that are not rows compare by kind (the
 *  `sameStallSettingsRead` idiom). */
export function sameCollectLaneRow(a: CollectLaneRowRead, b: CollectLaneRowRead): boolean {
  if (a.kind === 'row' && b.kind === 'row') {
    return a.row.choice === b.row.choice && a.row.fleetNodeId === b.row.fleetNodeId
      && a.row.markerRetiredAt === b.row.markerRetiredAt && a.row.generation === b.row.generation
      && a.row.updatedAt === b.row.updatedAt;
  }
  return a.kind === b.kind;
}
/** Whether two journal reads are the same state: the same kind and every field of that arm. */
export function sameCollectLaneJournal(a: CollectLaneJournalRead, b: CollectLaneJournalRead): boolean {
  switch (a.kind) {
    case 'ok': return b.kind === 'ok' && a.max === b.max && a.records === b.records;
    case 'malformed': return b.kind === 'malformed' && a.fault === b.fault && a.record === b.record;
    case 'unreadable': return b.kind === 'unreadable' && a.code === b.code;
    case 'not-regular': return b.kind === 'not-regular' && a.fileKind === b.fileKind;
    case 'missing': case 'not-configured': return b.kind === a.kind;
    default: { const unnamed: never = a; return unnamed; }
  }
}

/** Every word this section's tables declare: the journal's read kinds and faults, the control state's whys, the
 *  writer's refusals and the latch helper's outcomes. A scan of quoted kebab words admits the switch's words through
 *  this guard, never through an allowlist. Derived from the tables, never a hand list. */
const COLLECT_LANE_KEBAB_WORDS: readonly string[] = [
  ...COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_KINDS, ...COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_FAULTS, ...COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_WHYS,
  ...COLLECT_LANE_WRITE_REFUSALS, ...COLLECT_LATCH_OUTCOME_KINDS,
];
export function isCollectLaneKebab(v: string): boolean {
  return COLLECT_LANE_KEBAB_WORDS.includes(v);
}
```

### Task 3: L1, the resolver, the latch predicate, the switch and latch bodies, and the counts

**Model routing:** **`opus`, effort `xhigh`**. SAFETY: `collectLaneEffective` decides what arms the collector's deletion. Under R27 the executor's step 6 and the view are its only callers, and from Task 7 on, `live` is the only arm under which `CCD_ARGV.wsCollect(` is reached.

**Why:**
- **Figure 5 with R2 and R21.** The precedence is: paused, unlistable, epoch, caps, control, the marker arm, the Settings arm, unknown node, shadowed.
  - `epoch-changed` and `unknown-fleet` are arms of `stopped`, alongside `raised` and `unlistable`. A stopped arm means no flip, no feed row and a lane-wide clear.
  - Only control incoherence is `safety-stopped`. That arm is a flip candidate whose boolean is false.
  - A stored `live` whose node is unmeasured, in collision, or measured on another epoch is `stopped/unknown-fleet`, never shadowed.
  - A stored `live` for a different node that was measured on this epoch is `shadowed/other-node`.
  - The marker still arms before its latch, because Figure 5's F comes before G.
- **R22.** `collectLatchDue` decides the latch from the listing, the epoch pair and the control state alone. A stored Live on an unknown node therefore still retires a removed marker. `collectLaneEffective` gets `notes.latchDue` from that same predicate, so the predicate has one definer.
- **R31 and R36.** `collectSwitchFeedBody(r)` is added here. Task 7 moves `watch.ts` onto it and deletes `collectFeedSwitchBody(live)`. This task does not touch the old body. The latch body is R3's sentence followed by `; by <actor>`.
- **R12 and R26.** `collectLaneCounts` counts by `collectItemOf`'s own precedence. Unvouched holds count as held. The unvouched box line is left out of `boxLines`.
- **Rings (T1).** `collectLane.ts` keeps its two import statements and gets no `node:` import. It spells neither `COLLECT_CAP` nor a quoted capability token, and has no `**` in code. Task 3 writes no `coord/` file, `watch.ts`, `shared/api.ts` or prose.

```ts
const MOVED: CollectEpochPair = { before: EPOCH, after: EPOCH + 1 };
const CAPS: CollectLaneCaps = { collect: true, reclaimPause: true };
const STANDS: CollectLaneSwitches = { paused: false, marker: true };
const ABSENT: CollectLaneSwitches = { paused: false, marker: false };
const RAISED: CollectLaneSwitches = { paused: true, why: 'raised', marker: true };
const UNLISTABLE: CollectLaneSwitches = { paused: true, why: 'unlistable' };

const NODE_A = 'node-a';
const NODE_B = 'node-b';
const KNOWN_A: CollectCurrentNode = { kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: EPOCH, nodeId: NODE_A, measuredAt: 1_000 };
const KNOWN_B: CollectCurrentNode = { kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: EPOCH, nodeId: NODE_B, measuredAt: 1_000 };
const KNOWN_A_EARLIER: CollectCurrentNode = { kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: EPOCH - 1, nodeId: NODE_A, measuredAt: 900 };
const KNOWN_A_LATER: CollectCurrentNode = { kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: EPOCH + 1, nodeId: NODE_A, measuredAt: 1_100 };
const UNMEASURED: CollectCurrentNode = { kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: EPOCH };
const COLLISION: CollectCurrentNode = { kind: 'collision', connectionEpoch: EPOCH };

/** The migration's exact seed, as the store reads it (bigints, `setReadBigInts`). */
const SEED_RAW: CollectLaneRowRaw = { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 0n, updatedAt: 0n };
const MISSING: CollectLaneJournalRead = { kind: 'missing' };
const J = (max: number): CollectLaneJournalRead => ({ kind: 'ok', max, records: max });
const control = (row: Partial<CollectLaneRowRaw>, journal: CollectLaneJournalRead): CollectLaneControl =>
  collectLaneControl(measureCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'row', row: { ...SEED_RAW, ...row } }), journal);

const SEED = control({}, MISSING);
const OFF = control({ generation: 3n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(3));
const OFF_LATCHED = control({ markerRetiredAt: 800n, generation: 4n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(4));
const LIVE_A = control({ choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, generation: 3n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(3));
const LIVE_A_LATCHED = control({ choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, markerRetiredAt: 800n, generation: 4n,
  updatedAt: 900n }, J(4));
/** The named regression {journal:4,row:5}, and its mirror {journal:5,row:4}: both are mismatches, never coherent. */
const BEHIND = control({ choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, generation: 5n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(4));
const AHEAD = control({ choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, generation: 4n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(5));
const USED = { generation: 4n, updatedAt: 900n } as const;
/** Total by type: a new unmeasurable state is a compile error here until it has a row (typecheck-tests). */
const UNMEASURABLE: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneUnmeasurable, CollectLaneControl>> = {
  'row-absent': collectLaneControl(measureCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'absent' }), J(4)),
  'row-unreadable': collectLaneControl(measureCollectLaneRow({ kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'SQLITE_IOERR' }), J(4)),
  'row-malformed': control({ ...USED, choice: 1 }, J(4)),
  'journal-missing': control(USED, MISSING),
  'journal-malformed': control(USED, { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'order', record: 3 }),
  'journal-unreadable': control(USED, { kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EACCES' }),
  'journal-not-regular': control(USED, { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'symlink' }),
  'journal-not-configured': control({}, { kind: 'not-configured' }),
};

const inputs = (over: Partial<CollectLaneInputs>): CollectLaneInputs =>
  ({ switches: ABSENT, epoch: SAME, caps: CAPS, control: LIVE_A_LATCHED, node: KNOWN_A, ...over });
const notes = (latchDue: boolean, markerRecreated: boolean): CollectLaneNotes => ({ latchDue, markerRecreated });
const N = notes(false, false);
type Case = readonly [CollectLaneInputs, CollectLaneEffective];

const FIGURE_5: readonly (readonly [string, readonly Case[]])[] = [
  ['a raised pause beats a coherent Settings live for the same node and a standing marker', [
    [inputs({ switches: RAISED, control: LIVE_A, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'raised' }],
    [inputs({ switches: RAISED, control: LIVE_A, epoch: MOVED, caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: false } }),
      { kind: 'stopped', why: 'raised' }],
  ]],
  ['an unlistable registry stops', [
    [inputs({ switches: UNLISTABLE, control: LIVE_A }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unlistable' }],
    [inputs({ switches: UNLISTABLE, control: SEED, epoch: MOVED }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unlistable' }],
  ]],
  ['an epoch move stops, with a marker', [
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, epoch: MOVED, control: SEED, node: UNMEASURED }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'epoch-changed' }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, epoch: MOVED, control: LIVE_A, node: KNOWN_A_LATER }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'epoch-changed' }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, epoch: MOVED, control: LIVE_A, caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: true } }),
      { kind: 'stopped', why: 'epoch-changed' }],
  ]],
  ['either missing capability is not-running', [
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: LIVE_A, caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: true } }), { kind: 'not-running' }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: LIVE_A, caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: false } }), { kind: 'not-running' }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: LIVE_A, caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: false } }), { kind: 'not-running' }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: BEHIND, caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: false } }), { kind: 'not-running' }],
  ]],
  ['every unmeasurable control state suppresses the marker',
    (Object.entries(UNMEASURABLE) as [CollectLaneUnmeasurable, CollectLaneControl][]).map(([why, c]): Case =>
      [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: c, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'safety-stopped', why }])],
  ['{journal:4,row:5} suppresses the marker', [
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: BEHIND, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'generation-mismatch' }],
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: BEHIND, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'generation-mismatch' }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: AHEAD, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'generation-mismatch' }],
  ]],
  ['the seed with a missing journal and the marker is live by the legacy file', [
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: SEED, node: UNMEASURED }), { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'legacy-marker', notes: N }],
  ]],
  ['a set latch makes a re-created marker ineffective', [
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: OFF_LATCHED, node: KNOWN_A }),
      { kind: 'shadowed', why: 'off', notes: notes(false, true) }],
  ]],
  ['marker plus Settings live for this node is both; marker plus off is legacy-marker', [
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: LIVE_A, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'both', notes: N }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: OFF, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'legacy-marker', notes: N }],
  ]],
  ['coherent exact live for the known current node is live by Settings', [
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A_LATCHED, node: KNOWN_A }), { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'settings', notes: N }],
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A, node: KNOWN_A }),
      { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'settings', notes: notes(true, false) }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: LIVE_A_LATCHED, node: KNOWN_A }),
      { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'settings', notes: notes(false, true) }],
  ]],
  ['future tokens are shadowed', (['LIVE', 'toString', 'shadowed'] as const).map((choice): Case => [
    inputs({ switches: ABSENT, node: KNOWN_A, control: control({ choice, fleetNodeId: NODE_A, markerRetiredAt: 800n,
      generation: 4n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(4)) }),
    { kind: 'shadowed', why: 'future-choice', notes: N }])],
  ['another node is shadowed', [
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A_LATCHED, node: KNOWN_B }), { kind: 'shadowed', why: 'other-node', notes: N }],
  ]],
  ['live with the node unmeasured or in collision is stopped', [
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A_LATCHED, node: UNMEASURED }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' }],
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A_LATCHED, node: COLLISION }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' }],
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A, node: UNMEASURED }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' }],
  ]],
  ['live with the node unknown but the marker armed is still live by the legacy file', [
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: LIVE_A, node: UNMEASURED }), { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'legacy-marker', notes: N }],
    [inputs({ switches: STANDS, control: LIVE_A, node: COLLISION }), { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'legacy-marker', notes: N }],
  ]],
  ['a node measured on another epoch is unknown-fleet', [
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A_LATCHED, node: KNOWN_A_EARLIER }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' }],
  ]],
  ['off with the node unknown is shadowed, never unknown-fleet', [
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: OFF_LATCHED, node: UNMEASURED }), { kind: 'shadowed', why: 'off', notes: N }],
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: OFF_LATCHED, node: COLLISION }), { kind: 'shadowed', why: 'off', notes: N }],
  ]],
  ['a stored node arms only beside an exact live, and a live with no stored node never arms', [
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, node: KNOWN_A, control: control({ fleetNodeId: NODE_A, markerRetiredAt: 800n,
      generation: 4n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(4)) }), { kind: 'shadowed', why: 'off', notes: N }],
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, node: KNOWN_A, control: control({ choice: 'live', markerRetiredAt: 800n,
      generation: 4n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(4)) }), { kind: 'shadowed', why: 'other-node', notes: N }],
    [inputs({ switches: ABSENT, node: UNMEASURED, control: control({ choice: 'live', markerRetiredAt: 800n,
      generation: 4n, updatedAt: 900n }, J(4)) }), { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' }],
  ]],
];

describe('Figure 5, with the three unknown-node cases (path-identity spec §5.2, §5.5)', () => {
  it('CONTROL: each control fixture is the state its name says, through the real coherence rule', () => {
    expect(SEED).toMatchObject({ kind: 'coherent', generation: 0, bootstrap: true });
    expect(OFF).toMatchObject({ kind: 'coherent', generation: 3, bootstrap: false, row: { choice: 'off', markerRetiredAt: null } });
    expect(OFF_LATCHED).toMatchObject({ kind: 'coherent', row: { choice: 'off', markerRetiredAt: 800 } });
    expect(LIVE_A).toMatchObject({ kind: 'coherent', row: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, markerRetiredAt: null } });
    expect(LIVE_A_LATCHED).toMatchObject({ kind: 'coherent', row: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, markerRetiredAt: 800 } });
    expect(BEHIND).toMatchObject({ kind: 'mismatch', journalMax: 4, rowGeneration: 5 });
    expect(AHEAD).toMatchObject({ kind: 'mismatch', journalMax: 5, rowGeneration: 4 });
    for (const [why, c] of Object.entries(UNMEASURABLE)) expect(c, why).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasurable', why });
  });

  it.each<readonly [string, readonly Case[]]>(FIGURE_5)('%s', (_title, cases) => {
    for (const [i, want] of cases) expect(collectLaneEffective(i), JSON.stringify(i)).toEqual(want);
  });
});

describe('the latch predicate (path-identity spec §5.4)', () => {
  it('due on a coherent, unpaused, listed, same-epoch absence with the latch null', () => {
    for (const [what, c] of [['seed', SEED], ['off', OFF], ['live', LIVE_A]] as const) {
      expect(collectLatchDue(ABSENT, SAME, c), what).toBe(true);
    }
  });

  it('not due when any one condition fails', () => {
    const rows: readonly (readonly [string, CollectLaneSwitches, CollectEpochPair, CollectLaneControl])[] = [
      ['raised', { paused: true, why: 'raised', marker: false }, SAME, OFF],
      ['unlistable', UNLISTABLE, SAME, OFF],
      ['epoch moved', ABSENT, MOVED, OFF],
      ['marker stands', STANDS, SAME, OFF],
      ['latch set', ABSENT, SAME, OFF_LATCHED],
      ['mismatch, journal behind', ABSENT, SAME, BEHIND],
      ['mismatch, journal ahead', ABSENT, SAME, AHEAD],
      ...Object.entries(UNMEASURABLE).map(([why, c]) => [why, ABSENT, SAME, c] as const),
    ];
    expect(collectLatchDue(ABSENT, SAME, OFF), 'CONTROL: the row each case breaks is due').toBe(true);
    for (const [what, s, e, c] of rows) expect(collectLatchDue(s, e, c), what).toBe(false);
  });

  it('due even when choice is live and the node is unknown', () => {
    for (const node of [UNMEASURED, COLLISION, KNOWN_A_EARLIER]) {
      expect(collectLaneEffective(inputs({ switches: ABSENT, control: LIVE_A, node })), 'the arm is stopped')
        .toEqual({ kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' });
    }
    expect(collectLatchDue(ABSENT, SAME, LIVE_A), 'the latch is decided apart from the arm').toBe(true);
  });

  it('the resolver’s latchDue note is the predicate’s answer, so the latch has one definer', () => {
    let due = 0;
    let notDue = 0;
    for (const [i] of FIGURE_5.flatMap(([, cases]) => cases)) {
      const r = collectLaneEffective(i);
      if (r.kind !== 'live' && r.kind !== 'shadowed') continue;
      expect(r.notes.latchDue, JSON.stringify(i)).toBe(collectLatchDue(i.switches, i.epoch, i.control));
      if (r.notes.latchDue) due += 1;
      else notDue += 1;
    }
    expect(due, 'CONTROL: a due row is among them').toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(notDue, 'CONTROL: a row not due is among them').toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});

describe('the flip boolean (path-identity spec §5.5)', () => {
  it('collectLaneLive is true for the live arm alone, whatever armed it', () => {
    for (const armedBy of ['legacy-marker', 'settings', 'both'] as const) {
      expect(collectLaneLive({ kind: 'live', armedBy, notes: N }), armedBy).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const why of ['off', 'future-choice', 'other-node'] as const) {
      expect(collectLaneLive({ kind: 'shadowed', why, notes: N }), why).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(collectLaneLive({ kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'generation-mismatch' })).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

(b) Create `server/test/collect-switch-bodies.test.ts`:

```ts
// Child reclamation wave 10 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.4, §5.5): the collector's transition row names what
// armed it, or that neither does and why, or its bounded safety-stop reason from a total table; the latch row is the
// ruled sentence and its actor; and a change of the switch's stored state carries a title of its own. No body carries a
// detail, a path, a raw reason token or the journal's file name.
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  COLLECT_FEED_TITLE, COLLECT_SETTING_FEED_TITLE, collectLatchFeedBody, collectSwitchFeedBody,
  type CollectLaneNotes, type CollectLaneSafetyWhy, type CollectLaneSettled,
} from '../src/collectLane.js';

const N: CollectLaneNotes = { latchDue: false, markerRecreated: false };
const live = (armedBy: 'legacy-marker' | 'settings' | 'both'): CollectLaneSettled => ({ kind: 'live', armedBy, notes: N });
const shadowed = (why: 'off' | 'future-choice' | 'other-node'): CollectLaneSettled => ({ kind: 'shadowed', why, notes: N });
const stopped = (why: CollectLaneSafetyWhy): CollectLaneSettled => ({ kind: 'safety-stopped', why });
/** Total by type: a new safety-stop reason is a compile error here until it is listed (typecheck-tests). */
const SAFETY: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneSafetyWhy, true>> = {
  'row-absent': true, 'row-unreadable': true, 'row-malformed': true, 'journal-missing': true, 'journal-malformed': true,
  'journal-unreadable': true, 'journal-not-regular': true, 'journal-not-configured': true, 'generation-mismatch': true,
};
const SAFETY_WHYS = Object.keys(SAFETY) as CollectLaneSafetyWhy[];
const LIVE_TAIL = ': the temp-root collector removes an orphaned temp root it has proved idle twice, with no person in '
  + 'the loop, while cleanup is not paused.';
const shadowSaid = (reason: string): string => "the collector lane is now shadowed: neither Settings nor the fleet box's "
  + `legacy file arms it (${reason}), so the temp-root collector audits and reports what it would collect, and removes `
  + 'nothing.';
const ALL_SETTLED: readonly CollectLaneSettled[] = [
  live('legacy-marker'), live('settings'), live('both'),
  shadowed('off'), shadowed('future-choice'), shadowed('other-node'),
  ...SAFETY_WHYS.map(stopped),
];
/** The resolver's raw tokens: a body words each, and never prints one. */
const RAW_TOKENS: readonly string[] = [...SAFETY_WHYS, 'legacy-marker', 'future-choice', 'other-node', 'unknown-fleet',
  'epoch-changed'];

describe('the transition and latch rows name their source, never a path (§5.5)', () => {
  it('live names its source', () => {
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(live('legacy-marker')))
      .toBe(`the collector lane is now live, armed by the fleet box's legacy file${LIVE_TAIL}`);
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(live('settings'))).toBe(`the collector lane is now live, armed by Settings${LIVE_TAIL}`);
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(live('both')))
      .toBe(`the collector lane is now live, armed by both Settings and the fleet box's legacy file${LIVE_TAIL}`);
  });

  it('shadowed names neither and its reason', () => {
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(shadowed('off'))).toBe(shadowSaid('Settings is off'));
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(shadowed('future-choice'))).toBe(shadowSaid('Settings holds a choice this build does not know'));
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(shadowed('other-node'))).toBe(shadowSaid('Settings is live for another fleet node'));
  });

  it('safety-stopped names its reason from a total table', () => {
    const bodies = SAFETY_WHYS.map((why) => collectSwitchFeedBody(stopped(why)));
    for (const b of bodies) {
      expect(b.startsWith('the collector lane is now safety-stopped: '), b).toBe(true);
      expect(b.endsWith(', so the temp-root collector removes nothing until its control state is proved coherent.'), b)
        .toBe(true);
      expect(b, 'a reason missing from the table').not.toContain('undefined');
    }
    expect(new Set(bodies).size, 'each reason has its own words').toBe(SAFETY_WHYS.length);
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(stopped('generation-mismatch'))).toBe('the collector lane is now safety-stopped: its '
      + 'database and its monotonic journal disagree, so the temp-root collector removes nothing until its control state '
      + 'is proved coherent.');
  });

  it('the live/shadowed prefixes are kept', () => {
    for (const a of ['legacy-marker', 'settings', 'both'] as const) {
      expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(live(a)).startsWith('the collector lane is now live'), a).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const w of ['off', 'future-choice', 'other-node'] as const) {
      expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(shadowed(w)).startsWith('the collector lane is now shadowed'), w).toBe(true);
    }
    for (const w of SAFETY_WHYS) {
      const b = collectSwitchFeedBody(stopped(w));
      expect(b.startsWith('the collector lane is now live') || b.startsWith('the collector lane is now shadowed'), w).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  it('no body carries a detail, a path or the journal\'s basename', () => {
    const bodies = [...ALL_SETTLED.map(collectSwitchFeedBody), collectLatchFeedBody('collect sweep')];
    for (const b of bodies) {
      expect(b, 'a path character').not.toMatch(/[/\\~]/);
      expect(b, 'a file name').not.toMatch(/collect-lane-(?:generation|live)|\.log\b/);
      for (const tok of RAW_TOKENS) expect(b.includes(tok), `${tok} in ${b}`).toBe(false);
    }
    const planted = { kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'journal-unreadable',
      detail: '/fixture-home/.ccrc/collect-lane-generation.log: EACCES' } as CollectLaneSettled;
    expect(collectSwitchFeedBody(planted), 'a field beside the reason is never read')
      .toBe(collectSwitchFeedBody(stopped('journal-unreadable')));
  });

  it('the latch body is the ruled sentence and the actor', () => {
    expect(collectLatchFeedBody('collect sweep')).toBe("the fleet box's legacy file was retired: Settings alone controls "
      + 'the collector now; by collect sweep');
  });

  it('COLLECT_SETTING_FEED_TITLE differs from the transition row\'s title', () => {
    expect(COLLECT_SETTING_FEED_TITLE).toBe('temp root collector setting changed');
    expect(COLLECT_SETTING_FEED_TITLE).not.toBe(COLLECT_FEED_TITLE.switch);
    expect(Object.values(COLLECT_FEED_TITLE)).not.toContain(COLLECT_SETTING_FEED_TITLE);
  });
});
```

(c) Create `server/test/collect-lane-counts.test.ts`:

```ts
// Child reclamation wave 10 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.7): the Settings section shows would-collect and held
// counts from existing attention state. The PWA counts nothing, so the server counts, by the items' own precedence
// (`collectItemOf`), never by a second ladder: these cases hold `collectLaneCounts` to what `collectAttentionItems`
// publishes, unvouched holds included, and the box lines other than the unvouched one.
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import type { ChildReclaimCollectAttention } from '../../shared/api.js';
import { CHILD_RECLAIM_TIER_NONE, childReclaimTierFrom } from '../src/childReclaimSweep.js';
import {
  collectAttentionItems, collectLaneCounts,
  type CollectAttentionView, type CollectBoxFacts, type CollectRunView,
} from '../src/collectLane.js';

const NO_RUN: CollectRunView = { tier: CHILD_RECLAIM_TIER_NONE, word: null, detail: null };
const runOf = (cls: string, word: string, n: number, stuck = false): CollectRunView =>
  ({ tier: childReclaimTierFrom(cls, n, stuck), word, detail: null });
const view = (over: Partial<CollectAttentionView> = {}): CollectAttentionView => ({
  witnessRun: 41, leaf: '/h/tmp-root/demo-a', failing: NO_RUN, verbFailed: NO_RUN, terminal: NO_RUN, deferral: null,
  presenceSince: null, hold: null, changedRecentlySince: null, die: null, wouldCollect: false, ...over,
});
const holdOf = (why: 'run-open' | 'run-absent' | 'run-after-witness' | 'id-in-open-run'): CollectAttentionView =>
  view({ hold: { why, since: 0 } });
const BOX: CollectBoxFacts = {
  unmeasured: [], refusedNames: 0, boxProbes: new Map(), passAudits: new Map(), flockLatched: false, unsettled: new Map(),
};
interface Lane { readonly entries: ReadonlyMap<string, CollectAttentionView>; readonly box: CollectBoxFacts }
const lane = (entries: Readonly<Record<string, CollectAttentionView>>, box: Partial<CollectBoxFacts> = {}): Lane =>
  ({ entries: new Map(Object.entries(entries)), box: { ...BOX, ...box } });
/** The unvouched count, read from the one box line that states it. */
const unvouchedOf = (box: readonly ChildReclaimCollectAttention[]): number => {
  const line = box.find((a) => a.word === 'unvouched');
  if (line === undefined) return 0;
  const m = /^(\d+) temp roots are held/.exec(line.sentence);
  expect(m, 'CONTROL: the unvouched line states its count').not.toBeNull();
  return Number(m![1]);
};

const STATES: readonly (readonly [string, Lane])[] = [
  ['nothing remembered', lane({})],
  ['a mixed lane', lane({
    'demo-a': view({ wouldCollect: true }),
    'demo-b': holdOf('run-open'),
    'demo-c': holdOf('run-absent'),
    'demo-d': view({ deferral: { word: 'in-use', detail: 'pid 7', since: 0 }, wouldCollect: true }),
    'demo-e': view({ presenceSince: 0 }),
    'demo-f': view({ terminal: runOf('terminal', 'witness-mismatch', 1, true) }),
    'demo-g': view({ verbFailed: runOf('verb-failed', 'probe-unmeasured', 4) }),
    'demo-h': view({ changedRecentlySince: 0, wouldCollect: true }),
  })],
  ['a records failure while the record listing is in doubt yields to its would-collect', lane(
    { 'demo-a': view({ failing: runOf('failing', 'records', 4), wouldCollect: true }) },
    { unmeasured: [{ listing: 'tmpquarantine', kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'a symbolic link' }] })],
  ['the same records failure with the listing measured is a failing item', lane(
    { 'demo-a': view({ failing: runOf('failing', 'records', 4), wouldCollect: true }) })],
  ['box lines beside unvouched holds', lane(
    { 'demo-1': holdOf('run-absent'), 'demo-2': holdOf('run-after-witness'), 'demo-3': view({ wouldCollect: true }) },
    { flockLatched: true, refusedNames: 3, unsettled: new Map([['demo-9', 'audit']]) })],
];

describe("the counts come from the items' own precedence (§5.7)", () => {
  it('would-collect ids are counted', () => {
    expect(collectLaneCounts(lane({ 'demo-a': view({ wouldCollect: true }), 'demo-b': view({ wouldCollect: true }),
      'demo-c': view() }))).toEqual({ wouldCollect: 2, held: 0, boxLines: 0 });
  });

  it('held counts per-id held items plus unvouched ids', () => {
    expect(collectLaneCounts(lane({
      'demo-1': holdOf('run-open'),
      'demo-2': holdOf('run-absent'),
      'demo-3': holdOf('run-after-witness'),
      'demo-4': view({ hold: { why: 'run-open', since: 0 }, deferral: { word: 'in-use', detail: 'pid 7', since: 0 } }),
      'demo-5': view({ hold: { why: 'id-in-open-run', since: 0 }, wouldCollect: true }),
    }))).toEqual({ wouldCollect: 0, held: 4, boxLines: 0 });
  });

  it('boxLines excludes the unvouched line', () => {
    const l = lane({ 'demo-1': holdOf('run-absent'), 'demo-2': holdOf('run-after-witness') },
      { flockLatched: true, refusedNames: 2 });
    expect(collectAttentionItems({ ...l, nowMono: 0 }).box.map((a) => a.word), 'CONTROL: three lines stand, the unvouched among them')
      .toEqual(['refused-names', 'flock', 'unvouched']);
    expect(collectLaneCounts(l)).toEqual({ wouldCollect: 0, held: 2, boxLines: 2 });
  });

  it('an id failing the id predicate is not counted', () => {
    expect(collectLaneCounts(lane({ '-demo': view({ wouldCollect: true }), '.demo': holdOf('run-absent'),
      'demo-a': view({ wouldCollect: true }) }))).toEqual({ wouldCollect: 1, held: 0, boxLines: 0 });
  });

  it('a terminal item is never counted, even when ccd’s word is spelled like this build’s', () => {
    const l = lane({
      'demo-a': view({ terminal: runOf('terminal', 'would-collect', 1, true), wouldCollect: true }),
      'demo-b': view({ terminal: runOf('terminal', 'held', 1, true), hold: { why: 'run-open', since: 0 } }),
    });
    expect(collectAttentionItems({ ...l, nowMono: 0 }).perId.map((a) => a.word), 'CONTROL: the items carry ccd’s words')
      .toEqual(['would-collect', 'held']);
    expect(collectLaneCounts(l)).toEqual({ wouldCollect: 0, held: 0, boxLines: 0 });
  });

  it('parity with the published items over a table of lane states', () => {
    const seen = { wouldCollect: 0, held: 0, boxLines: 0 };
    for (const [what, l] of STATES) {
      const items = collectAttentionItems({ ...l, nowMono: 0 });
      const counts = collectLaneCounts(l);
      expect(counts, what).toEqual({
        wouldCollect: items.perId.filter((a) => a.word === 'would-collect').length,
        held: items.perId.filter((a) => a.word === 'held').length + unvouchedOf(items.box),
        boxLines: items.box.filter((a) => a.word !== 'unvouched').length,
      });
      seen.wouldCollect += counts.wouldCollect;
      seen.held += counts.held;
      seen.boxLines += counts.boxLines;
    }
    for (const [k, n] of Object.entries(seen)) expect(n, `CONTROL: the table exercises ${k}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});
```
