```ts
// ── the Settings switch: resolver, latch, bodies, counts (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.4, §5.5, §5.7) ────
//
// What arms the collector's deletion, decided PURELY from measured inputs: the registry listing, the connection epoch
// around it, both capabilities, the control state (`collectLaneControl`, above) and the current connection's node.
// Nothing here reads a file, a row, a clock or the link. `collectLaneEffective` is called by the executor
// (`coord/collectTempRoot.ts`), nearest the argv, and by the view (`collectLaneView`), and by nothing else.

/** The registry listing as the executor reads it (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). `marker` is the MEASURED
 *  presence of `COLLECT_LANE_LIVE_MARKER`. An unlistable registry carries NO marker field: a listing that failed proves
 *  no absence, and a proved absence is what retires the latch. */
export type CollectLaneSwitches =
  | { readonly paused: false; readonly marker: boolean }
  | { readonly paused: true; readonly why: 'raised'; readonly marker: boolean }
  | { readonly paused: true; readonly why: 'unlistable' };
/** The connection epoch around a listing (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.5). In the executor, `before` is the
 *  epoch the job was queued under and `after` the epoch read after the final listing; in the pass, the pass-head epoch
 *  and the epoch after the gather. Epochs only rise, so `before === after` is "no connection came or went". */
export interface CollectEpochPair { readonly before: number; readonly after: number }
/** Both capabilities, as the executor or the route measured them: the collector's own and the cleanup pause's. This
 *  file spells neither token. */
export interface CollectLaneCaps { readonly collect: boolean; readonly reclaimPause: boolean }
/** The current connection's fleet node, declared by this consumer (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). The identity
 *  cell's `CurrentFleetIdentity` satisfies it structurally. Only `known` carries a node id, and only a `known` measured
 *  on the epoch the listing ended under can arm Settings. */
export type CollectCurrentNode =
  | { readonly kind: 'known'; readonly connectionEpoch: number; readonly nodeId: string; readonly measuredAt: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'unmeasured'; readonly connectionEpoch: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'collision'; readonly connectionEpoch: number };
/** Everything the resolver reads, each MEASURED by its caller after the listing's await. */
export interface CollectLaneInputs {
  readonly switches: CollectLaneSwitches; readonly epoch: CollectEpochPair; readonly caps: CollectLaneCaps;
  readonly control: CollectLaneControl; readonly node: CollectCurrentNode;
}
/** Why the lane STOPPED: a measurement failed or a pause stands. No flip, no feed row, and a lane-wide clear. */
export type CollectLaneStopWhy = 'raised' | 'unlistable' | 'epoch-changed' | 'unknown-fleet';
/** Why the control state cannot be proved coherent. A flip candidate whose boolean is false. */
export type CollectLaneSafetyWhy = CollectLaneUnmeasurable | 'generation-mismatch';
/** Beside a settled arm: `latchDue` is `collectLatchDue`'s answer for the same listing; `markerRecreated` says the
 *  marker stands after its latch was set, which is reported and ignored (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.4). */
export interface CollectLaneNotes { readonly latchDue: boolean; readonly markerRecreated: boolean }
/** Figure 5's answer (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). `live` is the ONLY arm under which `ws-collect` may be
 *  composed. */
export type CollectLaneEffective =
  | { readonly kind: 'stopped'; readonly why: CollectLaneStopWhy }
  | { readonly kind: 'not-running' }
  | { readonly kind: 'safety-stopped'; readonly why: CollectLaneSafetyWhy }
  | { readonly kind: 'live'; readonly armedBy: Exclude<CollectArmedBy, 'neither'>; readonly notes: CollectLaneNotes }
  | { readonly kind: 'shadowed'; readonly why: 'off' | 'future-choice' | 'other-node'; readonly notes: CollectLaneNotes };
/** The arms a transition can name: a flip candidate is never `stopped` or `not-running`. */
export type CollectLaneSettled = Extract<CollectLaneEffective, { kind: 'live' | 'shadowed' | 'safety-stopped' }>;
type CollectLaneShadowWhy = Extract<CollectLaneEffective, { kind: 'shadowed' }>['why'];

/** The lane flips on this boolean alone, never on the source (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.5): a handoff from the
 *  marker to Settings that stays live is no flip. */
export const collectLaneLive = (r: CollectLaneSettled): boolean => r.kind === 'live';

/** THE latch predicate, its one definer (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.4): a listing that is unpaused, listed, on one
 *  epoch and proves the marker ABSENT, over a COHERENT control state whose latch is still null. It reads none of the
 *  arming inputs, so a stored Live on an unknown node still retires a removed marker. It never heals: a mismatch or an
 *  unmeasurable state is never due. */
export function collectLatchDue(switches: CollectLaneSwitches, epoch: CollectEpochPair, control: CollectLaneControl): boolean {
  return !switches.paused && !switches.marker && epoch.before === epoch.after
    && control.kind === 'coherent' && control.row.markerRetiredAt === null;
}

/** Figure 5 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.5), in this precedence:
 *  1. a raised pause, then an unlistable registry: stopped;
 *  2. an epoch that moved around the listing: stopped;
 *  3. either capability missing: not running;
 *  4. control state unmeasurable or incoherent: safety-stopped. This suppresses the marker too;
 *  5. the marker arm (it stands, latch unset), the Settings arm (exact `live`, for the node measured on this epoch), or
 *     both;
 *  6. a stored `live` with no node measured on this epoch: stopped, `unknown-fleet`, never shadowed, so a reconnect
 *     writes no flip row;
 *  7. otherwise shadowed: `off`, a choice this build does not know (`future-choice`), or Live for another node.
 *  A choice outside `off`/`live` is readable and ineffective (`isCollectLaneChoice`, never `in`). Total and pure. */
export function collectLaneEffective(i: CollectLaneInputs): CollectLaneEffective {
  const s = i.switches;
  if (s.paused) return { kind: 'stopped', why: s.why };
  if (i.epoch.before !== i.epoch.after) return { kind: 'stopped', why: 'epoch-changed' };
  if (!i.caps.collect || !i.caps.reclaimPause) return { kind: 'not-running' };
  const c = i.control;
  if (c.kind === 'unmeasurable') return { kind: 'safety-stopped', why: c.why };
  if (c.kind === 'mismatch') return { kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'generation-mismatch' };
  const notes: CollectLaneNotes = {
    latchDue: collectLatchDue(s, i.epoch, c),
    markerRecreated: s.marker && c.row.markerRetiredAt !== null,
  };
  const markerArms = s.marker && c.row.markerRetiredAt === null;
  const choice = isCollectLaneChoice(c.row.choice) ? c.row.choice : null;
  const n = i.node;
  const nodeNow = n.kind === 'known' && n.connectionEpoch === i.epoch.after ? n.nodeId : null;
  const settingsArms = choice === 'live' && nodeNow !== null && c.row.fleetNodeId === nodeNow;
  if (markerArms && settingsArms) return { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'both', notes };
  if (markerArms) return { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'legacy-marker', notes };
  if (settingsArms) return { kind: 'live', armedBy: 'settings', notes };
  if (choice === 'live' && nodeNow === null) return { kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' };
  const why: CollectLaneShadowWhy = choice === null ? 'future-choice' : choice === 'off' ? 'off' : 'other-node';
  return { kind: 'shadowed', why, notes };
}

/** What armed the lane, in the transition row's words (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.5, §5.7). Total. */
const COLLECT_ARMED_BY_SAID: Readonly<Record<Exclude<CollectArmedBy, 'neither'>, string>> = {
  'legacy-marker': "the fleet box's legacy file",
  settings: 'Settings',
  both: "both Settings and the fleet box's legacy file",
};
/** Why neither arms it. Total; a future token is never quoted here. */
const COLLECT_SHADOWED_SAID: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneShadowWhy, string>> = {
  off: 'Settings is off',
  'future-choice': 'Settings holds a choice this build does not know',
  'other-node': 'Settings is live for another fleet node',
};
/** Why the control state cannot be proved coherent, bounded. Total; no detail, path or file name. */
const COLLECT_SAFETY_SAID: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneSafetyWhy, string>> = {
  'row-absent': 'its database row is missing',
  'row-unreadable': 'its database row could not be read',
  'row-malformed': 'its database row holds a value this build cannot read',
  'journal-missing': 'its monotonic journal is missing, though its database row is no longer the untouched seed',
  'journal-malformed': 'its monotonic journal is malformed',
  'journal-unreadable': 'its monotonic journal could not be read',
  'journal-not-regular': 'its monotonic journal is not a regular file',
  'journal-not-configured': 'this server was started with no monotonic journal',
  'generation-mismatch': 'its database and its monotonic journal disagree',
};

/** One row per flip of the effective boolean (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.5). It names the measured source, or
 *  that neither arms the lane and why, or the bounded safety-stop reason, each from a total table. It never carries a
 *  detail, a path, a stored token or the journal's file name. It keeps wave 9's prefixes, `the collector lane is now
 *  live` and `the collector lane is now shadowed`. */
export function collectSwitchFeedBody(r: CollectLaneSettled): string {
  switch (r.kind) {
    case 'live':
      return `the collector lane is now live, armed by ${COLLECT_ARMED_BY_SAID[r.armedBy]}: the temp-root collector `
        + 'removes an orphaned temp root it has proved idle twice, with no person in the loop, while cleanup is not paused.';
    case 'shadowed':
      return "the collector lane is now shadowed: neither Settings nor the fleet box's legacy file arms it "
        + `(${COLLECT_SHADOWED_SAID[r.why]}), so the temp-root collector audits and reports what it would collect, and `
        + 'removes nothing.';
    case 'safety-stopped':
      return `the collector lane is now safety-stopped: ${COLLECT_SAFETY_SAID[r.why]}, so the temp-root collector `
        + 'removes nothing until its control state is proved coherent.';
    default: { const unnamed: never = r; return unnamed; }
  }
}

/** The latch row's sentence (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.4), as ruled. */
const COLLECT_LATCH_SAID = "the fleet box's legacy file was retired: Settings alone controls the collector now";
/** The latch row's body: the ruled sentence, then `; by <actor>`, as every coordination row names who acted. The
 *  executor passes its own sweep actor. */
export function collectLatchFeedBody(actor: string): string {
  return `${COLLECT_LATCH_SAID}; by ${actor}`;
}
/** The title of a row that records a CHANGE to the switch's stored state: an accepted POST, and the latch
 *  (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.5). Never the flip row's `COLLECT_FEED_TITLE.switch`. */
export const COLLECT_SETTING_FEED_TITLE = 'temp root collector setting changed';

/** The view's counts (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.7). */
export interface CollectLaneCounts { readonly wouldCollect: number; readonly held: number; readonly boxLines: number }
const COLLECT_WOULD_COLLECT_WORD = 'would-collect' satisfies CollectItemWord;
const COLLECT_HELD_WORD = 'held' satisfies CollectItemWord;
/** Is this item the terminal branch's? Its `word` is ccd's own, so a ccd word spelled like one of this build's is never
 *  that word. The branch is told apart by its collapsed clause, which only it returns. */
const collectItemTerminal = (t: CollectItemText): boolean => t.many === COLLECT_TERMINAL_MANY;

/** The would-collect and held counts the Settings view shows (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.7). The PWA counts
 *  nothing, so the server counts, by the items' OWN precedence (`collectItemOf`), never by a second ladder:
 *  - `wouldCollect`: ids whose item is shadow's would-collect;
 *  - `held`: ids whose item is a per-id hold, plus the unvouched holds that join one box line instead of an item;
 *  - `boxLines`: the box-wide lines standing, the unvouched line excluded (its ids are in `held`).
 *  An id the temp-root id predicate refuses is never counted, as it is never listed, and neither is a terminal item.
 *  Pure. */
export function collectLaneCounts(i: {
  readonly entries: ReadonlyMap<string, CollectAttentionView>;
  readonly box: CollectBoxFacts;
}): CollectLaneCounts {
  const recordsSubsumed = collectRecordsInDoubt(i.box.unmeasured);
  let wouldCollect = 0;
  let held = 0;
  for (const [id, v] of i.entries) {
    if (!isTmpRootId(id)) continue;
    const t = collectItemOf(id, v, recordsSubsumed);
    if (t === 'unvouched') { held += 1; continue; }
    if (t === null || collectItemTerminal(t)) continue;
    if (t.word === COLLECT_WOULD_COLLECT_WORD) wouldCollect += 1;
    else if (t.word === COLLECT_HELD_WORD) held += 1;
  }
  return { wouldCollect, held, boxLines: collectBoxItems(i.box, []).length };
}
```

### Task 4: L1, the route's decisions: body, confirm key, POST decision, change body, write proof and the view

**Model routing:** `opus`, effort `high`. This task writes the confirm key over every safety fact, and the POST's order of answers from the 503 down. Review Focus 4 ("Live is armed without a signed-in operator's fresh confirm of the current facts") rests on these pure functions. Task 9 only reads, awaits, maps a decision to a status and calls the store.

**Why:**
- **R10 and R25: the key.** FNV-1a 32 over the canonical (recursively key-sorted) JSON of `CollectLaneKeyFacts`, written as 8 lowercase hex, with no `node:crypto`. The key binds the boot nonce, the epoch after the listing, the node, the expected row (choice, fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt, generation), the journal maximum (`'missing'` for the bootstrap), the marker, both capabilities and the pause. The wire `facts` carry neither the nonce nor the epoch, and the counts are shown but never keyed.
- **R11 and R24: the POST decision.**
  - A row and journal that cannot be measured answer `unmeasurable` for both choices, before any 409.
  - Off never reads the listing. A null latch answers `marker`; a set latch writes, even when the registry is unlistable or the epoch moved.
  - Live answers `unmeasurable` for an unlistable registry, an epoch that moved during the await, or a node that is unmeasured, in collision, or measured on an earlier connection. Otherwise it answers `confirm-required` with no key, `confirm-stale` with a wrong key (fresh facts and a fresh key in both), and writes with the right key. A no-op Live still needs the key, because the store finds the no-op.
- **The change body** reads a repair from `journalBefore`, so a behind journal (row 5, journal 4, written at 6) still says "repairing". A future token is quoted and bounded through `childReclaimDetailText`, and no path appears.
- **The write proof** takes `generation: number | null`. A null generation means the store answered `unchanged`. The proof is then a coherent re-read showing the requested choice and node at the expected row's generation; for Off, which carries no expectation, it is a coherent re-read showing `off` with no node.
- **R27, R34 and R38: the view.** `collectLaneView` is the only caller of `collectLaneEffective` outside the executor. Its input type admits no absent row. Malformed and unreadable are never folded. `notice` passes through. The remedy is bounded and may name the marker file, through this file's own constant.
- **Rings.** This task adds no import statement: three type specifiers join the one `../../shared/api.js` statement. There is no `node:` import, no `**`, and no clock. It spells no capability token, no journal basename and no marker literal. Nothing here is under `server/src/coord/`, so the kebab scan is untouched.

```ts
// Child reclamation wave 10 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.6): the collector switch's route decisions, pure. The
// body is refused, never clamped; the confirm key binds every safety fact and is FNV-1a over canonical JSON; the POST
// decision answers in the route's order from the 503 down; the feed body reads a repair from the journal read before
// the write; and a 200 is proved by a coherent re-read. No marker name, journal file name or capability token is
// spelled here.
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import {
  COLLECT_LANE_APPLIES_TEXT, collectConfirmKey, collectLaneSettingChange, collectLaneWriteProved,
  decideCollectLaneBody, decideCollectLanePost,
  type CollectCurrentNode, type CollectLaneJournalRead, type CollectLaneKeyFacts, type CollectLaneRowRaw,
  type CollectLaneRowRead, type CollectLaneWriteRequest, type CollectPostDecision, type CollectPostInput,
} from '../src/collectLane.js';
import type { CollectLaneConfirmRequired } from '../../shared/api.js';

const NODE = 'node-a';
const OTHER = 'node-b';
const BOOT = 'boot-a';
const MEASURED_AT = 1_760_000_000_000;
/** The migration's exact seed, as the store reads it: bigints. */
const SEED_RAW: CollectLaneRowRaw = { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 0n, updatedAt: 0n };
const row = (o: Partial<CollectLaneRowRaw> = {}): CollectLaneRowRead => ({ kind: 'row', row: { ...SEED_RAW, ...o } });
const SEED = row();
const MISSING: CollectLaneJournalRead = { kind: 'missing' };
const ok = (max: number): CollectLaneJournalRead => ({ kind: 'ok', max, records: max });
const liveRow = (generation: number, nodeId: string = NODE, latch: bigint | null = null): CollectLaneRowRead =>
  row({ choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: nodeId, markerRetiredAt: latch, generation: BigInt(generation), updatedAt: 5n });
const offRow = (generation: number, latch: bigint | null): CollectLaneRowRead =>
  row({ choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: latch, generation: BigInt(generation), updatedAt: 5n });
const known = (connectionEpoch: number = 3, nodeId: string = NODE): CollectCurrentNode =>
  ({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch, nodeId, measuredAt: MEASURED_AT });
const CAPS = { collect: true, reclaimPause: true };
const input = (o: Partial<CollectPostInput> = {}): CollectPostInput => ({
  request: { choice: 'live' }, row: SEED, journal: MISSING, switches: { paused: false, marker: false },
  epoch: { before: 3, after: 3 }, node: known(), caps: CAPS, boot: BOOT, counts: null, ...o,
});
const confirmOf = (d: CollectPostDecision): CollectLaneConfirmRequired => {
  if (d.kind !== 'confirm') throw new Error(`expected a confirm decision, got ${d.kind}`);
  return d.body;
};

describe('the body (path-identity spec §5.6)', () => {
  it('an unknown key is refused, naming it', () => {

    expect(r.ok).toBe(false);
    if (!r.ok) expect(r.detail).toContain('unknown key extra');
    const proto = decideCollectLaneBody(JSON.parse('{"choice":"off","__proto__":{"x":1}}'));
    expect(proto.ok, 'an own __proto__ key is a key like any other').toBe(false);
    if (!proto.ok) expect(proto.detail).toContain('unknown key __proto__');
  });

  it('a non-object is refused', () => {
    for (const body of [null, undefined, [], ['live'], 'live', 7, true]) {

    }

    for (const body of [{ choice: 'LIVE' }, { choice: 'toString' }, { choice: 'shadowed' }, { choice: ' live' }, { choice: 1 }, {}]) {
      expect(decideCollectLaneBody(body), JSON.stringify(body)).toEqual({ ok: false, detail: 'choice must be off or live' });
    }
  });

  it('confirm must be 8 lowercase hex', () => {
    for (const confirm of [7, 'XYZ', 'ABCDEF12', 'abcdef123', 'abcdef1', '', null]) {
      const r = decideCollectLaneBody({ choice: 'live', confirm });

      if (!r.ok) expect(r.detail, String(confirm)).toMatch(/^confirm /);

describe('the confirm key binds every safety fact (§5.6, R10)', () => {
  /** Written in a non-sorted order on purpose: JSON.stringify of it is NOT the canonical text. */
  const FACTS: CollectLaneKeyFacts = {
    boot: BOOT, epoch: 3, node: NODE,
    row: { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 0 },
    journal: 'missing', marker: 'absent', caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true }, paused: false,

  const CANONICAL = '{"boot":"boot-a","caps":{"collect":true,"reclaimPause":true},"epoch":3,"journal":"missing",'

    + '"markerRetiredAt":null}}';
  /** A reference FNV-1a, 32-bit, over UTF-16 code units, in bigint arithmetic, so it shares no step with the shipped one. */
  const fnvRef = (s: string): string => {
    let h = 2166136261n;
    for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = ((h ^ BigInt(s.charCodeAt(i))) * 16777619n) % 4294967296n;
    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');

    ['markerRetiredAt', { ...FACTS, row: { ...FACTS.row, markerRetiredAt: 9 } }],
    ['generation', { ...FACTS, row: { ...FACTS.row, generation: 1 } }],
    ['journal', { ...FACTS, journal: 0 }],
    ['journal maximum', { ...FACTS, journal: 1 }],
    ['marker', { ...FACTS, marker: 'stands' }],
    ['collect cap', { ...FACTS, caps: { ...FACTS.caps, collect: false } }],
    ['reclaim-pause cap', { ...FACTS, caps: { ...FACTS.caps, reclaimPause: false } }],
    ['pause', { ...FACTS, paused: true }],
  ];

  it('CONTROL: the reference hash answers the published FNV-1a vectors', () => {
    expect([fnvRef(''), fnvRef('a'), fnvRef('foobar')]).toEqual(['811c9dc5', 'e40c292c', 'bf9cf968']);
  });

  it('8 lowercase hex', () => {
    expect(collectConfirmKey(FACTS)).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{8}$/);
    for (const [fact, f] of ONE_FACT) expect(collectConfirmKey(f), fact).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{8}$/);
  });

  it.each(ONE_FACT)('it changes when each fact changes alone: %s', (_fact, changed) => {
    expect(collectConfirmKey(changed)).not.toBe(collectConfirmKey(FACTS));
  });

  it('stable under key-order permutation', () => {
    const permuted: CollectLaneKeyFacts = {
      paused: false, caps: { reclaimPause: true, collect: true }, marker: 'absent', journal: 'missing',
      row: { generation: 0, markerRetiredAt: null, fleetNodeId: null, choice: 'off' }, node: NODE, epoch: 3, boot: BOOT,
    };
    expect(JSON.stringify(permuted), 'CONTROL: the two objects serialise differently as written').not.toBe(JSON.stringify(FACTS));
    expect(collectConfirmKey(permuted)).toBe(collectConfirmKey(FACTS));
  });

  it('equals an independent FNV-1a over the canonical JSON', () => {
    expect(JSON.stringify(FACTS), 'CONTROL: FACTS as written is not canonical').not.toBe(CANONICAL);
    expect(collectConfirmKey(FACTS)).toBe(fnvRef(CANONICAL));
  });
});

describe('the POST decision follows R11 and R24', () => {
  const LISTINGS: [string, Partial<CollectPostInput>][] = [
    ['listed, the marker absent', { switches: { paused: false, marker: false } }],
    ['listed, the marker standing', { switches: { paused: false, marker: true } }],
    ['paused, the marker standing', { switches: { paused: true, why: 'raised', marker: true } }],
    ['an unlistable registry', { switches: { paused: true, why: 'unlistable' } }],
    ['an epoch moved during the listing', { epoch: { before: 3, after: 4 }, node: known(4) }],
    ['a node not measured', { node: { kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 3 } }],
  ];

  it('control unmeasurable is unmeasurable for both choices', () => {
    const bad: [string, Partial<CollectPostInput>][] = [
      ['a malformed row', { row: row({ generation: '0' }) }],
      ['an unreadable row', { row: { kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'database is locked' } }],
      ['an absent row', { row: { kind: 'absent' } }],
      ['a malformed journal', { journal: { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'json', record: 1 } }],
      ['an unreadable journal', { journal: { kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EACCES' } }],
      ['a journal that is not a regular file', { journal: { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'symlink' } }],
      ['a missing journal beside a used row', { row: offRow(1, null) }],
    ];
    for (const [name, o] of bad) {
      for (const choice of ['off', 'live'] as const) {
        const d = decideCollectLanePost(input({ ...o, request: { choice } }));
        expect(d.kind, `${name}, ${choice}`).toBe('unmeasurable');
        if (d.kind === 'unmeasurable') expect(d.detail, name).not.toMatch(/\/|EACCES|database is locked/);
      }
    }
  });

  it('Off with the latch null is marker, whatever the listing', () => {
    const states: [string, Partial<CollectPostInput>][] = [
      ['the seed', {}],
      ['a coherent Live', { row: liveRow(1), journal: ok(1) }],
      ['a mismatch', { row: liveRow(4), journal: ok(5) }],
    ];
    for (const [s, state] of states) {
      for (const [l, listing] of LISTINGS) {
        expect(decideCollectLanePost(input({ ...state, ...listing, request: { choice: 'off' } })), `${s}; ${l}`)
          .toEqual({ kind: 'marker' });
      }
    }
  });

  it('Off with the latch set writes, even unlistable or epoch-moved', () => {
    const states: [string, Partial<CollectPostInput>][] = [
      ['a coherent Live, latched', { row: liveRow(2, NODE, 9n), journal: ok(2) }],
      ['a coherent Off, latched', { row: offRow(2, 9n), journal: ok(2) }],
      ['a latched journal ahead', { row: liveRow(4, NODE, 9n), journal: ok(5) }],
      ['a latched journal behind', { row: offRow(5, 9n), journal: ok(4) }],
    ];
    for (const [s, state] of states) {
      for (const [l, listing] of LISTINGS) {
        expect(decideCollectLanePost(input({ ...state, ...listing, request: { choice: 'off' } })), `${s}; ${l}`)
          .toEqual({ kind: 'write', request: { kind: 'off' } });
      }
    }
  });

  it('Live is unmeasurable on an unlistable listing, an epoch moved during the await, or a node unmeasured or in collision', () => {
    const cases: [string, Partial<CollectPostInput>][] = [
      ['an unlistable registry', { switches: { paused: true, why: 'unlistable' } }],
      ['an epoch moved during the listing', { epoch: { before: 3, after: 4 }, node: known(4) }],
      ['a node not measured yet', { node: { kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 3 } }],
      ['a node id in collision', { node: { kind: 'collision', connectionEpoch: 3 } }],
      ['a node measured on an earlier connection', { node: known(2) }],
    ];
    for (const [name, o] of cases) {
      for (const confirm of [undefined, '0123abcd']) {
        const request = confirm === undefined ? { choice: 'live' as const } : { choice: 'live' as const, confirm };
        const d = decideCollectLanePost(input({ ...o, request }));
        expect(d.kind, `${name}, confirm ${String(confirm)}`).toBe('unmeasurable');
        if (d.kind === 'unmeasurable') expect(d.detail, name).not.toMatch(/\//);
      }
    }
  });

  it('Live without a key is confirm-required, with the sheet\'s facts and the key', () => {
    const body = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input()));
    expect(body.ok).toBe(false);
    expect(body.error).toBe('confirm-required');
    expect(body.facts).toEqual({
      node: { nodeId: NODE, measuredAt: MEASURED_AT }, caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true },
      paused: false, marker: 'absent', repair: null, attention: null,
    });
    expect(body.confirmKey, 'the key over the facts this input measured: the seed, a missing journal, epoch 3').toBe(collectConfirmKey({
      boot: BOOT, epoch: 3, node: NODE, row: { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 0 },
      journal: 'missing', marker: 'absent', caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true }, paused: false,
    }));
    const wide = input({
      row: liveRow(4, OTHER), journal: ok(5), switches: { paused: true, why: 'raised', marker: true },
      caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: true }, epoch: { before: 7, after: 7 }, node: known(7),
    });
    expect(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(wide)).confirmKey,
      'the row generation, the journal maximum, the epoch after the listing, the marker, the caps and the pause').toBe(collectConfirmKey({
      boot: BOOT, epoch: 7, node: NODE, row: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: OTHER, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 4 },
      journal: 5, marker: 'stands', caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: true }, paused: true,
    }));
    const coherent = input({ row: liveRow(2, OTHER), journal: ok(2) });
    expect(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(coherent)).confirmKey, 'a used, coherent journal keys its maximum').toBe(collectConfirmKey({
      boot: BOOT, epoch: 3, node: NODE, row: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: OTHER, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 2 },
      journal: 2, marker: 'absent', caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true }, paused: false,
    }));
    const latched = input({ row: liveRow(2, OTHER, 9n), journal: ok(2) });
    expect(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(latched)).confirmKey, 'a set latch is keyed').toBe(collectConfirmKey({
      boot: BOOT, epoch: 3, node: NODE, row: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: OTHER, markerRetiredAt: 9, generation: 2 },
      journal: 2, marker: 'absent', caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true }, paused: false,
    }));
    const counted = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input({ counts: { wouldCollect: 2, held: 1, boxLines: 3 } })));
    expect(counted.facts.attention).toEqual({ wouldCollect: 2, held: 1, boxLines: 3 });
    expect(counted.confirmKey, 'the counts are shown on the sheet and never keyed').toBe(body.confirmKey);
  });

  it('Live with a wrong key is confirm-stale, with fresh facts and key', () => {
    const first = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input()));
    const moved = input({ switches: { paused: false, marker: true }, request: { choice: 'live', confirm: first.confirmKey } });
    const stale = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(moved));
    expect(stale.error).toBe('confirm-stale');
    expect(stale.facts.marker, 'the fresh facts').toBe('stands');
    expect(stale.confirmKey).not.toBe(first.confirmKey);
    expect(stale.confirmKey, 'the fresh key').toBe(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost({ ...moved, request: { choice: 'live' } })).confirmKey);
    expect(decideCollectLanePost({ ...moved, request: { choice: 'live', confirm: stale.confirmKey } }).kind, 'the fresh key writes')
      .toBe('write');
  });

  it('Live with the right key writes, carrying the expected row and journal', () => {
    const before = input({ row: liveRow(1, OTHER), journal: ok(1) });
    const key = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(before)).confirmKey;
    const confirmed: CollectPostInput = { ...before, request: { choice: 'live', confirm: key } };
    const d = decideCollectLanePost(confirmed);
    expect(d).toEqual({
      kind: 'write', request: { kind: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, expected: confirmed.row, expectedJournal: confirmed.journal },
    });
    if (d.kind !== 'write' || d.request.kind !== 'live') throw new Error('expected a live write');
    expect(d.request.expected, 'the read itself, never a copy').toBe(confirmed.row);
    expect(d.request.expectedJournal).toBe(confirmed.journal);
  });

  it('Live is confirmable with a capability missing or the pause standing', () => {
    const variants: Partial<CollectPostInput>[] = [
      { caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: true } },
      { caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: false } },
      { switches: { paused: true, why: 'raised', marker: false } },
    ];
    for (const o of variants) {
      const asked = input(o);
      const b = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(asked));
      expect(b.facts.caps).toEqual(asked.caps);
      expect(b.facts.paused).toBe(asked.switches.paused);
      expect(decideCollectLanePost({ ...asked, request: { choice: 'live', confirm: b.confirmKey } }).kind).toBe('write');
    }
  });

  it('a mismatch shows as the repair fact', () => {
    expect(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input({ row: liveRow(4, OTHER), journal: ok(5) }))).facts.repair).toBe('journal-ahead');
    expect(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input({ row: liveRow(5, OTHER), journal: ok(4) }))).facts.repair).toBe('journal-behind');
    expect(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input({ row: liveRow(4, OTHER), journal: ok(4) }))).facts.repair).toBeNull();
    expect(confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input())).facts.repair, 'the bootstrap is coherent').toBeNull();
  });

  it('a no-op Live still needs the key', () => {
    const same = input({ row: liveRow(1), journal: ok(1) });
    const asked = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(same));
    expect(asked.error).toBe('confirm-required');
    expect(decideCollectLanePost({ ...same, request: { choice: 'live', confirm: asked.confirmKey } }).kind,
      'the store, not the decision, finds the no-op').toBe('write');
  });

  it('the wire facts carry neither the boot nonce nor the epoch', () => {
    const b = confirmOf(decideCollectLanePost(input({ epoch: { before: 4242, after: 4242 }, node: known(4242) })));
    expect(Object.keys(b.facts).sort()).toEqual(['attention', 'caps', 'marker', 'node', 'paused', 'repair']);
    expect(Object.keys(b.facts.node).sort()).toEqual(['measuredAt', 'nodeId']);
    const wire = JSON.stringify(b.facts);
    expect(wire).not.toContain(BOOT);
    expect(wire).not.toContain('4242');
  });
});

describe('the change body and the write proof', () => {
  const REPAIRING = ', repairing a journal that disagreed with the database';

  it('the change names before and after, the node for Live, the generation and a repair; no path', () => {
    const bodies = [
      collectLaneSettingChange(SEED, liveRow(1), MISSING),
      collectLaneSettingChange(liveRow(1), offRow(2, null), ok(1)),
      collectLaneSettingChange(offRow(4, null), liveRow(6), ok(5)),
      collectLaneSettingChange(offRow(2, null), offRow(3, 9n), ok(2)),
    ];
    expect(bodies[0]).toBe('choice off → live for fleet node node-a (generation 1)');
    expect(bodies[1]).toBe('choice live for fleet node node-a → off (generation 2)');
    expect(bodies[2], 'a journal ahead').toBe(`choice off → live for fleet node node-a (generation 6)${REPAIRING}`);
    expect(bodies[3], 'a retirement, which the POST never writes, still reads true')
      .toBe("choice off → off (generation 3), retiring the fleet box's legacy file");
    for (const b of bodies) expect(b).not.toMatch(/\//);
  });

  it('a behind-journal repair (row 5, journal 4, written at 6) still says repairing', () => {
    expect(collectLaneSettingChange(offRow(5, 9n), offRow(6, 9n), ok(4))).toBe(`choice off → off (generation 6)${REPAIRING}`);
    expect(collectLaneSettingChange(liveRow(5, OTHER), liveRow(6), ok(4)))
      .toBe(`choice live for fleet node node-b → live for fleet node node-a (generation 6)${REPAIRING}`);
  });

  it('a future stored token is quoted and bounded', () => {
    const was = (choice: string): CollectLaneRowRead => row({ choice, generation: 1n, updatedAt: 1n });
    expect(collectLaneSettingChange(was('L'.repeat(200)), liveRow(2), ok(1)))
      .toBe(`choice the unknown token "${'L'.repeat(32)}…" → live for fleet node node-a (generation 2)`);
    const bel = String.fromCharCode(7);
    expect(collectLaneSettingChange(was(`a${bel}b`), liveRow(2), ok(1)))
      .toBe('choice the unknown token "a b" → live for fleet node node-a (generation 2)');
    expect(collectLaneSettingChange(was('LIVE'), liveRow(2), ok(1)))
      .toBe('choice the unknown token "LIVE" → live for fleet node node-a (generation 2)');
  });

  it('the proof holds only for a coherent re-read at the written generation and target', () => {
    const live: CollectLaneWriteRequest = { kind: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, expected: SEED, expectedJournal: MISSING };
    const off: CollectLaneWriteRequest = { kind: 'off' };
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(live, 1, liveRow(1), ok(1))).toBe(true);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(live, 1, liveRow(1), ok(2)), 'a mismatch').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(live, 1, liveRow(1), MISSING), 'a missing journal beside a used row').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(live, 1, liveRow(1, OTHER), ok(1)), 'another node').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(live, 1, offRow(1, null), ok(1)), 'another choice').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(live, 1, liveRow(2), ok(2)), 'another generation').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(live, 1, { kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'database is locked' }, ok(1)), 'an unreadable re-read').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(off, 2, offRow(2, 9n), ok(2))).toBe(true);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(off, 2, row({ fleetNodeId: NODE, markerRetiredAt: 9n, generation: 2n, updatedAt: 5n }), ok(2)),
      'Off keeps no node').toBe(false);
  });

  it('a no-op proof (generation null) holds only for a coherent re-read at the unchanged generation showing the requested choice and node', () => {
    const same: CollectLaneWriteRequest = { kind: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE, expected: liveRow(1), expectedJournal: ok(1) };
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(same, null, liveRow(1), ok(1))).toBe(true);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(same, null, liveRow(2), ok(2)), 'the generation moved').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(same, null, liveRow(1), ok(2)), 'a mismatch').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(same, null, liveRow(1, OTHER), ok(1)), 'another node').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(same, null, offRow(1, null), ok(1)), 'another choice').toBe(false);
    const off: CollectLaneWriteRequest = { kind: 'off' };
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(off, null, SEED, MISSING)).toBe(true);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(off, null, liveRow(1), ok(1)), 'not off').toBe(false);
    expect(collectLaneWriteProved(off, null, offRow(1, null), ok(2)), 'a mismatch').toBe(false);
  });

  it('the 200 notice says when the choice applies, and what it cannot stop', () => {
    expect(COLLECT_LANE_APPLIES_TEXT)
      .toBe("The choice applies from the collector's next check; a removal already handed to ccd is not stopped.");
  });
});
```

```ts
      .toEqual({ state: 'collision', stored: 'unread' });
    expect(view({ node: known(2) }).node, 'a node measured on an earlier connection is not this connection\'s')
      .toEqual({ state: 'unmeasured', stored: 'none' });
  });

  const REMEDIED: [string, Partial<CollectLaneViewInput>][] = [
    ['an unreadable row', { row: { kind: 'unreadable', detail: 'fixture-home/.ccrc/coord.db: database is locked' } }],
    ['a malformed row', { row: row({ generation: '0' }) }],
    ['a missing journal beside a used row', { row: row({ generation: 1n, updatedAt: 1n }) }],
    ['a malformed journal', { journal: { kind: 'malformed', fault: 'json', record: 1 } }],
    ['an unreadable journal', { journal: { kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EACCES' } }],
    ['a journal that is not a regular file', { journal: { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'symlink' } }],
    ['a mismatch before the latch', { ...LIVE_HERE, journal: OK2 }],
    ['a mismatch after the latch', { ...LATCHED, journal: OK2 }],
    ['a re-created marker', { ...LATCHED, switches: { paused: false, marker: true } }],
    ['a missing capability', { caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: true } }],
  ];

  it.each(REMEDIED)('the remedy is bounded and names no path but the marker file\'s: %s', (_name, o) => {
    const remedy = view(o).remedy;
    expect(remedy).not.toBeNull();
    expect((remedy ?? '').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect((remedy ?? '').length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(240);
    expect(remedy).not.toMatch(/\/|\.log\b|\.ccrc|coord\.db|EACCES|database is locked/);
  });

  it('only the re-created marker\'s remedy names the marker file, and a healthy lane has none', () => {
    expect(view({ ...LATCHED, switches: { paused: false, marker: true } }).remedy).toContain(COLLECT_LANE_LIVE_MARKER);
    for (const [name, o] of REMEDIED.filter(([n]) => n !== 'a re-created marker')) {
      expect(view(o).remedy, name).not.toContain(COLLECT_LANE_LIVE_MARKER);
    }
    expect(view({ ...LIVE_HERE, journal: OK2 }).remedy, 'Off cannot repair before the latch')
      .not.toBe(view({ ...LATCHED, journal: OK2 }).remedy);
    expect(view().remedy).toBeNull();
    expect(view(LIVE_HERE).remedy).toBeNull();
    expect(view({ switches: { paused: false, marker: true } }).remedy, 'a standing marker before the latch is the Off note\'s to say').toBeNull();
    expect(view({ switches: { paused: true, why: 'raised', marker: false } }).remedy, 'the pause is deliberate').toBeNull();
  });

  it('notice passes through', () => {
    expect(view().notice).toBeNull();
    expect(view({ notice: COLLECT_LANE_APPLIES_TEXT }).notice).toBe(COLLECT_LANE_APPLIES_TEXT);
  });

  it('caps and the counts pass through, and null counts stay null', () => {
    expect(view({ caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: true } }).caps).toEqual({ collect: false, reclaimPause: true });
    expect(view().attention).toBeNull();
    expect(view({ counts: { wouldCollect: 2, held: 1, boxLines: 3 } }).attention).toEqual({ wouldCollect: 2, held: 1, boxLines: 3 });
  });
});
```

```ts
// ── the Settings route's decisions and its view (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.6, §5.7) ─────────────────────────
//
// Everything `GET`/`POST /api/coord/collect-lane` decides, so the route (`coord/routes.ts`, L4) only reads, awaits its
// one registry listing, maps a decision to a status and calls the store's one writer. Pure, like the rest of this file:
// the boot nonce, both epochs, the current node, the capabilities and the counts arrive as arguments. Nothing here
// spells a capability token or the generation journal's file name, and no sentence carries a path.

/** The keys a POST body may name, each a `CollectLaneRequest` field, enumerated once. */
const COLLECT_LANE_REQUEST_KEYS = ['choice', 'confirm'] as const satisfies readonly (keyof CollectLaneRequest)[];
/** A confirm key as `collectConfirmKey` writes it. A `confirm` of any other shape is refused before anything is read. */
const COLLECT_CONFIRM_KEY_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{8}$/;
/** How many code points a sentence quotes of an unknown body key or a stored choice token, and of a node id. */
const COLLECT_LANE_WORD_MAX = 32;
const COLLECT_LANE_NODE_MAX = 64;

/** `text` as one plain bounded line: `childReclaimDetailText` turns every control, format and separator character into
 *  a space and trims the ends, then at most `max` code points are kept, an ellipsis marking a cut. */
function collectBoundedWords(text: string, max: number): string {
  const cps = [...childReclaimDetailText(text)];
  return cps.length <= max ? cps.join('') : `${cps.slice(0, max).join('')}…`;
}

/** The POST body, decided: the request, or a refusal whose detail names what was wrong. Two shapes, never a nullable
 *  request. */
export type CollectLaneBody =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly request: CollectLaneRequest }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly detail: string };

/** Path-identity spec §5.6's 400, decided from the body alone, before anything is read. Refuses, never clamps:
 *  - a body that is not an object;
 *  - an unknown key, named and bounded, so a newer page sending a field this server lacks hears it was not applied;
 *  - a choice `isCollectLaneChoice` refuses (`LIVE`, `toString` and `shadowed` among them), or none;
 *  - a `confirm` that is present and is not eight lowercase hex characters.
 *  An absent `confirm` stays absent: no key is invented. */
export function decideCollectLaneBody(body: unknown): CollectLaneBody {
  if (!isObject(body)) return { ok: false, detail: 'body must be an object' };
  for (const k of Object.keys(body)) {
    if (!(COLLECT_LANE_REQUEST_KEYS as readonly string[]).includes(k)) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        detail: `unknown key ${collectBoundedWords(k, COLLECT_LANE_WORD_MAX)}: a request names only ${COLLECT_LANE_REQUEST_KEYS.join(' and ')}`,
      };
    }
  }
  const choice = body.choice;
  if (!isCollectLaneChoice(choice)) return { ok: false, detail: 'choice must be off or live' };
  if (!hasOwn(body, 'confirm')) return { ok: true, request: { choice } };
  const confirm = body.confirm;
  if (typeof confirm !== 'string' || !COLLECT_CONFIRM_KEY_RE.test(confirm)) {
    return { ok: false, detail: 'confirm must be the eight lowercase hex characters a 409 answered with' };
  }
  return { ok: true, request: { choice, confirm } };
}

/** Every fact a Live confirm stands on (path-identity spec §5.6): the server process (`boot`, a nonce minted once per
 *  process in `index.ts`), the connection epoch after the listing, the directly measured node, the expected row, the
 *  journal maximum (`missing` for the untouched bootstrap), the marker as listed, both capabilities and the pause.
 *  The key's input only: the wire's `facts` carry neither the nonce nor the epoch. */
export interface CollectLaneKeyFacts {
  readonly boot: string; readonly epoch: number; readonly node: string;
  readonly row: { readonly choice: string; readonly fleetNodeId: string | null; readonly markerRetiredAt: number | null; readonly generation: number };
  readonly journal: number | 'missing'; readonly marker: 'stands' | 'absent';
  readonly caps: CollectLaneCaps; readonly paused: boolean;
}

/** The canonical JSON the confirm key hashes: object keys sorted at every depth, arrays in order, every other value as
 *  `JSON.stringify` writes it. Two fact objects holding the same values hash the same, whatever order built them. */
function collectCanonicalJson(v: unknown): string {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return `[${v.map((x) => collectCanonicalJson(x)).join(',')}]`;
  if (isObject(v)) {
    return `{${Object.keys(v).sort().map((k) => `${JSON.stringify(k)}:${collectCanonicalJson(v[k])}`).join(',')}}`;
  }
  return JSON.stringify(v);
}

/** The confirm key (path-identity spec §5.6): eight lowercase hex characters of a 32-bit FNV-1a over the facts'
 *  canonical JSON, over UTF-16 code units in plain JavaScript, so no `node:crypto` (the stall door's hash, over
 *  canonical JSON here). A staleness check, not a credential: the session gate guards the door, and because the boot
 *  nonce is a fact, a key a previous server process answered never matches. */
export function collectConfirmKey(facts: CollectLaneKeyFacts): string {
  const s = collectCanonicalJson(facts);
  let h = 0x811c9dc5;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
    h ^= s.charCodeAt(i);
    h = Math.imul(h, 0x01000193) >>> 0;
  }
  return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

/** What the POST decides over: the parsed request, and the reads the route took AFTER its one listing's await. */
export interface CollectPostInput {
  readonly request: CollectLaneRequest; readonly row: CollectLaneRowRead; readonly journal: CollectLaneJournalRead;
  readonly switches: CollectLaneSwitches; readonly epoch: CollectEpochPair; readonly node: CollectCurrentNode;
  readonly caps: CollectLaneCaps; readonly boot: string; readonly counts: CollectLaneCounts | null;
}
/** The POST's decision; the route maps each kind to one status: 503, 409 `marker-still-controls`, 409 with the confirm
 *  body, or the store's write. */
export type CollectPostDecision =
  | { readonly kind: 'unmeasurable'; readonly detail: string }
  | { readonly kind: 'marker' }
  | { readonly kind: 'confirm'; readonly body: CollectLaneConfirmRequired }
  | { readonly kind: 'write'; readonly request: CollectLaneWriteRequest };

type CollectLaneMeasured = Extract<CollectLaneControl, { kind: 'coherent' | 'mismatch' }>;
/** The journal fact: its maximum, or `missing` for the untouched bootstrap, read off the measured control. */
const collectJournalFact = (c: CollectLaneMeasured): number | 'missing' =>
  c.kind === 'mismatch' ? c.journalMax : c.bootstrap ? 'missing' : c.generation;
/** The sheet's repair fact: which way a measurable mismatch leans, or null when row and journal agree. */
const collectRepairFact = (c: CollectLaneMeasured): 'journal-ahead' | 'journal-behind' | null =>
  c.kind === 'coherent' ? null : c.journalMax > c.rowGeneration ? 'journal-ahead' : 'journal-behind';

/** The marker as one listing measured it. An unlistable registry carries no marker (its switches arm has none), so it
 *  is `unmeasured`, never `absent`. */
function collectListingOf(sw: CollectLaneSwitches): 'stands' | 'absent' | 'unmeasured' {
  if (!sw.paused) return sw.marker ? 'stands' : 'absent';
  if (sw.why === 'unlistable') return 'unmeasured';
  return sw.marker ? 'stands' : 'absent';
}

/** Why the control state cannot be measured, as a 503's detail: bounded, no path, no errno. */
const COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_TEXT: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneUnmeasurable, string>> = {
  'row-absent': "the collector's settings row is missing",
  'row-unreadable': "the collector's settings row cannot be read",
  'row-malformed': "the collector's settings row holds a value this build cannot read",
  'journal-missing': "the collector's generation journal is missing beside a settings row that has been used",
  'journal-malformed': "the collector's generation journal is malformed",
  'journal-unreadable': "the collector's generation journal cannot be read",
  'journal-not-regular': "the collector's generation journal is not a regular file",
  'journal-not-configured': "this server runs without the collector's generation journal",
};
/** Why Live cannot be confirmed on what the POST measured. */
type CollectLiveUnmeasurable = 'unlistable' | 'epoch-moved' | 'node-unmeasured' | 'node-collision' | 'node-earlier-connection';

  unlistable: "the fleet box's registry could not be listed, so whether its legacy file stands is unknown",
  'epoch-moved': 'the fleet connection changed while the registry was being listed',
  'node-unmeasured': 'the fleet node on the current connection is not measured yet',
  'node-collision': "the fleet node's id on the current connection keys another live inventory row",
  'node-earlier-connection': 'the fleet node was measured on an earlier connection',
};
const collectLiveUnmeasurable = (why: CollectLiveUnmeasurable): CollectPostDecision =>
  ({ kind: 'unmeasurable', detail: COLLECT_LIVE_UNMEASURABLE_TEXT[why] });

 *  await, so a write that landed during it is in the facts and an earlier key is stale:
 *  1. a row and journal that cannot be measured: `unmeasurable`, for both choices, before any 409;
 *  2. Off reads no listing, no epoch and no node. A null latch is `marker` (409 `marker-still-controls`), whatever the
 *     listing says; a set latch is a write, even on an unlistable registry or a moved epoch, and it repairs a mismatch;
 *  3. Live needs a listed registry, an unmoved epoch and a node measured on this connection, else `unmeasurable`;
 *  4. Live's facts are keyed by `collectConfirmKey`: no `confirm` is `confirm-required`, a different one is
 *     `confirm-stale`, each carrying the fresh facts and key; a match writes, carrying the row and journal reads
 *     themselves as the store's expectation. A no-op Live still needs the key: the store, not this decision, finds it.
 *  Live stays confirmable with a capability missing or the pause standing: both are on the sheet and in the key. */
export function decideCollectLanePost(i: CollectPostInput): CollectPostDecision {
  const control = collectLaneControl(measureCollectLaneRow(i.row), i.journal);
  if (control.kind === 'unmeasurable') return { kind: 'unmeasurable', detail: COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_TEXT[control.why] };
  if (i.request.choice === 'off') {
    if (control.row.markerRetiredAt === null) return { kind: 'marker' };
    return { kind: 'write', request: { kind: 'off' } };
  }
  const listing = collectListingOf(i.switches);
  if (listing === 'unmeasured') return collectLiveUnmeasurable('unlistable');
  if (i.epoch.before !== i.epoch.after) return collectLiveUnmeasurable('epoch-moved');
  const node = i.node;
  if (node.kind === 'unmeasured') return collectLiveUnmeasurable('node-unmeasured');
  if (node.kind === 'collision') return collectLiveUnmeasurable('node-collision');
  if (node.connectionEpoch !== i.epoch.after) return collectLiveUnmeasurable('node-earlier-connection');
  const caps: CollectLaneCaps = { collect: i.caps.collect, reclaimPause: i.caps.reclaimPause };
  const paused = i.switches.paused;
  const r = control.row;
  const confirmKey = collectConfirmKey({
    boot: i.boot, epoch: i.epoch.after, node: node.nodeId,
    row: { choice: r.choice, fleetNodeId: r.fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt: r.markerRetiredAt, generation: r.generation },
    journal: collectJournalFact(control), marker: listing, caps, paused,

    node: { nodeId: node.nodeId, measuredAt: node.measuredAt },

    paused,
    marker: listing,

    attention: i.counts === null ? null : { wouldCollect: i.counts.wouldCollect, held: i.counts.held, boxLines: i.counts.boxLines },
  };

  if (i.request.confirm !== confirmKey) return { kind: 'confirm', body: { ok: false, error: 'confirm-stale', confirmKey, facts } };

/** The measured row, when the read is one (`seed` or `row`); null when it is not a readable row. One meaning. */
const collectRowOf = (m: CollectLaneRowMeasure): CollectLaneRow | null => (m.kind === 'seed' || m.kind === 'row' ? m.row : null);

/** A row as the change body names it: the choice (a future token quoted and bounded), and its node when it has one. */
function collectRowWords(m: CollectLaneRowMeasure): string {
  switch (m.kind) {
    case 'seed':
    case 'row': {
      const choice = isCollectLaneChoice(m.row.choice) ? m.row.choice
        : `the unknown token ${JSON.stringify(collectBoundedWords(m.row.choice, COLLECT_LANE_WORD_MAX))}`;
      return m.row.fleetNodeId === null ? choice
        : `${choice} for fleet node ${collectBoundedWords(m.row.fleetNodeId, COLLECT_LANE_NODE_MAX)}`;
    }
    case 'malformed': return 'a malformed row';
    case 'unreadable': return 'an unreadable row';
    case 'absent': return 'no row';
    default: { const unnamed: never = m; return unnamed; }
  }
}

/** The accepted POST's feed body (path-identity spec §5.5): `choice <before> → <after> (generation <g>)`, the node for
 *  a Live, then `, repairing a journal that disagreed with the database` whenever the row before and `journalBefore`
 *  were a mismatch, either way. The repair is read from the journal as read before the append, never from the step
 *  between generations: a behind journal (row 5, journal 4) is written at 6, one step, and is a repair all the same.
 *  A latch retirement, which the POST never writes, is named too, so the body is true for every write. No path; the
 *  route appends the actor. */
export function collectLaneSettingChange(before: CollectLaneRowRead, after: CollectLaneRowRead,
  journalBefore: CollectLaneJournalRead): string {
  const was = measureCollectLaneRow(before);
  const now = measureCollectLaneRow(after);
  const wasRow = collectRowOf(was);
  const nowRow = collectRowOf(now);
  const generation = nowRow === null ? '' : ` (generation ${nowRow.generation})`;
  const retired = wasRow !== null && nowRow !== null && wasRow.markerRetiredAt === null && nowRow.markerRetiredAt !== null
    ? ", retiring the fleet box's legacy file" : '';
  const repaired = collectLaneControl(was, journalBefore).kind === 'mismatch'
    ? ', repairing a journal that disagreed with the database' : '';

}

/** Whether a coherent re-read shows what the request asked for: Live for its node, Off with no node, a set latch. */
function collectWriteTargetShown(request: CollectLaneWriteRequest, r: CollectLaneRow): boolean {
  switch (request.kind) {
    case 'live': return r.choice === 'live' && r.fleetNodeId === request.fleetNodeId;
    case 'off': return r.choice === 'off' && r.fleetNodeId === null;
    case 'retire': return r.markerRetiredAt !== null;
    default: { const unnamed: never = request; return unnamed; }
  }
}

/** A 200's proof (path-identity spec §5.6): a synchronous re-read that is coherent and shows the requested target.
 *  - `generation` a number (the store wrote): the re-read stands at exactly that generation.
 *  - `generation` null (the store answered unchanged): for Live and retire, at the expected row's own generation; for
 *    Off, which carries no expectation by design (Off wins over a concurrent Live), the coherent re-read showing off
 *    with no node is the proof.
 *  Never `true` on the store's word alone. */
export function collectLaneWriteProved(request: CollectLaneWriteRequest, generation: number | null,
  row: CollectLaneRowRead, journal: CollectLaneJournalRead): boolean {
  const c = collectLaneControl(measureCollectLaneRow(row), journal);
  if (c.kind !== 'coherent' || !collectWriteTargetShown(request, c.row)) return false;
  if (generation !== null) return c.generation === generation;
  if (request.kind === 'off') return true;
  const was = collectRowOf(measureCollectLaneRow(request.expected));
  return was !== null && was.generation === c.generation;
}

/** A 200 POST's notice: when the choice applies, and the stated residual it cannot reach. */
export const COLLECT_LANE_APPLIES_TEXT: string =
  "The choice applies from the collector's next check; a removal already handed to ccd is not stopped.";

/** The view's input. The row admits no `absent` read (the route answers 503 for it), and the journal no
 *  `not-configured` read (a server built without the journal answers 501 before any view). */
export interface CollectLaneViewInput {
  readonly row: Exclude<CollectLaneRowRead, { kind: 'absent' }>;
  readonly journal: Exclude<CollectLaneJournalRead, { kind: 'not-configured' }>;
  readonly switches: CollectLaneSwitches; readonly epoch: CollectEpochPair; readonly node: CollectCurrentNode;
  readonly caps: CollectLaneCaps; readonly counts: CollectLaneCounts | null; readonly notice: string | null;
}

type CollectViewState = CollectLaneView['effective']['state'];
/** A stopped resolver arm as the Settings section names it: the pause is its own state; every other stop is a fact
 *  this server could not measure, so the fleet is unknown. */
const COLLECT_STOP_STATE: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneStopWhy, CollectViewState>> = {
  raised: 'paused', unlistable: 'unknown-fleet', 'epoch-changed': 'unknown-fleet', 'unknown-fleet': 'unknown-fleet',
};
function collectViewState(r: CollectLaneEffective): CollectViewState {
  switch (r.kind) {
    case 'stopped': return COLLECT_STOP_STATE[r.why];
    case 'not-running':
    case 'safety-stopped':
    case 'live':
    case 'shadowed': return r.kind;
    default: { const unnamed: never = r; return unnamed; }
  }
}

function collectStoredView(m: CollectLaneRowMeasure): CollectLaneView['stored'] {
  switch (m.kind) {
    case 'seed':
    case 'row':
      return { read: 'row', choice: m.row.choice, fleetNodeId: m.row.fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt: m.row.markerRetiredAt,

    case 'unreadable': return { read: 'unreadable' };
    case 'absent': throw new Error('collectLaneView: an absent row never reaches the view; the route answers 503 for it');

    case 'malformed':
    case 'unreadable':
    case 'not-regular': return { read: j.kind };
    default: { const unnamed: never = j; return unnamed; }
  }
}

function collectControlView(c: CollectLaneControl): CollectLaneView['control'] {
  switch (c.kind) {
    case 'coherent': return { state: 'coherent', bootstrap: c.bootstrap };
    case 'mismatch': return { state: 'mismatch', journal: c.journalMax > c.rowGeneration ? 'ahead' : 'behind' };

  }
}

/** The current node as the view shows it, with how the stored node compares. A node is `known` only when measured on
 *  the epoch after the listing; one measured on an earlier connection is not this connection's, so it reads
 *  `unmeasured`. `unread` means the stored row is not a readable row. */
function collectNodeView(node: CollectCurrentNode, epochNow: number, row: CollectLaneRow | null): CollectLaneView['node'] {
  if (node.kind === 'known' && node.connectionEpoch === epochNow) {
    const stored = row === null ? 'unread' : row.fleetNodeId === null ? 'none' : row.fleetNodeId === node.nodeId ? 'this' : 'other';

const COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_REMEDY: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneUnmeasurable, string>> = {

  'journal-unreadable': "The collector's generation journal on the server box cannot be read. Repair it by hand; Settings cannot.",

};
const COLLECT_LANE_MISMATCH_REMEDY = {
  preLatch: "Confirm Live again to repair it: the write takes a generation above both. Off waits until the fleet box's legacy file is retired.",
  latched: 'Confirm Live again, or choose Off, to repair it: either write takes a generation above both.',
} as const;
const COLLECT_LANE_RECREATED_REMEDY =
  `The fleet box's legacy file ${COLLECT_LANE_LIVE_MARKER} was re-created, and this server ignores it: remove it by hand on the fleet box.`;
const COLLECT_LANE_NOT_RUNNING_REMEDY =
  "The fleet box's ccd has not reported a capability this collector needs, so it removes nothing; if this persists, update the fleet box.";

/** The one remedy the view carries, most pressing first: an unmeasurable control state, a mismatch, a re-created
 *  marker, a missing capability. Null otherwise: the pause is deliberate, a stored Live for another node and a standing
 *  marker before the latch are lines the Settings section says itself, and an unknown fleet clears on measurement. */
function collectLaneRemedy(control: CollectLaneControl, listing: 'stands' | 'absent' | 'unmeasured', r: CollectLaneEffective): string | null {
  if (control.kind === 'unmeasurable') return COLLECT_LANE_UNMEASURABLE_REMEDY[control.why];
  const latched = control.row.markerRetiredAt !== null;
  if (control.kind === 'mismatch') return latched ? COLLECT_LANE_MISMATCH_REMEDY.latched : COLLECT_LANE_MISMATCH_REMEDY.preLatch;
  if (latched && listing === 'stands') return COLLECT_LANE_RECREATED_REMEDY;
  if (r.kind === 'not-running') return COLLECT_LANE_NOT_RUNNING_REMEDY;
  return null;
}

/** THE view composer (path-identity spec §5.6, §5.7): the GET's answer and a 200 POST's re-read. The only caller of
 *  the resolver outside the executor. Nothing folds:
 *  - the stored row is `row` (the raw token), `malformed` or `unreadable`;
 *  - the journal keeps each of its five reads;
 *  - the control state is coherent (and whether by bootstrap), a mismatch leaning ahead or behind, or unmeasurable;
 *  - the latch is `set`/`unset` only while the row and journal are measurable, else `unmeasured`: a latch no journal
 *    vouches for is not one the route acts on.
 *  No field is a path; the remedy may name the marker file, through this file's own constant. */
export function collectLaneView(i: CollectLaneViewInput): CollectLaneView {
  const measured = measureCollectLaneRow(i.row);
  const control = collectLaneControl(measured, i.journal);
  const effective = collectLaneEffective({ switches: i.switches, epoch: i.epoch, caps: i.caps, control, node: i.node });
  const listing = collectListingOf(i.switches);
  return {
    stored: collectStoredView(measured),
    journal: collectJournalView(i.journal),
    control: collectControlView(control),
    effective: { state: collectViewState(effective), armedBy: effective.kind === 'live' ? effective.armedBy : 'neither' },
    marker: {
      listing,
      latch: control.kind === 'unmeasurable' ? 'unmeasured' : control.row.markerRetiredAt === null ? 'unset' : 'set',
    },
    node: collectNodeView(i.node, i.epoch.after, collectRowOf(measured)),
    caps: { collect: i.caps.collect, reclaimPause: i.caps.reclaimPause },
    attention: i.counts === null ? null : { wouldCollect: i.counts.wouldCollect, held: i.counts.held, boxLines: i.counts.boxLines },
    remedy: collectLaneRemedy(control, listing, effective),
    notice: i.notice,
  };
}
```

```bash
and a node measured on this connection, then a fresh key; a no-op Live
still needs one. The feed body reads a repair from the journal read
before the write, so a behind journal says so too. A 200 needs a
coherent re-read showing the requested choice, the no-op's included.

remedy names no path but the marker file's.
MSG
```

### Task 5: The connection-bound fleet identity: the cell, client invalidation, the caps guard, publication under the epoch, and local mode

**Model routing:** **`opus`, effort `xhigh`**. Settings Live binds to this node. A wrong answer here arms deletion on a box the operator never confirmed. Review Focus 5 is aimed at this task, and the SAFETY and identity lenses read this diff against spec §5.2 and §5.9.

**Why:**
- **Spec §5.2.** "The current fleet identity is not the persisted update-inventory row. The server keeps `{connectionEpoch, nodeIdState}` in memory. Every accepted ready and every close invalidates it synchronously. An inventory read may publish a directly measured node id only while the epoch it captured still stands; a result from an earlier connection is discarded. The connection-label fallback is not node identity for this switch."
- **R20.** The names are `FleetIdentityCell`, `epochNow()`, `current()` and `CurrentFleetIdentity`.
- **R7.** In local mode the epoch is 0 and the node is this box's own directly measured node id, published by `sweepOwn` through `ownIdentity`.
- **R29.** Both publication keys are optional, and a missing key publishes nothing. The remote arm sets `fleet.identity` and the local arm sets `ownIdentity`. Text pins hold production presence.
- **Spec §5.8 SW7 A.** A stored Live re-arms once the same node is freshly measured. In the meantime "the post-ready state stopped until same-epoch identity is known".

**Readings this task takes (each named by slug in the wave-done, for the coordinator):**
- `error-outcome-publishes-inventory-refused`. Sometimes a sweep's reads come back but the apply then throws or is refused. Such a sweep still publishes, under its captured epoch: `fleetNodeMeasuredOf` maps `error` and `refused` to `inventory-refused`. A same-epoch `known` therefore never outlives a sweep that could not record its read. Part C's grounding had "a throw publishes nothing".
- `link-down-at-sweep-start-publishes-nothing`. A sweep that finds the link down before its await reads nothing and publishes nothing. The close that took the link down already invalidated the cell.
- `cell-answers-are-frozen`. Every `current()` answer is a frozen object, built field by field.
- `fleet-identity-imports-nothing-pin`. This is an extra case: the cell module has no import and reads no clock.
- `run-inventory-behaviour-pins`. These are extra cases. Beside the `runInventory` text pin, `FleetWatcher.inventoryNow()` runs in local mode (one publish, of this box's node, at epoch 0). It also runs in remote mode over two fixture directories, where exactly one publish is made, of the fleet's node, never the server's.
- `sw7-case-reads-the-resolver`. The SW7 case drives Task 3's `collectLaneEffective` with an unchanged stored Live. That shows "stopped until same-epoch identity is known", then "re-arms".

```ts
// Path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2: "The current fleet identity is not the persisted update-inventory row. The
// server keeps {connectionEpoch, nodeIdState} in memory. Every accepted ready and every close invalidates it
// synchronously. An inventory read may publish a directly measured node id only while the epoch it captured still
// stands; a result from an earlier connection is discarded." This file pins the cell alone: no socket, no store.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import type { CollectCurrentNode } from '../src/collectLane.js';
import {
  FleetIdentityCell, NO_FLEET_IDENTITY, type CurrentFleetIdentity, type FleetNodeMeasured,
} from '../src/fleetidentity.js';
import { codeOnly } from './sourceScan.js';

const U1 = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0';
const U2 = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';
const KNOWN_U1: FleetNodeMeasured = { kind: 'known', nodeId: U1, measuredAt: 1_000 };
const KNOWN_U2: FleetNodeMeasured = { kind: 'known', nodeId: U2, measuredAt: 2_000 };

describe('the identity cell (path-identity spec §5.2)', () => {
  it('starts unmeasured at epoch 0, no-ready', () => {
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    expect(cell.epochNow()).toBe(0);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 0, why: 'no-ready' });
  });

  it('invalidate strictly increases the epoch and resets known to unmeasured', () => {
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    expect(cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory')).toBe(1);
    expect(cell.publish(1, KNOWN_U1)).toEqual({ kind: 'published' });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: 1, nodeId: U1, measuredAt: 1_000 });
    expect(cell.invalidate('link-down')).toBe(2);
    expect(cell.epochNow()).toBe(2);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 2, why: 'link-down' });
    expect(cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory')).toBe(3);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 3, why: 'awaiting-inventory' });
  });

  it('publish under the current epoch is known', () => {
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    const e = cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    expect(cell.publish(e, KNOWN_U1)).toEqual({ kind: 'published' });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: e, nodeId: U1, measuredAt: 1_000 });
    expect(cell.epochNow(), 'publishing never moves the epoch').toBe(e);
  });

  it('publish under a stale epoch changes nothing', () => {
    // §5.9: "An old-epoch inventory completion cannot repopulate current identity."
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    const captured = cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    cell.invalidate('link-down');
    cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    const before = cell.current();
    expect(cell.publish(captured, KNOWN_U1)).toEqual({ kind: 'stale-epoch', captured: 1, current: 3 });
    expect(cell.current()).toBe(before);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 3, why: 'awaiting-inventory' });
    // A capture from no connection at all is no better than one from an earlier connection.
    expect(cell.publish(4, KNOWN_U1)).toEqual({ kind: 'stale-epoch', captured: 4, current: 3 });
    expect(cell.current()).toBe(before);
  });

  it('the latest same-epoch measurement wins, fail-closed', () => {
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    const e = cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    cell.publish(e, KNOWN_U1);
    cell.publish(e, { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-unreadable' });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: e, why: 'node-id-unreadable' });
    cell.publish(e, KNOWN_U2);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: e, nodeId: U2, measuredAt: 2_000 });
  });

  it('current().connectionEpoch === epochNow() over a random sequence', () => {
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    const MEASURED: readonly FleetNodeMeasured[] = [
      KNOWN_U1, KNOWN_U2, { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-absent' },
      { kind: 'collision', why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row' },
    ];
    let seed = 0x5eed;
    const next = (n: number): number => { seed = (Math.imul(seed, 1103515245) + 12345) >>> 0; return seed % n; };
    let last = 0;
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    for (let step = 0; step < 500; step++) {
      const op = next(3);
      if (op === 0) {
        const e = cell.invalidate(next(2) === 0 ? 'awaiting-inventory' : 'link-down');
        expect(e, `step ${step}: invalidate moves the epoch by exactly one`).toBe(last + 1);
        last = e;
      } else if (op === 1) {
        expect(cell.publish(cell.epochNow(), MEASURED[next(MEASURED.length)]!)).toEqual({ kind: 'published' });
      } else {
        const before = cell.current();
        const stale = cell.epochNow() - 1 - next(3);
        expect(cell.publish(stale, MEASURED[next(MEASURED.length)]!)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'stale-epoch' });
        expect(cell.current(), `step ${step}: a stale publish changed the answer`).toBe(before);
      }
      seen.add(cell.current().kind);
      expect(cell.epochNow(), `step ${step}`).toBe(last);
      expect(cell.current().connectionEpoch, `step ${step}`).toBe(cell.epochNow());
    }
    // CONTROL: the sequence reached every kind, so the invariant was checked against each.
    expect([...seen].sort()).toEqual(['collision', 'known', 'unmeasured']);
  });

  it('collision carries no nodeId', () => {
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    const e = cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    // A caller's object that DID carry one (a cast, a spread from a row): the cell stamps field by field.
    const smuggled = { kind: 'collision', why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row', nodeId: U1 } as unknown as FleetNodeMeasured;
    expect(cell.publish(e, smuggled)).toEqual({ kind: 'published' });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'collision', connectionEpoch: e, why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row' });
    expect('nodeId' in cell.current()).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(cell.current()).sort()).toEqual(['connectionEpoch', 'kind', 'why']);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(cell.current()), 'an answer a reader could edit in place').toBe(true);
  });

  it('CurrentFleetIdentity is assignable to CollectCurrentNode', () => {
    // TYPE-LEVEL: typecheck-tests compiles this file. An arm of CurrentFleetIdentity that the resolver's input
    // (collectLane.ts, which may not import this file) lacks is a TS2322 on the next line.
    const asNode = (c: CurrentFleetIdentity): CollectCurrentNode => c;
    const node: CollectCurrentNode = new FleetIdentityCell().current();
    expect(asNode(new FleetIdentityCell().current())).toEqual(node);
  });

  it('NO_FLEET_IDENTITY is epoch 0 and never known', () => {
    expect(NO_FLEET_IDENTITY.epochNow()).toBe(0);
    expect(NO_FLEET_IDENTITY.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 0, why: 'no-identity-source' });
    expect(Object.isFrozen(NO_FLEET_IDENTITY)).toBe(true);
    expect('publish' in NO_FLEET_IDENTITY, 'a no-source reader that can be published into').toBe(false);
    expect('invalidate' in NO_FLEET_IDENTITY).toBe(false);
  });

  it('the module imports nothing and reads no clock', () => {
    const IMPORT = /^\s*import\b|\bimport\s*\(|\brequire\s*\(/m;
    const CLOCK = /\bDate\b|\bperformance\b|\bsetTimeout\b|\bsetInterval\b/;
    expect(IMPORT.test("import { x } from './y.js';"), 'CONTROL: an import is seen').toBe(true);
    expect(CLOCK.test('const t = Date.now();'), 'CONTROL: a clock is seen').toBe(true);
    const code = codeOnly(readFileSync(new URL('../src/fleetidentity.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
    expect(code, 'fleetidentity.ts imports something').not.toMatch(IMPORT);
    expect(code, 'fleetidentity.ts reads a clock: measuredAt arrives in the measurement').not.toMatch(CLOCK);
  });
});
```
