```ts
// Path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2: "Every accepted ready and every close invalidates it synchronously." The
// client is where a ready is accepted, and its listeners run synchronously inside `onReady` (`setState`'s state
// listeners, then the connect listeners, index.ts's inventory trigger among them) and inside `onClose`
// (`markDown`'s state listeners). So the invalidation comes FIRST in each, or a listener reads the previous
// connection's node as known. `close()` never reaches `onClose`, so it invalidates on its own path. The agent is
// hand-rolled (`remote-connect.test.ts`'s `fakeReadyAgent`, reduced to its handshake), and no HOME is read.
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { WebSocketServer } from 'ws';
import type { CurrentFleetIdentity } from '../src/fleetidentity.js';
import { connectFleet, FleetClient, type ConnectedFleet } from '../src/remote/client.js';

const U1 = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0';
/** Fast reconnects, and no heartbeat inside a case. */
const FAST = { token: 'unused', reconnectMinMs: 30, reconnectMaxMs: 100, heartbeatMs: 60_000, requestTimeoutMs: 2_000 };
const AWAITING_1: CurrentFleetIdentity = { kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'awaiting-inventory' };

/** Answers every hello with a bare ready, on every connection. */
function fakeReadyAgent(): Promise<{ port: number; close(): Promise<void> }> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const wss = new WebSocketServer({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0 }, () => {
      const address = wss.address();
      const port = typeof address === 'object' && address !== null ? address.port : 0;
      resolve({
        port,
        close: () => new Promise<void>((res) => {
          for (const c of wss.clients) c.terminate();
          wss.close(() => res());
        }),
      });
    });
    wss.on('connection', (ws) => {
      ws.on('message', (raw) => {
        const msg: unknown = JSON.parse(raw.toString());
        if (typeof msg === 'object' && msg !== null && (msg as { t?: unknown }).t === 'hello') {
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({ t: 'ready', v: 1 }));
        }
      });
    });
  });
}

describe('ready and close invalidate before any listener runs (§5.2)', () => {
  let agent: { port: number; close(): Promise<void> } | undefined;
  let client: FleetClient | undefined;
  let fleet: ConnectedFleet | undefined;
  afterEach(async () => {
    await client?.close();
    client = undefined;
    await fleet?.close();
    fleet = undefined;
    await agent?.close();
    agent = undefined;
  });

  /** A client to a fresh fake agent, NOT started, so a case registers its listeners before the first ready. */
  async function unstarted(): Promise<FleetClient> {
    agent = await fakeReadyAgent();
    client = new FleetClient({ url: `ws://127.0.0.1:${agent.port}`, ...FAST });
    return client;
  }

  it('a fresh client reads epoch 0', () => {
    // Constructed and never started: no socket, nothing to close.
    const c = new FleetClient({ url: 'ws://127.0.0.1:1', token: 'unused' });
    expect(c.identity.epochNow()).toBe(0);
    expect(c.identity.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 0, why: 'no-ready' });
  });

  it('after the handshake the identity is awaiting-inventory on a larger epoch', async () => {
    agent = await fakeReadyAgent();
    fleet = connectFleet({ url: `ws://127.0.0.1:${agent.port}`, ...FAST });
    expect(fleet.identity, "connectFleet hands out the client's own cell").toBe(fleet.client.identity);
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(fleet!.state.connected).toBe(true), { timeout: 3000 });
    expect(fleet.identity.current()).toEqual(AWAITING_1);
  });

  it('a connect listener and a state listener both see the post-ready epoch', async () => {
    const c = await unstarted();
    const atState: CurrentFleetIdentity[] = [];
    const atConnect: CurrentFleetIdentity[] = [];
    c.onStateChange((s) => { if (s.connected) atState.push(c.identity.current()); });
    c.onConnected(() => { atConnect.push(c.identity.current()); });
    c.start();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(atConnect).toHaveLength(1), { timeout: 3000 });
    expect(atState, 'the state listener ran inside onReady before the invalidation').toEqual([AWAITING_1]);
    expect(atConnect, "the connect listener (index.ts's inventory trigger) ran before the invalidation").toEqual([AWAITING_1]);
  });

  it('a socket close invalidates before the connected:false notification', async () => {
    const c = await unstarted();
    const atDown: CurrentFleetIdentity[] = [];
    c.onStateChange((s) => { if (!s.connected) atDown.push(c.identity.current()); });
    c.start();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(c.state.connected).toBe(true), { timeout: 3000 });
    expect(c.identity.publish(c.identity.epochNow(), { kind: 'known', nodeId: U1, measuredAt: 5 })).toEqual({ kind: 'published' });
    c.ws?.close();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(atDown).toHaveLength(1), { timeout: 3000 });
    expect(atDown[0]).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 2, why: 'link-down' });
    // The reconnect's ready invalidates again: a node measured on the closed connection never comes back by itself.
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(c.state.connected).toBe(true), { timeout: 3000 });
    expect(c.identity.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 3, why: 'awaiting-inventory' });
  });

  it('explicit close() invalidates', async () => {
    const c = await unstarted();
    c.start();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(c.state.connected).toBe(true), { timeout: 3000 });
    c.identity.publish(c.identity.epochNow(), { kind: 'known', nodeId: U1, measuredAt: 5 });
    await c.close();
    expect(c.identity.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 2, why: 'link-down' });
  });

  it("FleetState's whole-object shape is unchanged", async () => {
    const c = await unstarted();
    c.start();
    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(c.state.connected).toBe(true), { timeout: 3000 });
    // The epoch is the cell's, never a FleetState field: remote-connect.test.ts pins that object whole.
    expect(Object.keys(c.state).sort())
      .toEqual(['agentOps', 'build', 'ccdVerbs', 'connected', 'downSince', 'observedEpoch', 'rosterFp']);
  });
});
```

```ts
// Path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2: capabilities never cross a reconnect. `ccdVerbs` survives a close, so a
// `caps` answer asked on one connection and landing after a close and a fresh ready would describe the old agent
// to every reader of the new one. The refresh writes only on the epoch it asked under.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { FleetIdentityCell } from '../src/fleetidentity.js';
import { makeRefreshCaps } from '../src/refreshcaps.js';
import type { FleetState } from '../src/remote/client.js';

describe('caps never cross a reconnect', () => {
  it('a caps answer that resolves after an invalidation writes nothing', async () => {
    const state: FleetState = { connected: true, downSince: null, ccdVerbs: ['start', 'ws-audit'], rosterFp: null, build: null };
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    // Asked on epoch 1; while it is out, the link closes and a new ready is accepted.
    const crossing = makeRefreshCaps({
      caps: async () => { cell.invalidate('link-down'); cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory'); return ['start']; },
    }, state, cell);
    await crossing();
    expect(state.ccdVerbs).toEqual(['start', 'ws-audit']);
    // CONTROL: the same answer on an unchanged epoch writes, so the guard is the epoch and nothing else.
    const steady = makeRefreshCaps({ caps: async () => ['start'] }, state, cell);
    await steady();
    expect(state.ccdVerbs).toEqual(['start']);
  });
});
```

```ts
// Path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2 and §5.9: the inventory publishes the fleet node's identity ONLY from its own
// direct read of `node-id`, ONLY under the connection epoch it captured before its one await, and never from the
// connection-label fallback, a uuid carried forward from the persisted row, or a collision. FIXTURE HOMEs only:
// every ~/.ccrc is an `mkTmp` home, every coord.db is that home's own, and the fleet node is `localIO` over the
// fixture, a scripted io spread over `localIO`, or a real in-process agent over a real loopback WS.
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { mkdirSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import type { RunningAgent } from '../../agent/src/server.js';
import { NODE_FILES, type NodeFileKey } from '../../shared/agent-protocol.js';
import { collectLaneEffective, type CollectCurrentNode, type CollectLaneRow } from '../src/collectLane.js';
import { openCoordDb } from '../src/coord/db.js';
import { CoordStore } from '../src/coord/store.js';
import { FleetIdentityCell, type CurrentFleetIdentity, type FleetNodeMeasured } from '../src/fleetidentity.js';
import type { FleetState } from '../src/fleetstate.js';
import { localIO, type FleetIO } from '../src/io.js';
import type { ConnectedFleet } from '../src/remote/client.js';
import {
  FLEET_LABEL, NODE_FILE_CAP_BYTES, SERVER_LABEL, fleetNodeMeasuredOf, sweepInventory,
  type FleetIdentityPublisher, type InventoryDeps, type NodeFileRead, type SweepOutcome,
} from '../src/update/inventory.js';
import { bootAgent, connectToAgent, makeFixture } from './remoteHelpers.js';
import { mkTmp } from './tmpHelpers.js';

const SHA = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567';
const U1 = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0';
const U2 = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';
const NOW = 1_758_500_120_000;

type Measured = Exclude<NodeFileKey, 'projection' | 'tokenGeneration'>;
const stampJson = (): string =>
  `${JSON.stringify({ sha: SHA, ref: 'main', builtAt: '2026-09-22T10:00:00Z', dirty: false, version: 'v0.0.12' })}\n`;
/** Every node file but `node-id` (`update-inventory.test.ts`'s NO_ID). */
const NO_ID: Partial<Record<Measured, string>> = {
  stamp: stampJson(), installed: `${SHA}\n`, caps: 'os linux\nverify\nnode-id\nfloor\n', floor: 'v0.0.12\n', previous: 'v0.0.11\n',
};
const withId = (id: string): Partial<Record<Measured, string>> => ({ ...NO_ID, nodeId: `${id}\n` });

function plant(ccrcDir: string, files: Partial<Record<Measured, string>>): void {
  mkdirSync(ccrcDir, { recursive: true });
  for (const [key, body] of Object.entries(files) as [Measured, string][]) {
    writeFileSync(path.join(ccrcDir, NODE_FILES[key]), body);
  }
}
const unplant = (ccrcDir: string, key: Measured): void => rmSync(path.join(ccrcDir, NODE_FILES[key]), { force: true });

interface Box { ccrcDir: string; store: CoordStore }
/** A fixture HOME with its own coord database, never the live one. */
function box(prefix: string): Box {
  const ccrcDir = path.join(mkTmp(prefix), '.ccrc');
  return { ccrcDir, store: new CoordStore(openCoordDb(path.join(ccrcDir, 'coord.db'))) };
}
const fleetState = (): FleetState => ({ connected: true, downSince: null, ccdVerbs: null, rosterFp: null, build: null });
/** The server row's io in the remote cases: it reads nothing, so the fleet row alone reads the fixture. */
const NOTHING_IO: FleetIO = { ...localIO, lstatMeasured: async () => ({ ok: false as const, reason: 'absent' as const }) };
const remoteDeps = (b: Box, identity: FleetIdentityPublisher, io: FleetIO = localIO): InventoryDeps =>
  ({ store: b.store, localIo: NOTHING_IO, ccrcDir: b.ccrcDir, role: 'server', fleet: { io, state: fleetState(), identity } });
/** A cell as the client leaves it after its first accepted ready: epoch 1, nothing measured yet. */
const readyCell = (): FleetIdentityCell => {
  const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
  cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
  return cell;
};
const measuredAs = (nodeId: string): SweepOutcome => ({ label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'measured', nodeId, lease: 'none', refused: false });

describe('identity is published only from the direct read, under the captured epoch (path-identity spec §5.2, §5.9)', () => {
  let agent: RunningAgent | undefined;
  let fleet: ConnectedFleet | undefined;
  afterEach(async () => {
    await fleet?.close();
    fleet = undefined;
    if (agent) await agent.close();
    agent = undefined;
  });

  it('the planted node-id is known', async () => {
    const b = box('ccrc-ident-known-');
    plant(b.ccrcDir, withId(U1));
    const cell = readyCell();
    const out = await sweepInventory(remoteDeps(b, cell), NOW);
    expect(out[1]).toMatchObject({ label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'measured', nodeId: U1 });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: 1, nodeId: U1, measuredAt: NOW });
  });

  it('an invalidation during the node-id read leaves it awaiting-inventory, and the row is still written', async () => {
    const b = box('ccrc-ident-midread-');
    plant(b.ccrcDir, withId(U1));
    const cell = readyCell();
    // A ready is accepted while the node-id read is out (the link dropped and came back; `connected` reads true).
    const reconnecting: FleetIO = {
      ...localIO,
      readFileMeasured: async (p, timeoutMs, signal) => {
        if (path.basename(p) === NODE_FILES.nodeId) cell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
        return localIO.readFileMeasured(p, timeoutMs, signal);
      },
    };
    const out = await sweepInventory(remoteDeps(b, cell, reconnecting), NOW);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 2, why: 'awaiting-inventory' });
    // The row is written as it always was; the sweep the new ready triggers re-measures it under the new epoch.
    expect(out[1]).toMatchObject({ label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'measured', nodeId: U1 });
    expect(b.store.node(U1)).toMatchObject({ label: FLEET_LABEL, reachable: true, measuredAt: NOW });
  });

  it('the label fallback is never identity', async () => {
    const b = box('ccrc-ident-label-');
    plant(b.ccrcDir, NO_ID);
    const cell = readyCell();
    const out = await sweepInventory(remoteDeps(b, cell), NOW);
    expect(out[1], 'CONTROL: the row is keyed by the connection label').toMatchObject({ result: 'measured', nodeId: FLEET_LABEL });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-absent' });
  });

  it('the carried persisted uuid is never identity', async () => {
    const b = box('ccrc-ident-carry-');
    plant(b.ccrcDir, withId(U2));
    const cell = readyCell();
    await sweepInventory(remoteDeps(b, cell), NOW - 60_000);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: 1, nodeId: U2, measuredAt: NOW - 60_000 });
    unplant(b.ccrcDir, 'nodeId');
    const out = await sweepInventory(remoteDeps(b, cell), NOW);
    // CONTROL: the inventory keeps measuring into the row it already re-keyed, so the outcome still names U2.
    expect(out[1]).toMatchObject({ result: 'measured', nodeId: U2 });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-absent' });
  });

  it('a collision is collision', async () => {
    const b = box('ccrc-ident-collision-');
    // Both connections read ONE directory, so the fleet's node-id already keys the server's live row.
    plant(b.ccrcDir, withId(U1));
    const cell = readyCell();
    const deps: InventoryDeps = {
      store: b.store, localIo: localIO, ccrcDir: b.ccrcDir, role: 'both', fleet: { io: localIO, state: fleetState(), identity: cell },
    };
    const out = await sweepInventory(deps, NOW);
    expect(out[1]).toMatchObject({ label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'node-id-collision' });
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'collision', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row' });
    expect('nodeId' in cell.current()).toBe(false);
  });

  it('unreadable, too-large and malformed each keep their own why', async () => {
    const whyAfter = async (prefix: string, files: Partial<Record<Measured, string>>, io: FleetIO = localIO): Promise<CurrentFleetIdentity> => {
      const b = box(prefix);
      plant(b.ccrcDir, files);
      const cell = readyCell();
      await sweepInventory(remoteDeps(b, cell, io), NOW);
      return cell.current();
    };
    const unreadableId: FleetIO = {
      ...localIO,
      readFileMeasured: async (p, timeoutMs, signal) => (path.basename(p) === NODE_FILES.nodeId
        ? { ok: false as const, reason: 'unreadable' as const }
        : localIO.readFileMeasured(p, timeoutMs, signal)),
    };
    expect(await whyAfter('ccrc-ident-unreadable-', withId(U1), unreadableId))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-unreadable' });
    // Over the cap even though its first line is a valid id: a too-large file is never read as one.
    expect(await whyAfter('ccrc-ident-large-', { ...NO_ID, nodeId: `${U1}\n${'x'.repeat(NODE_FILE_CAP_BYTES)}` }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-too-large' });
    expect(await whyAfter('ccrc-ident-malformed-', { ...NO_ID, nodeId: 'not-a-uuid\n' }))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-malformed' });
    expect(await whyAfter('ccrc-ident-upper-', withId(U1.toUpperCase())))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-malformed' });
    expect(await whyAfter('ccrc-ident-absent-', NO_ID))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-absent' });
  });

  it('known needs outcome.result measured and outcome.nodeId equal to the direct read; a disagreement is node-id-malformed', () => {
    const read: NodeFileRead = { ok: true, content: `${U1}\n` };
    const rows: readonly (readonly [string, NodeFileRead, SweepOutcome, FleetNodeMeasured])[] = [
      ['agree', read, measuredAs(U1), { kind: 'known', nodeId: U1, measuredAt: NOW }],
      ['the row keyed by another uuid', read, measuredAs(U2), { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-malformed' }],
      ['the row keyed by the label', read, measuredAs(FLEET_LABEL), { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-malformed' }],
      ['collision', read, { label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'node-id-collision', nodeId: FLEET_LABEL, lease: 'none', refused: false },
        { kind: 'collision', why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row' }],
      ['refused', read, { label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'refused', why: 'bad-node-id' }, { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'inventory-refused' }],
      ['error', read, { label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'error', message: 'boom' }, { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'inventory-refused' }],
      ['unreachable', read, { label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'unreachable', nodeId: FLEET_LABEL }, { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'link-down' }],
      ['absent beside a carried uuid', { ok: false, reason: 'absent' }, measuredAs(U1), { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-absent' }],
      ['unreadable beside a carried uuid', { ok: false, reason: 'unreadable' }, measuredAs(U1), { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-unreadable' }],
      ['too large beside a carried uuid', { ok: false, reason: 'too-large' }, measuredAs(U1), { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-too-large' }],
      ['malformed', { ok: true, content: 'not-a-uuid\n' }, measuredAs(FLEET_LABEL), { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-malformed' }],
    ];
    for (const [name, r, outcome, want] of rows) expect(fleetNodeMeasuredOf(r, outcome, NOW), name).toEqual(want);
  });

  it('local mode publishes the own node under epoch 0 through ownIdentity', async () => {
    // In local mode this box IS the fleet node: nothing invalidates the cell, and the server row's own sweep publishes.
    const b = box('ccrc-ident-local-');
    plant(b.ccrcDir, withId(U1));
    const cell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    const out = await sweepInventory(
      { store: b.store, localIo: localIO, ccrcDir: b.ccrcDir, role: 'both', fleet: null, ownIdentity: cell }, NOW);
    expect(out).toEqual([{ label: SERVER_LABEL, result: 'measured', nodeId: U1, lease: 'none', refused: false }]);
    expect(cell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: 0, nodeId: U1, measuredAt: NOW });
    // The remote shape sets no ownIdentity: the server box's own node-id never reaches the fleet cell.
    const r = box('ccrc-ident-remote-own-');
    plant(r.ccrcDir, withId(U1));
    const fleetCell = readyCell();
    const outR = await sweepInventory(
      { store: r.store, localIo: localIO, ccrcDir: r.ccrcDir, role: 'server', fleet: { io: NOTHING_IO, state: fleetState(), identity: fleetCell } },
      NOW);
    expect(outR[0]).toMatchObject({ label: SERVER_LABEL, result: 'measured', nodeId: U1 });
    expect(fleetCell.current()).toEqual({ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: 1, why: 'node-id-absent' });
  });

  /** A real agent over a fixture HOME whose node-id is `id`, a real client to it, and the ready trigger wired the way
   *  index.ts wires it, but straight to `sweepInventory`. The server row reads nothing (`NOTHING_IO`), so only the
   *  fleet row reads the fixture: one directory read by both rows would be a collision. `atReady` records what each
   *  ready leaves in the cell, before any sweep could publish into it. */
  async function wired(prefix: string, id: string): Promise<{ f: ConnectedFleet; ccrcDir: string; atReady: CurrentFleetIdentity[] }> {
    const fixture = makeFixture();
    const ccrcDir = path.join(fixture.home, '.ccrc');
    plant(ccrcDir, withId(id));
    agent = await bootAgent(fixture);
    const b = box(prefix);
    const f = connectToAgent(agent.port);
    fleet = f;
    const atReady: CurrentFleetIdentity[] = [];
    f.client.onConnected(() => { atReady.push(f.identity.current()); });
    f.client.onConnected(() => {
      void sweepInventory(
        { store: b.store, localIo: NOTHING_IO, ccrcDir, role: 'server', fleet: { io: f.io, state: f.state, identity: f.identity } },
        Date.now());
    });
    return { f, ccrcDir, atReady };
  }

  it('a real agent reconnecting to a different node goes unmeasured then known(U2) on a larger epoch', async () => {
    // Spec §5.3: "Connect a different or unmeasured fleet node: Settings Live is ineffective until freshly confirmed
    // for that node." Here the node-id behind the same address changes while the link is down.
    const { f, ccrcDir, atReady } = await wired('ccrc-ident-swap-', U1);
    await vi.waitFor(() => { expect(f.identity.current()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'known', nodeId: U1 }); }, { timeout: 3000, interval: 20 });
    const first = f.identity.epochNow();
    expect(atReady).toEqual([{ kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch: first, why: 'awaiting-inventory' }]);
    writeFileSync(path.join(ccrcDir, NODE_FILES.nodeId), `${U2}\n`);
    f.client.ws?.close();
    await vi.waitFor(() => { expect(atReady).toHaveLength(2); }, { timeout: 3000, interval: 20 });
    expect(atReady[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'awaiting-inventory' });
    expect(atReady[1]!.connectionEpoch).toBeGreaterThan(first);
    await vi.waitFor(() => { expect(f.identity.current()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'known', nodeId: U2 }); }, { timeout: 3000, interval: 20 });
    expect(f.identity.current().connectionEpoch).toBe(atReady[1]!.connectionEpoch);
  });

  it('the same node re-arms after a fresh measurement with no new confirm', async () => {
    // Spec §5.8 SW7 A: a stored Live is "eligible to re-arm after the same node is freshly measured", "with the
    // post-ready state stopped until same-epoch identity is known". The stored row never changes: no new confirm.
    const STORED_LIVE_U1: CollectLaneRow = { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: U1, markerRetiredAt: 1_000, generation: 1, updatedAt: 1_000 };
    const settingsArm = (node: CollectCurrentNode) => collectLaneEffective({
      switches: { paused: false, marker: false },
      epoch: { before: node.connectionEpoch, after: node.connectionEpoch },
      caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true },
      control: { kind: 'coherent', row: STORED_LIVE_U1, generation: 1, bootstrap: false },
      node,
    });
    const { f, atReady } = await wired('ccrc-ident-same-', U1);
    await vi.waitFor(() => { expect(f.identity.current()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'known', nodeId: U1 }); }, { timeout: 3000, interval: 20 });
    expect(settingsArm(f.identity.current()), 'CONTROL: armed before the link restarts').toMatchObject({ kind: 'live', armedBy: 'settings' });
    f.client.ws?.close();
    await vi.waitFor(() => { expect(atReady).toHaveLength(2); }, { timeout: 3000, interval: 20 });
    expect(settingsArm(atReady[1]!)).toEqual({ kind: 'stopped', why: 'unknown-fleet' });
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(f.identity.current()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'known', nodeId: U1, connectionEpoch: atReady[1]!.connectionEpoch });
    }, { timeout: 3000, interval: 20 });
    expect(atReady[1]!.connectionEpoch).toBeGreaterThan(atReady[0]!.connectionEpoch);
    expect(settingsArm(f.identity.current())).toMatchObject({ kind: 'live', armedBy: 'settings' });
  });
});
```

```ts
// Path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2: production carries the identity cell. `Deps.fleetIdentity`, `fleet.identity`
// and `ownIdentity` are all optional, so a deleted line is no type error and fails closed in silence: Settings Live
// would never arm, with every other suite green. No test imports index.ts (`refreshcaps.test.ts` says why), so these
// are text pins over the composition root and the inventory's deps builder, in the idiom of
// `update-inventory.test.ts`'s "index.ts composes the update lanes", each beside the behaviour it stands for.
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { NODE_FILES } from '../../shared/agent-protocol.js';
import { Bus } from '../src/bus.js';

import { CoordStore } from '../src/coord/store.js';

const U1 = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4978-8796-a5b4c3d2e1f0';
const U2 = '11111111-2222-4333-8444-555555555555';
const indexTs = readFileSync(new URL('../src/index.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
const watchTs = readFileSync(new URL('../src/watch.ts', import.meta.url), 'utf8');

const depsLiterals = indexTs.match(/^  deps = \{\n[\s\S]*?^  \};$/gm) ?? [];
const runInventory = /^  private async runInventory\(\): Promise<SweepOutcome\[\]> \{\n[\s\S]*?^  \}$/m.exec(watchTs)?.[0] ?? '';
const plantNodeId = (ccrcDir: string, id: string): void => {

};

describe('the composition root wires the identity cell (path-identity spec §5.2)', () => {

    expect(depsLiterals[1]).toContain('io: localIO');
    expect(depsLiterals[0]).toMatch(/^    fleetIdentity: fleet\.identity,$/m);
    expect(depsLiterals[1]).toMatch(/^    fleetIdentity: localFleetIdentity,$/m);
    // The local arm's cell is the one cell index.ts builds, and nothing there invalidates it: epoch 0 for ever.
    expect(indexTs).toMatch(/^  const localFleetIdentity = new FleetIdentityCell\(\);$/m);
    expect(codeOnly(indexTs).match(/\bnew FleetIdentityCell\s*\(/g) ?? []).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(codeOnly(indexTs)).not.toMatch(/\.invalidate\s*\(/);

    expect(runInventory).toMatch(/^\s+ownIdentity: cfg\.fleetMode === 'remote' \? undefined : this\.deps\.fleetIdentity,$/m);

    // Local: this box is the fleet node, so the server row's own sweep publishes into the cell, under epoch 0.
    const localHome = mkTmp('ccrc-ident-watch-local-');

    plantNodeId(fleetCcrc, U2);

      (p.startsWith(`${serverCcrc}${path.sep}`) ? path.join(fleetCcrc, path.relative(serverCcrc, p)) : p);
    const fleetIo: FleetIO = {
      ...localIO,

      statMeasured: (p) => localIO.statMeasured(onFleet(p)),
      readFileMeasured: (p, timeoutMs, signal) => localIO.readFileMeasured(onFleet(p), timeoutMs, signal),
    };
    const remoteCell = new FleetIdentityCell();
    remoteCell.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    const remotePublish = vi.spyOn(remoteCell, 'publish');
    const rw = new FleetWatcher({
      ...remote, cfg: { ...remote.cfg, fleetMode: 'remote', role: 'server' }, io: fleetIo,
      fleetState: { connected: true, downSince: null, ccdVerbs: null, rosterFp: null, build: null },

    expect(remoteCell.current()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: 1, nodeId: U2 });

    // fleetidentity.ts's header and client.ts's field docstring say so; this case is the mechanism. Code only, every
    // server/src .ts file; `__`-prefixed transients are skipped (boot.test.ts's mutant copy of index.ts).
    const SRC = fileURLToPath(new URL('../src/', import.meta.url));
    const files = readdirSync(SRC, { recursive: true, encoding: 'utf8' })
      .filter((f) => f.endsWith('.ts') && !path.basename(f).startsWith('__'));
    const holders = (re: RegExp): string[] => files.flatMap((f) => {
      const n = (codeOnly(readFileSync(path.join(SRC, f), 'utf8')).match(re) ?? []).length;
      return n === 0 ? [] : [`${f.split(path.sep).join('/')}:${n}`];
    }).sort();
    expect('identity.cell.publish(identity.captured, m);'.match(/\.publish\s*\(/g), 'CONTROL: a publish call is seen').toHaveLength(1);
    expect(holders(/\.publish\s*\(/g), 'a second publisher of the fleet identity').toEqual(['update/inventory.ts:2']);
    expect(holders(/\.invalidate\s*\(/g), 'a second invalidator of the fleet identity').toEqual(['remote/client.ts:3']);
  });

  it('refreshCaps is built with fleet.identity', () => {
    expect(depsLiterals[0]).toMatch(/^    refreshCaps: makeRefreshCaps\(fleet\.client, fleet\.state, fleet\.identity\),$/m);
    expect(codeOnly(indexTs).match(/\bmakeRefreshCaps\s*\(/g) ?? []).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 7: Create `server/src/fleetidentity.ts`**

```ts
// L3: the connection-bound fleet node identity (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2): "The current fleet identity
// is not the persisted update-inventory row. The server keeps {connectionEpoch, nodeIdState} in memory. Every
// accepted ready and every close invalidates it synchronously. An inventory read may publish a directly measured
// node id only while the epoch it captured still stands; a result from an earlier connection is discarded."
//
// One small synchronous memory cell, in `presence.ts`'s shape: nothing persisted, no timer, no clock (a
// measurement brings its own `measuredAt`), and no import of any kind. It FAILS SHUT. A server that just started,
// a connection that just changed and a node-id nobody could read all answer `unmeasured`; only a measurement
// published under the epoch it was taken on answers `known`. The temp-root collector's Settings arm binds to this
// answer and never to the inventory row, whose key can be the connection label or a uuid carried from an earlier
// sweep.
//
// WHO WRITES IT. The fleet client (`remote/client.ts`) invalidates it in three places: as the first statement of
// every accepted ready, right after a close's stale-socket guard, and in `close()`. The epoch lives there and never
// on `FleetState`, because a ready can be accepted before index.ts registers any listener. The inventory
// (`update/inventory.ts`) is the one publisher. In local mode nothing invalidates the composition root's cell, so
// its epoch stays 0, and the server row's own sweep publishes this box's node-id, because this box is the fleet node.

/** Why the current node is not known: one word per condition, none folded into another. */
export type FleetIdentityUnmeasuredWhy =
  | 'no-ready'             // constructed: no ready accepted yet
  | 'awaiting-inventory'   // a ready was accepted: nothing measured under its epoch yet
  | 'link-down'            // a close was observed, or the sweep found the link down
  | 'node-id-absent' | 'node-id-unreadable' | 'node-id-too-large' | 'node-id-malformed'
  | 'inventory-refused'    // the sweep's apply was refused or threw: its read is not trusted as identity
  | 'no-identity-source';  // `NO_FLEET_IDENTITY`: a Deps built without a cell

/** What a reader gets. `connectionEpoch` is always the cell's epoch at the moment of reading. A collision carries
 *  no `nodeId`, so nothing that asks `'nodeId' in x` can read it as an identity. */
export type CurrentFleetIdentity =
  | { readonly kind: 'known'; readonly connectionEpoch: number; readonly nodeId: string; readonly measuredAt: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'unmeasured'; readonly connectionEpoch: number; readonly why: FleetIdentityUnmeasuredWhy }
  | { readonly kind: 'collision'; readonly connectionEpoch: number; readonly why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row' };

/** One measurement, before the cell stamps the epoch it stands under. */
export type FleetNodeMeasured =
  | { readonly kind: 'known'; readonly nodeId: string; readonly measuredAt: number }
  | { readonly kind: 'unmeasured'; readonly why: FleetIdentityUnmeasuredWhy }
  | { readonly kind: 'collision'; readonly why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row' };

export type FleetIdentityPublish =
  | { readonly kind: 'published' } | { readonly kind: 'stale-epoch'; readonly captured: number; readonly current: number };

/** One answer under `connectionEpoch`, built field by field and frozen: a caller's object that carried more (a
 *  `nodeId` on a collision) never reaches a reader, and no reader can edit the answer in place. */
function stamped(m: FleetNodeMeasured, connectionEpoch: number): CurrentFleetIdentity {
  const s: CurrentFleetIdentity = m.kind === 'known'
    ? { kind: 'known', connectionEpoch, nodeId: m.nodeId, measuredAt: m.measuredAt }
    : m.kind === 'collision'
      ? { kind: 'collision', connectionEpoch, why: m.why }
      : { kind: 'unmeasured', connectionEpoch, why: m.why };
  return Object.freeze(s);
}

export class FleetIdentityCell {
  private epoch = 0;
  private latest: CurrentFleetIdentity = stamped({ kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'no-ready' }, 0);

  /** Synchronous. The epoch rises by one, and the answer becomes `unmeasured` with `why` under the new epoch,
   *  whatever it was before. Returns the new epoch. */
  invalidate(why: 'awaiting-inventory' | 'link-down'): number {
    this.epoch += 1;
    this.latest = stamped({ kind: 'unmeasured', why }, this.epoch);
    return this.epoch;
  }

  /** The epoch now. Capture it before an await; compare it, or publish under it, after. */
  epochNow(): number {
    return this.epoch;
  }

  /** The current answer. `current().connectionEpoch === epochNow()` always: every write stamps the epoch it stands
   *  under, and only `invalidate` moves the epoch, writing a fresh answer as it does. */
  current(): CurrentFleetIdentity {
    return this.latest;
  }

  /** Publishes `measured` only when `captured` is still the epoch. Any other capture, whether an earlier
   *  connection's or a number from nowhere, answers `stale-epoch` and changes nothing. Under one epoch the LATEST
   *  measurement wins, so a node read as known and then as unreadable is unmeasured: fail closed. */
  publish(captured: number, measured: FleetNodeMeasured): FleetIdentityPublish {
    if (captured !== this.epoch) return { kind: 'stale-epoch', captured, current: this.epoch };
    this.latest = stamped(measured, this.epoch);
    return { kind: 'published' };
  }
}

const NO_SOURCE: CurrentFleetIdentity = stamped({ kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'no-identity-source' }, 0);

/** The no-source reader for a Deps built without a cell (a test, a script): epoch 0 for ever and never `known`, so
 *  nothing that needs the current node can arm through it. It has no `publish` and no `invalidate`. */
export const NO_FLEET_IDENTITY: Pick<FleetIdentityCell, 'epochNow' | 'current'> = Object.freeze({
  epochNow: (): number => 0,
  current: (): CurrentFleetIdentity => NO_SOURCE,
});
```

(a) The import. Before:
```ts
import type { FleetState } from '../fleetstate.js';
import type { FleetIO } from '../io.js';
```
After:
```ts
import { FleetIdentityCell } from '../fleetidentity.js';
import type { FleetState } from '../fleetstate.js';
import type { FleetIO } from '../io.js';
```

(b) The field. Before:
```ts
  readonly state: FleetState = {
    connected: false, downSince: null, ccdVerbs: null, rosterFp: null, build: null,
    observedEpoch: undefined, agentOps: undefined,
  };
```
After:
```ts
  readonly state: FleetState = {
    connected: false, downSince: null, ccdVerbs: null, rosterFp: null, build: null,
    observedEpoch: undefined, agentOps: undefined,
  };
  /** The connection-bound fleet node identity (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). It lives HERE, never on `state`
   *  (whose whole shape `remote-connect.test.ts` pins) and never in a listener: index.ts registers its listeners after
   *  `connectFleet` returns, so a ready accepted first would bump nothing. `onReady`, `onClose` and `close()`
   *  invalidate it synchronously; only the inventory's fleet sweep publishes into it. */
  readonly identity: FleetIdentityCell = new FleetIdentityCell();
```

(c) `onReady`. Before:
```ts
  private onReady(frame: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    this.ready = true;
```
After:
```ts
  private onReady(frame: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    // Path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2: FIRST. It comes before every field below and before `setState` and the
    // connect listeners that run synchronously at the end of this function, so every listener (index.ts's inventory
    // trigger among them) already reads the new epoch, with nothing measured under it.
    this.identity.invalidate('awaiting-inventory');
    this.ready = true;
```

(d) `onClose`. Before:
```ts
    if (ws !== this.socket) return; // a stale handler for a socket we already replaced
    this.socket = null;
```
After:
```ts
    if (ws !== this.socket) return; // a stale handler for a socket we already replaced
    // Path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2: right after the guard, before the pending rejections, the synthesized pty
    // exits and `markDown`'s state listeners, so none of them can read the closed connection's node as known.
    this.identity.invalidate('link-down');
    this.socket = null;
```

(e) `close()`. Before:
```ts
    this.stopHeartbeat();
    this.rejectAllPending(new Error('disconnected'));
    this.tailListeners.clear();
```
After:

- [ ] **Step 9: `server/src/refreshcaps.ts`: write `ccdVerbs` only on the epoch it was asked under**

Before:
```ts
import type { FleetClient, FleetState } from './remote/client.js';
```
After:
```ts
import type { FleetIdentityCell } from './fleetidentity.js';
import type { FleetClient, FleetState } from './remote/client.js';
```

Before:
```ts
export function makeRefreshCaps(client: Pick<FleetClient, 'caps'>, state: FleetState): () => Promise<void> {
  return async () => {
    const verbs = await client.caps();
    if (verbs !== null) state.ccdVerbs = verbs;
  };
}
```
After:
```ts
//
// THE EPOCH (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). `ccdVerbs` survives a close, so a `caps` answer asked on one
// connection and landing after a close (and perhaps a fresh ready) would describe another connection's agent to
// every reader of this one. It is written only when the connection epoch is the one it was asked under. Otherwise
// it is dropped: the next ready's frame and the next minute's refresh measure the current agent.
export function makeRefreshCaps(
  client: Pick<FleetClient, 'caps'>, state: FleetState, identity: Pick<FleetIdentityCell, 'epochNow'>,
): () => Promise<void> {
  return async () => {
    const asked = identity.epochNow();
    const verbs = await client.caps();
    if (verbs !== null && identity.epochNow() === asked) state.ccdVerbs = verbs;
  };
}
```

(b) After `nodeIdFrom`. Before:

After:
```ts
export function nodeIdFrom(read: NodeFileRead): string | null {
  const line = firstLine(read);
  return line !== null && NODE_ID_RE.test(line) ? line : null;
}

/** Each node-id read failure keeps its own word (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). `nodeIdFrom`'s one `null`
 *  serves the row's keying, which falls back to the label for all four conditions; identity tells them apart. */
const NODE_ID_UNREAD: Readonly<Record<Extract<NodeFileRead, { ok: false }>['reason'], FleetIdentityUnmeasuredWhy>> = {
  absent: 'node-id-absent', unreadable: 'node-id-unreadable', 'too-large': 'node-id-too-large',
};

/** One sweep's answer as switch identity (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.9). It answers `known` ONLY from
 *  this sweep's own direct read of `node-id`, validated by `nodeIdFrom` (the row's one validator), and only when the
 *  sweep measured the row AND keyed it by that same id. It never answers from `outcome.nodeId` alone, because that
 *  may be the connection label (no node-id read) or a uuid carried forward from the persisted row that this sweep
 *  never read. A collision is `collision` and never known, whatever the release push counts it as. A disagreement
 *  between the direct read and the outcome should be unreachable; it reads `node-id-malformed`. */
export function fleetNodeMeasuredOf(nodeIdRead: NodeFileRead, outcome: SweepOutcome, measuredAt: number): FleetNodeMeasured {
  if (outcome.result === 'node-id-collision') return { kind: 'collision', why: 'node-id-keys-another-live-row' };
  if (outcome.result === 'unreachable') return { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'link-down' };
  if (outcome.result !== 'measured') return { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'inventory-refused' };
  if (!nodeIdRead.ok) return { kind: 'unmeasured', why: NODE_ID_UNREAD[nodeIdRead.reason] };
  const direct = nodeIdFrom(nodeIdRead);
  if (direct === null || direct !== outcome.nodeId) return { kind: 'unmeasured', why: 'node-id-malformed' };
  return { kind: 'known', nodeId: direct, measuredAt };
}
```

```ts
}
export interface InventoryDeps {

   *  which fails closed. */

   *  not the fleet node's. Absent: nothing is published. */
  ownIdentity?: FleetIdentityPublisher;
  budgetMs?: number;
}
```

(e) `sweepFleet`, the whole function and its docstring. Before:
```ts
/** C1's twin for the one agent connection. Same isolation, same reason. */
async function sweepFleet(deps: InventoryDeps, fleet: NonNullable<InventoryDeps['fleet']>, budget: number, now: number): Promise<SweepOutcome> {
  try {
    const { io, state } = fleet;
    if (!linkUp(state)) return unreachable(deps.store, now);
    // `agentOps` is read inside the connected arm only: the field keeps the
    // last `ready`'s answer across a drop (Task 8).
    const fleetReads = await readNodeFiles(io, deps.ccrcDir, budget);
    const m = measurementFrom(fleetReads, { label: FLEET_LABEL, role: 'fleet', agentOps: state.agentOps ?? [] }, now);
    return linkUp(state) ? applyMeasurement(deps.store, m, reportUnmeasured(fleetReads.report), now) : unreachable(deps.store, now);
  } catch (err) {
    return { label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'error', message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
}
```
After:
```ts
/** C1's twin for the one agent connection. Same isolation, same reason.
 *
 *  THE IDENTITY (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2). The connection epoch is captured HERE, before the sweep's one
 *  await, and the node this sweep read is published under it after the apply. A ready or a close accepted while the
 *  reads were out has moved the epoch, so the publication answers `stale-epoch` and changes nothing: an earlier
 *  connection's reads never become the current node. `linkUp` cannot tell this, because a drop and a reconnect read
 *  `connected: true`. The row is written exactly as before, and the sweep the new ready triggers re-measures it
 *  under the new epoch. A link down at the start reads nothing and publishes nothing; the close that took it down
 *  already invalidated the cell. */
async function sweepFleet(deps: InventoryDeps, fleet: NonNullable<InventoryDeps['fleet']>, budget: number, now: number): Promise<SweepOutcome> {
  const identity = fleet.identity === undefined ? null : { cell: fleet.identity, captured: fleet.identity.epochNow() };
  let nodeIdRead: NodeFileRead | null = null;
  let out: SweepOutcome;
  try {
    const { io, state } = fleet;
    if (!linkUp(state)) return unreachable(deps.store, now);
    // `agentOps` is read inside the connected arm only: the field keeps the
    // last `ready`'s answer across a drop (Task 8).
    const fleetReads = await readNodeFiles(io, deps.ccrcDir, budget);
    nodeIdRead = fleetReads.nodeId;
    const m = measurementFrom(fleetReads, { label: FLEET_LABEL, role: 'fleet', agentOps: state.agentOps ?? [] }, now);
    out = linkUp(state) ? applyMeasurement(deps.store, m, reportUnmeasured(fleetReads.report), now) : unreachable(deps.store, now);
  } catch (err) {
    out = { label: FLEET_LABEL, result: 'error', message: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) };
  }
  if (identity !== null && nodeIdRead !== null) identity.cell.publish(identity.captured, fleetNodeMeasuredOf(nodeIdRead, out, now));
  return out;
}
```

```bash
feat(fleet): a connection-bound fleet identity, invalidated on ready and close (path-identity §5.2)

The collector switch's Settings arm binds to the fleet node measured on
the current connection, never to the persisted inventory row. This adds
that measurement:

- fleetidentity.ts holds one synchronous memory cell: an epoch, and the
  current node as known, unmeasured with its reason, or a collision that
  carries no node id. It imports nothing and reads no clock.
  NO_FLEET_IDENTITY is the never-known reader for a Deps built without
  a cell;
- the fleet client invalidates the cell as the first statement of every
  accepted ready, right after a close's stale-socket guard, and in
  close(), so no listener reads the old connection's node. The epoch
  stays off FleetState;
- a caps answer is written only when the epoch is unchanged across its
  await;
- the inventory captures the epoch before its one await. It publishes
  only the direct node-id read, validated by nodeIdFrom and checked
  against the measured row, and never the label fallback, a carried uuid
  or a collision. A refused or failed apply publishes inventory-refused;
- in local mode the server row's own sweep publishes into a cell that is
  never invalidated. In remote mode the server row never publishes;
- Deps.fleetIdentity is optional. index.ts wires the client's cell and
  the local cell, and runInventory hands the cell to the sweep by mode.
EOF
```

### Task 6: Persistence: the migration, the row reader, the journal adapter and the one writer

**Model routing:** **`opus`, effort `xhigh`**. This task builds the durable half of the proof that a database-only rollback cannot arm deletion. The order "journal first, then database" is what makes a `coord.db` snapshot detectable.

**Why (the rulings this task carries):**
- **R8, storage.**
  - The table is `collect_lane_settings`. It is a singleton (`id = 1`), with camelCase columns, no SQL check on `choice`, and an exact seed `{off, NULL, NULL, 0, 0}`. It takes the next free migration slot.
  - The journal is `~/.ccrc/collect-lane-generation.log`, resolved through `cfg.ccrcDir`. Every append fsyncs the file, and a create also fsyncs its directory. Reads are capped at 1 MiB, and a larger file reads `unreadable`. The strict grammar belongs to L1's parser.
  - The server never inserts an absent row.
- **R15.** There is exactly one DB writer, `CoordStore.setCollectLane`, and exactly one journal append adapter. Task 10 pins both. This task builds them so the pins hold.
- **R28.** `Deps.collectLane?: { journal; bootNonce }` is one object. "No journal dependency" therefore has a single spelling: the field is absent.
- **R30.** L1's `isCollectLaneKebab` becomes the kebab scanner's next union in this commit, because the new adapter in `server/src/coord/` spells `'not-regular'`.
- **R33.** `coord-db.test.ts` changes only at its schema-version pins. New migration cases go in a new file.
- **R19 and Task 0 (f3).**
  - #351 holds `store.ts` and `schema.ts`.
  - This task's `store.ts` edits sit at the class end, after `updateEpoch()`, plus one import line. Its `schema.ts` edit sits just before the array's closing `];`.

- **The store writes no quoted kebab literal.** Every store-internal discriminant is a single word: `written`, `unchanged`, `refused`, `failed`, `appended`, `decide`, `append`, `update`, `commit`.

```ts
// Child reclamation wave 10 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2): the collector switch's table is ONE new MIGRATIONS
// entry with an exact seed. Its slot is found by its DDL and never hard-coded: the delegation-broker wave 3 plan names
// the same slot, and whichever branch merges second moves up without editing a line here. Fixture coord.db files only.
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { COORD_SCHEMA_VERSION, openCoordDb, tx } from '../src/coord/db.js';
import { MIGRATIONS } from '../src/coord/schema.js';
import { CoordStore } from '../src/coord/store.js';
import { mkTmp, removeTmpFixtures } from './tmpHelpers.js';

afterEach(removeTmpFixtures);

/** The needle stops at the NAME: `_` is a word character, so `collect_lane_settings_new` (SQLite's rebuild idiom, a
 *  legitimate later migration) is not a second create of this table. The stall_settings case's rule. */
const CREATE = /CREATE TABLE collect_lane_settings(?![A-Za-z0-9_])/;
const SLOT = MIGRATIONS.findIndex((m) => CREATE.test(m)) + 1;
const dbPathIn = (home: string): string => path.join(home, '.ccrc', 'coord.db');
const SEED = { id: 1, choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 0, updatedAt: 0 };
const SEED_SQL = 'SELECT id, choice, fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt, generation, updatedAt FROM collect_lane_settings';
const objectNames = (db: DatabaseSync): string[] =>
  (db.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table', 'index') AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'").all() as
    unknown as { name: string }[]).map((r) => r.name);
/** A database at exactly the version before this entry, carrying one program and one run. */
const plantedBefore = (prefix: string): string => {
  const p = dbPathIn(mkTmp(prefix));
  mkdirSync(path.dirname(p), { recursive: true });
  const raw = new DatabaseSync(p);
  tx(raw, () => {
    for (let v = 0; v < SLOT - 1; v++) raw.exec(MIGRATIONS[v]!);
    raw.exec(`PRAGMA user_version = ${SLOT - 1}`);
    raw.exec("INSERT INTO programs (slug, title, createdAt, state) VALUES ('p', 'P', 1, 'active')");
    raw.exec("INSERT INTO runs (program, wave, waveOf, project, state, claimedBy, openedAt) " +
             "VALUES ('p', 1, 1, 'demo', 'working', 'c', 1)");
  });
  raw.close();
  return p;
};

describe('the switch\u2019s table is one new entry with an exact seed (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2)', () => {
  it('the slot is found by DDL, created once, never amended into a frozen entry', () => {
    expect(SLOT, 'no MIGRATIONS entry creates collect_lane_settings').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(19);
    expect(MIGRATIONS.filter((m) => CREATE.test(m)).length, 'more than one entry creates collect_lane_settings').toBe(1);
    expect(MIGRATIONS.slice(0, SLOT - 1).some((m) => m.includes('collect_lane_settings')),
      'collect_lane_settings was amended into a frozen entry').toBe(false);
  });

  it('the entry alone adds exactly collect_lane_settings and seeds the one row', () => {
    expect(SLOT, 'no MIGRATIONS entry creates collect_lane_settings').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(19);
    // A NEW TABLE AND NOTHING ELSE: one CREATE and its seed, no ALTER of an older build's table.
    expect(MIGRATIONS[SLOT - 1]!.trim()).toMatch(
      /^CREATE TABLE collect_lane_settings \([^;]*\);\s*INSERT INTO collect_lane_settings \(id, choice, fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt, generation, updatedAt\)\s*VALUES \(1, 'off', NULL, NULL, 0, 0\);$/);
    const raw = new DatabaseSync(plantedBefore('ccrc-mig-collectlane-'));
    const had = objectNames(raw);
    raw.exec(MIGRATIONS[SLOT - 1]!);
    expect(objectNames(raw).filter((n) => !had.includes(n)).sort()).toEqual(['collect_lane_settings']);
    expect(raw.prepare(SEED_SQL).all()).toEqual([SEED]);
    raw.close();
  });

  it('openCoordDb reaches a database one version before it and keeps its rows', () => {
    const db = openCoordDb(plantedBefore('ccrc-mig-collectlane-open-'));
    expect(db.prepare('PRAGMA user_version').get()).toMatchObject({ user_version: COORD_SCHEMA_VERSION });
    expect(db.prepare(SEED_SQL).all()).toEqual([SEED]);
    expect(db.prepare('SELECT claimedBy, state FROM runs').all()).toEqual([{ claimedBy: 'c', state: 'working' }]);
    db.close();
  });

  it('the columns and their nullability', () => {
    const db = openCoordDb(dbPathIn(mkTmp('ccrc-mig-collectlane-cols-')));
    const cols = (db.prepare('PRAGMA table_info(collect_lane_settings)').all() as unknown as
      { name: string; type: string; notnull: number; dflt_value: unknown; pk: number }[])
      .map((c) => [c.name, c.type, c.notnull, c.dflt_value, c.pk]);
    expect(cols).toEqual([
      ['id', 'INTEGER', 0, null, 1], ['choice', 'TEXT', 1, null, 0], ['fleetNodeId', 'TEXT', 0, null, 0],
      ['markerRetiredAt', 'INTEGER', 0, null, 0], ['generation', 'INTEGER', 1, null, 0], ['updatedAt', 'INTEGER', 1, null, 0],
    ]);
    db.close();
  });

  it('the singleton check refuses id 2', () => {

  it('no SQL check on choice', () => {

  it('an older build opening the new version takes the read-as-is rule and boots', () => {
    // A test cannot run an older db.ts. It puts THIS build where an older build stands: the file is one version past
    // COORD_SCHEMA_VERSION, as a file carrying this entry is one version past a build from before it. Rule 3 (db.ts)
    // warns, reads as-is and migrates nothing. An older build never names this table, and every read it makes names
    // its own columns.

      expect(db.prepare('PRAGMA user_version').get()).toMatchObject({ user_version: COORD_SCHEMA_VERSION + 1 });
```

```ts
  it('the durability acts stand in the code: the file fsync, the directory fsync on create, a reopen without O_CREAT', () => {
    // No test can intercept a direct `node:fs` sync call, so these are pinned by text (codeOnly: comments stripped,
    // strings kept). Deleting one, or adding `O_CREAT` to the reopen, reds this case.
    const code = codeOnly(readFileSync(ADAPTER, 'utf8'));
    expect(code.match(/\bfsyncSync\(fd\)/g) ?? [], 'the file fsync').toHaveLength(1);
    expect(code, 'the directory fsync on create').toMatch(/if \(created\) \{\s*const dfd = openSync\(dir, FS\.O_RDONLY\);\s*try \{ fsyncSync\(dfd\); \}/);
    expect(code, 'the reopen after EEXIST').toMatch(/^\s*fd = openSync\(logPath, FS\.O_RDWR \| FS\.O_APPEND \| FS\.O_NOFOLLOW\);$/m);
  });
```

```ts
// Child reclamation wave 10 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.3, §5.9): the collector switch's row reader and its
// ONE writer. A fixture coord.db (mkTmp) and the real journal adapter at a fixture path, wrapped where a case must count
// or fail its calls. Never a live coord.db, never a journal resolved from the real HOME.
import { describe, it, expect, afterEach, vi } from 'vitest';
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
import {
  appendFileSync, chmodSync, copyFileSync, existsSync, lstatSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync,

import path from 'node:path';
import { openCoordDb } from '../src/coord/db.js';
import { CoordStore, type CollectLaneWrite } from '../src/coord/store.js';
import { collectLaneJournalAt, defaultCollectLaneJournalPath } from '../src/coord/collectLaneJournal.js';
import {
  collectLaneControl, collectLaneEffective, measureCollectLaneRow,
  type CollectLaneControl, type CollectLaneJournal, type CollectLaneRowRead, type CollectLaneWriteRequest,

import { mkTmp, removeTmpFixtures } from './tmpHelpers.js';

afterEach(removeTmpFixtures);

const AT = Date.parse('2026-10-12T12:00:00Z');
const NODE_A = '0f1e2d3c-4b5a-4968-8778-695a4b3c2d1e';
const NODE_B = '1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d';
const ROOT_USER = process.getuid?.() === 0;

type Journal = CollectLaneJournal & { readonly logPath: string };
/** A store on a fresh fixture database, its file (for a second connection), its HOME and the journal beside it. */
const opened = (): { s: CoordStore; file: string; home: string; j: Journal } => {
  const home = mkTmp('ccrc-collect-lane-store-');
  const file = path.join(home, '.ccrc', 'coord.db');
  return { s: new CoordStore(openCoordDb(file)), file, home,
    j: collectLaneJournalAt(defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(path.join(home, '.ccrc'))) };
};
/** The row exactly as SQLite holds it, read without the store, every INTEGER as a bigint. */
const rawRow = (s: CoordStore): unknown => {
  const st = s.db.prepare('SELECT id, choice, fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt, generation, updatedAt FROM collect_lane_settings');
  st.setReadBigInts(true);
  return st.all();
};
const SEED_READ: CollectLaneRowRead =
  { kind: 'row', row: { choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 0n, updatedAt: 0n } };
const SEED_RAW = { id: 1n, choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 0n, updatedAt: 0n };

/** Each request with its expectations taken NOW, from the store and the journal it will be written through. */
const live = (s: CoordStore, j: CollectLaneJournal, fleetNodeId: string): CollectLaneWriteRequest =>
  ({ kind: 'live', fleetNodeId, expected: s.collectLaneRow(), expectedJournal: j.read() });
const retire = (s: CoordStore, j: CollectLaneJournal): CollectLaneWriteRequest =>
  ({ kind: 'retire', expected: s.collectLaneRow(), expectedJournal: j.read() });
const OFF: CollectLaneWriteRequest = { kind: 'off' };

/** A journal that records each call into `log`, then delegates to `inner`, or throws `fail` from the append. */
const recorder = (inner: CollectLaneJournal, log: string[], o: { onAppend?: () => void; fail?: Error } = {}):
  CollectLaneJournal & { appends(): number } => ({
  read: () => { log.push('journal'); return inner.read(); },
  appendGeneration: (generation: number) => {
    log.push(`append:${generation}`);
    o.onAppend?.();
    if (o.fail !== undefined) throw o.fail;
    inner.appendGeneration(generation);
  },
  appends: () => log.filter((e) => e.startsWith('append:')).length,
});
const fileBytes = (p: string): Buffer | null => (existsSync(p) && lstatSync(p).isFile() ? readFileSync(p) : null);
/** Writes through a counting journal and proves the call consumed nothing: no append, the row and the journal file
 *  byte-identical. Returns the answer for the case's own assertion. */
const consumesNothing = (s: CoordStore, j: Journal, req: CollectLaneWriteRequest, at = AT): CollectLaneWrite => {
  const rowBefore = rawRow(s);
  const fileBefore = fileBytes(j.logPath);
  const rec = recorder(j, []);
  const w = s.setCollectLane(req, at, rec);
  expect(rec.appends(), 'a generation was appended').toBe(0);
  expect(rawRow(s)).toEqual(rowBefore);
  expect(fileBytes(j.logPath)).toEqual(fileBefore);
  return w;
};
const fsError = (message: string, code: unknown): Error => Object.assign(new Error(message), { code });
const controlOf = (s: CoordStore, j: CollectLaneJournal): CollectLaneControl =>
  collectLaneControl(measureCollectLaneRow(s.collectLaneRow()), j.read());

describe('collectLaneRow reads the row raw (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2)', () => {
  it('collectLaneRow reads every value raw: the seed as bigints, a deleted row as absent, a dropped table as unreadable, never a throw', () => {
    const { s } = opened();
    expect(s.collectLaneRow()).toEqual(SEED_READ);
    s.db.exec('UPDATE collect_lane_settings SET generation = 9223372036854775807');
    expect(s.collectLaneRow()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'row', row: { generation: 9223372036854775807n } });
    s.db.exec('DELETE FROM collect_lane_settings');
    expect(s.collectLaneRow()).toEqual({ kind: 'absent' });
    s.db.exec('DROP TABLE collect_lane_settings');
    const r = s.collectLaneRow();
    expect(r.kind).toBe('unreadable');
    expect(r.kind === 'unreadable' ? r.detail : '').toMatch(/no such table/);

    expect(rawRow(c.s)).toEqual([{ id: 1n, choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, markerRetiredAt: BigInt(AT + 5),
      generation: 2n, updatedAt: BigInt(AT + 5) }]);
    // Set: unchanged.
    expect(consumesNothing(c.s, c.j, retire(c.s, c.j), AT + 9)).toEqual({ kind: 'unchanged', before: c.s.collectLaneRow() });
  });

  it('an absent row refuses everything and nothing is inserted', () => {
    const { s, j } = opened();
    s.db.exec('DELETE FROM collect_lane_settings');
    for (const req of [live(s, j, NODE_A), OFF, retire(s, j)]) {
      expect(consumesNothing(s, j, req), req.kind).toMatchObject({ kind: 'refused', code: 'state-unmeasurable' });
    }
    expect(rawRow(s)).toEqual([]);
    expect(j.read()).toEqual({ kind: 'missing' });
  });

  it('failed.code is an errno word, never a path', () => {
    const { s, home, j } = opened();
    const named = fsError(`EACCES: permission denied, open '${j.logPath}'`, 'EACCES');
    const w = s.setCollectLane(live(s, j, NODE_A), AT, recorder(j, [], { fail: named }));
    expect(w).toEqual({ kind: 'failed', phase: 'append', code: 'EACCES' });
    expect(JSON.stringify(w)).not.toContain(home);
    const wordless = fsError(`a failure at ${j.logPath}`, 42);
    expect(s.setCollectLane(live(s, j, NODE_A), AT, recorder(j, [], { fail: wordless })))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'failed', phase: 'append', code: 'UNKNOWN' });
    if (!ROOT_USER) {
      // The real adapter, in a directory it cannot create the journal in: Node's message names the path; the answer does not.
      const roHome = mkTmp('ccrc-collect-lane-ro-');
      const roDir = path.join(roHome, 'ro');
      mkdirSync(roDir);
      chmodSync(roDir, 0o500);
      try {
        const ro = collectLaneJournalAt(defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(roDir));
        const wr = s.setCollectLane(live(s, ro, NODE_A), AT, ro);
        expect(wr).toEqual({ kind: 'failed', phase: 'append', code: 'EACCES' });
        expect(JSON.stringify(wr)).not.toContain(roHome);
      } finally {
        chmodSync(roDir, 0o700);
      }
    }
    expect(rawRow(s)).toEqual([SEED_RAW]);
  });

  it('a defect before the append propagates as itself, never as a failed answer', () => {
    const { s, j } = opened();
    const broken: CollectLaneJournal = {
      read: () => { throw new Error('a journal read must never throw'); },
      appendGeneration: (g: number) => j.appendGeneration(g),
    };
    expect(() => s.setCollectLane(OFF, AT, broken)).toThrow('a journal read must never throw');
    const spy = vi.spyOn(s, 'collectLaneRow').mockImplementation(() => { throw new Error('a row read must never throw'); });
    try {
      expect(() => s.setCollectLane(OFF, AT, j)).toThrow('a row read must never throw');
    } finally {
      spy.mockRestore();
    }
    expect(rawRow(s)).toEqual([SEED_RAW]);
    // Rolled back: the next write opens its own transaction.
    expect(s.setCollectLane(retire(s, j), AT, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 1 });
  });
});

describe('snapshots (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.3, §5.9)', () => {
  const NODE_NOW = { kind: 'known', connectionEpoch: 1, nodeId: NODE_A, measuredAt: AT } as const;
  const effective = (control: CollectLaneControl, marker: boolean) => collectLaneEffective({
    switches: { paused: false, marker }, epoch: { before: 1, after: 1 }, caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true },
    control, node: NODE_NOW,
  });
  /** A `VACUUM INTO` copy of the database as it stands: the backup's own mechanism (backup-coord.mjs). */
  const snapshot = (s: CoordStore): string => {
    const p = path.join(mkTmp('ccrc-collect-lane-snap-'), 'coord.db');
    s.db.prepare('VACUUM INTO ?').run(p);
    return p;
  };
  const restored = (p: string): CoordStore => new CoordStore(openCoordDb(p));

  it('a stale same-node Live snapshot is stopped by the later journal', () => {
    const { s, j } = opened();
    expect(s.setCollectLane(retire(s, j), AT, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 1 });
    expect(s.setCollectLane(live(s, j, NODE_A), AT + 1, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 2 });
    const snap = snapshot(s);
    expect(s.setCollectLane(OFF, AT + 2, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 3 });
    expect(effective(controlOf(s, j), false), 'CONTROL: the live database is Off').toMatchObject({ kind: 'shadowed', why: 'off' });
    const old = restored(snap);
    expect(old.collectLaneRow()).toMatchObject({ kind: 'row', row: { choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: NODE_A, generation: 2n } });
    expect(controlOf(old, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'mismatch', journalMax: 3, rowGeneration: 2 });
    expect(effective(controlOf(old, j), false)).toEqual({ kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'generation-mismatch' });
  });

  it('a pre-latch snapshot cannot revive the marker', () => {
    const { s, j } = opened();
    const snap = snapshot(s);
    expect(s.setCollectLane(retire(s, j), AT, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 1 });
    expect(effective(controlOf(s, j), true), 'CONTROL: after the latch a re-created marker is ignored')
      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'shadowed', why: 'off', notes: { markerRecreated: true } });
    const old = restored(snap);
    const noJournal = collectLaneJournalAt(defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(path.join(mkTmp('ccrc-collect-lane-none-'), '.ccrc')));
    expect(effective(controlOf(old, noJournal), true), 'CONTROL: the same snapshot with no journal is the bootstrap, live by the file')
      .toMatchObject({ kind: 'live', armedBy: 'legacy-marker' });
    expect(controlOf(old, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'mismatch', journalMax: 1, rowGeneration: 0 });
    expect(effective(controlOf(old, j), true)).toEqual({ kind: 'safety-stopped', why: 'generation-mismatch' });
  });

  it('restoring both files to one older point is coherent: the stated whole-state boundary', () => {
    // Spec §5.3: "Restore both database and journal to the same older point | The older pair is coherent; this design
    // cannot detect a whole-state rollback." Pinned so the boundary is measured, not claimed: after such a restore the
    // operator raises the cleanup pause and makes a fresh confirmed Settings transition before allowing Live.
    const { s, j } = opened();
    expect(s.setCollectLane(retire(s, j), AT, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 1 });
    expect(s.setCollectLane(live(s, j, NODE_A), AT + 1, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 2 });
    const snap = snapshot(s);
    const kept = defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(path.join(mkTmp('ccrc-collect-lane-kept-'), '.ccrc'));
    mkdirSync(path.dirname(kept), { recursive: true });
    copyFileSync(j.logPath, kept);
    expect(s.setCollectLane(OFF, AT + 2, j)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'written', generation: 3 });
    const old = restored(snap);
    const oldJournal = collectLaneJournalAt(kept);
    expect(controlOf(old, oldJournal)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'coherent', generation: 2 });
    expect(effective(controlOf(old, oldJournal), false)).toMatchObject({ kind: 'live', armedBy: 'settings' });
  });
});
```

(b) Create `server/src/coord/collectLaneJournal.ts`:

```ts
// The collector switch's generation journal, ring L3 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2, §5.3): the ONE adapter that
// reads and appends `~/.ccrc/collect-lane-generation.log` on the SERVER box. It implements the port its consumers
// declare, `CollectLaneJournal` (`collectLane.ts`, L1), and decides nothing: every byte it reads goes to L1's
// `parseCollectLaneJournal`, the journal's one strict parser.
//
// NOT the update-intent and pool-edge journals' twin in how it reads. Those parse leniently, count a torn tail and tell
// the operator to rebuild them from coord.db. This file is the proof that coord.db did NOT move backward, so a torn,
// truncated, blank or non-increasing file is `malformed`, and nothing in the tree rebuilds it from the row it exists to
// distrust (spec §5.2, §5.3).
//
// - `read()` never throws. ENOENT is the ONLY `missing` (the bootstrap, beside the exact seed). The open never follows a
//   link (`O_NOFOLLOW`: a symlink, a dangling one included, is `not-regular`, never missing) and never waits
//   (`O_NONBLOCK`: a FIFO swapped in answers at once). `fstat` on the open descriptor decides the kind, with no
//   lstat-then-open race. The read is bounded at COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES, and past it the answer is
//   `unreadable` `EFBIG`, so a hostile or runaway file cannot stall the store's `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`.
// - `appendGeneration()` writes exactly `{"generation":g}\n` in ONE write, led by `\n` when the file lacks its final
//   newline (so a torn tail never fuses with the next record). It fsyncs the file, and fsyncs the directory when it
//   created the file. It throws on every failure, its `code` an errno word. `CoordStore.setCollectLane` is its one
//   caller, inside its transaction, BEFORE the row changes.
// - No answer and no thrown code carries the path. A Node fs error's `message` names it, so only its `code` is read
//   (spec §5.6: responses never expose the journal path).
// - Synchronous on purpose: the store calls it inside `tx()`, and `DatabaseSync`'s no-async rule is the argument.
import { closeSync, constants as FS, fstatSync, fsyncSync, mkdirSync, openSync, readSync, writeSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { isPositiveDecimalSafeInteger } from '../../../shared/api.js';
import { parseCollectLaneJournal, type CollectLaneJournal, type CollectLaneJournalRead } from '../collectLane.js';

/** The journal's basename, spelled once in code; every other code reference names it through this constant. */
export const COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_BASENAME = 'collect-lane-generation.log';
/** The read cap: one record per operator transition is about twenty bytes, so 1 MiB is never a real journal. */
export const COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES = 1048576;

/** `~/.ccrc/collect-lane-generation.log`, resolved through `cfg.ccrcDir`, never through the home directory: the
 *  `update-intent.log` precedent. `index.ts` calls it once. */
export function defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(ccrcDir: string): string {
  return path.join(ccrcDir, COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_BASENAME);
}

/** The errno word of a thrown error (`ENOENT`, `ELOOP`, `EACCES`), never its message, which names the path. An error
 *  with no errno word answers `UNKNOWN`. */
const errnoOf = (err: unknown): string => {
  const code = typeof err === 'object' && err !== null ? (err as { code?: unknown }).code : undefined;
  return typeof code === 'string' && /^E[A-Z0-9]+$/.test(code) ? code : 'UNKNOWN';
};
/** An error this adapter raises itself: a fixed message with no path, and its errno word. */
const fault = (message: string, code: string): Error => Object.assign(new Error(message), { code });

/** The journal at `logPath`. Tests build one under a fixture HOME; production builds exactly one, in `index.ts`. */
export function collectLaneJournalAt(logPath: string): CollectLaneJournal & { readonly logPath: string } {
  return {
    logPath,
    read(): CollectLaneJournalRead {
      let fd: number;
      try {
        fd = openSync(logPath, FS.O_RDONLY | FS.O_NOFOLLOW | FS.O_NONBLOCK);
      } catch (err) {
        const code = errnoOf(err);
        if (code === 'ENOENT') return { kind: 'missing' };
        if (code === 'ELOOP') return { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: 'symlink' };
        return { kind: 'unreadable', code };
      }
      try {
        const st = fstatSync(fd);
        if (!st.isFile()) return { kind: 'not-regular', fileKind: st.isDirectory() ? 'directory' : 'other' };
        const buf = Buffer.allocUnsafe(COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES + 1);
        let n = 0;
        while (n < buf.length) {
          const got = readSync(fd, buf, n, buf.length - n, null);
          if (got === 0) break;
          n += got;
        }
        if (n > COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_MAX_BYTES) return { kind: 'unreadable', code: 'EFBIG' };
        return parseCollectLaneJournal(buf.toString('utf8', 0, n));
      } catch (err) {
        return { kind: 'unreadable', code: errnoOf(err) };
      } finally {
        try { closeSync(fd); } catch { /* the answer above stands */ }
      }
    },
    appendGeneration(generation: number): void {
      if (!isPositiveDecimalSafeInteger(generation)) {
        throw Object.assign(new RangeError('a journal generation is a positive safe integer'), { code: 'ERANGE' });
      }
      const dir = path.dirname(logPath);
      mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      let fd: number;
      let created = false;
      try {
        fd = openSync(logPath, FS.O_RDWR | FS.O_APPEND | FS.O_CREAT | FS.O_EXCL | FS.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o600);
        created = true;
      } catch (err) {
        if (errnoOf(err) !== 'EEXIST') throw err;
        // It exists: open it as it stands. Never re-created here, so a file removed between the two opens fails ENOENT.
        fd = openSync(logPath, FS.O_RDWR | FS.O_APPEND | FS.O_NOFOLLOW);
      }
      try {
        const st = fstatSync(fd);
        if (!st.isFile()) throw fault('the generation journal is not a regular file', 'EFTYPE');
        let lead = '';
        if (st.size > 0) {
          const last = Buffer.alloc(1);
          if (readSync(fd, last, 0, 1, st.size - 1) !== 1) throw fault('the last byte of the generation journal did not read', 'EIO');
          if (last[0] !== 0x0a) lead = '\n';
        }
        const bytes = Buffer.from(`${lead}{"generation":${generation}}\n`, 'utf8');
        if (writeSync(fd, bytes) !== bytes.length) throw fault('a short write to the generation journal', 'EIO');
        fsyncSync(fd);
      } finally {
        closeSync(fd);
      }
      if (created) {
        const dfd = openSync(dir, FS.O_RDONLY);
        try { fsyncSync(dfd); } finally { closeSync(dfd); }
      }
    },
  };
}
```

**The class end.** Before:
