```ts
// CHILD RECLAMATION WAVE 10 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.9: "Exactly one database writer and one journal append
// adapter exist; only POST and automatic latch call the writer"). APPENDED, for the reason the blocks above state:
// `session-hook.test.ts`'s citation audit cites this file by line. Settings now arms the temp-root collector beside the
// hand-touched legacy file, so what may move the switch is pinned as text:
// - the store's one writer is called by the route's POST and the one latch helper, and by nothing else;
// - the generation journal is appended by one adapter, from inside that writer only, and its basename is spelled once;
// - the resolver that turns the switch into a licence is called by the executor and the GET's view composer alone;
// - the latch helper is called by the executor and the lane's pass alone.
// The call census reads server/src only: the PWA's client method of the same name posts to the route and is not the
// store's writer, and the PWA cannot import server/src. Code lines only (`stallCode`): a sentence about a call is never a
// call. KNOWN WIDTH: a call spelled inside a string on a code line counts, which errs toward red. A call through an
// alias (`const w = store.setCollectLane; w(…)`) is not seen; the bar is the ordinary call.
describe('child reclamation wave 10: the collector switch has one writer, one journal and one resolver', () => {
  const STORE = 'server/src/coord/store.ts';
  const ROUTES = 'server/src/coord/routes.ts';
  const EXECUTOR = 'server/src/coord/collectTempRoot.ts';
  const LANE = 'server/src/collectLane.ts';
  const ADAPTER = 'server/src/coord/collectLaneJournal.ts';
  const WATCH = 'server/src/watch.ts';
  const SERVER = ALL.filter((f) => rel(f).startsWith('server/src/'));
  const code = (r: string): string => stallCode(path.join(ccrcRoot, r));
  /** A call or a method head: the name and its paren, never after `function ` (a declaration). */
  const CALL = (n: string): RegExp => new RegExp(`(?<!function\\s+)\\b${n}\\s*\\(`, 'g');
  const count = (text: string, re: RegExp): number => [...text.matchAll(re)].length;
  /** `file:n` for every server/src file whose code lines match `re` (global) n times, sorted. */
  const sitesOf = (re: RegExp): string[] => SERVER.flatMap((f) => {
    const n = count(stallCode(f), re);
    return n === 0 ? [] : [`${rel(f)}:${n}`];
  }).sort();
  const DEF_FN = (n: string): RegExp => new RegExp(`^\\s*(?:export\\s+)?(?:async\\s+)?function\\s+${n}\\b`, 'm');
  const DEF_VAL = (n: string): RegExp => new RegExp(`^\\s*(?:export\\s+)?(?:const|let|var)\\s+${n}\\b`, 'm');
  const definers = (re: RegExp): string[] => ALL.filter((f) => re.test(stallCode(f))).map(rel).sort();
  /** Quoted strings and template literals blanked to spaces, newlines kept: a brace inside a quote never moves a
   *  body's end. */
  const unquoted = (t: string): string =>
    t.replace(/'(?:\\.|[^\\'\n])*'|"(?:\\.|[^\\"\n])*"|`(?:\\[\s\S]|[^\\`])*`/g, (m) => m.replace(/[^\n]/g, ' '));
  /** The `{…}` body that opens at the first brace after the first match of `head`; '' when `head` matches nothing. */
  const bodyAfter = (text: string, head: RegExp): string => {
    const at = text.search(head);
    if (at < 0) return '';
    const flat = unquoted(text);
    const open = flat.indexOf('{', at);
    if (open < 0) return '';
    let depth = 0;
    for (let i = open; i < flat.length; i++) {
      if (flat[i] === '{') depth += 1;
      else if (flat[i] === '}') {
        depth -= 1;
        if (depth === 0) return text.slice(open, i + 1);
      }
    }
    return text.slice(open);
  };
  /** The route's POST, from its registration to the next one: `stall-settings-route.test.ts`'s slice. */
  const postSlice = (text: string): string => {
    const decl = "app.post('/api/coord/collect-lane'";
    const at = text.indexOf(decl);
    if (at < 0) return '';
    const next = /app\.(?:get|post)\('/.exec(text.slice(at + decl.length));
    return text.slice(at, next === null ? text.length : at + decl.length + next.index);
  };

  it('CONTROL: the scanners see a call, a method head and a body, and not a declaration, a comment line or a quoted brace', () => {
    expect(count('    const w = deps.coord.setCollectLane(req, at, deps.collectLane.journal);', CALL('setCollectLane'))).toBe(1);
    expect(count('  setCollectLane(req: CollectLaneWriteRequest, at: number, journal: CollectLaneJournal): CollectLaneWrite {',
      CALL('setCollectLane')), 'a method head is a site').toBe(1);
    expect(count('export function collectLaneEffective(i: CollectLaneInputs): CollectLaneEffective {', CALL('collectLaneEffective')))
      .toBe(0);
    expect(count('export async function collectRetireLatch(c: CollectControlDeps): CollectLatchOutcome {', CALL('collectRetireLatch')))
      .toBe(0);
    expect(count(stallCodeText('  // c.coord.setCollectLane(req, at, journal)\n   * collectLaneEffective(i) is called here'),
      CALL('setCollectLane')), 'a comment line is not a call').toBe(0);
    expect(DEF_FN('collectRetireLatch').test(
      'export function collectRetireLatch(c: CollectControlDeps, switches: CollectSwitches, epoch: CollectEpochPair): CollectLatchOutcome {'))
      .toBe(true);
    expect(DEF_FN('collectRetireLatch').test('    const out = collectRetireLatch(deps.control, sw, pair);')).toBe(false);
    const planted = "export function f(): void {\n  const s = '}';\n  g(`${'{'}`);\n  if (x) { h(); }\n}\nexport function k(): void { h(); }\n";
    expect(bodyAfter(planted, /^export function f\(/m), 'the body ends at its own brace, past a quoted one')
      .toBe("{\n  const s = '}';\n  g(`${'{'}`);\n  if (x) { h(); }\n}");
    expect(bodyAfter(planted, /^export function absent\(/m), 'an absent head reads as no body').toBe('');
    const routes = "app.get('/api/coord/collect-lane', a);\napp.post('/api/coord/collect-lane', async () => { w(); });\napp.get('/api/runs', b);\n";
    expect(postSlice(routes)).toBe("app.post('/api/coord/collect-lane', async () => { w(); });\n");
    expect(SERVER.length, 'the walk reached server/src').toBeGreaterThan(30);
    expect(SERVER.map(rel)).toContain(STORE);
  });

  it('setCollectLane is defined in store.ts and called only in the route’s POST and collectRetireLatch', () => {
    expect(sitesOf(/\bsetCollectLane\s*\(/g), 'a second caller, or a second definition')
      .toEqual([`${EXECUTOR}:1`, `${ROUTES}:1`, `${STORE}:1`]);
    expect(code(STORE), 'the store’s one spelling is not the single-line method head')
      .toMatch(/^[ \t]*setCollectLane\s*\([^)]*\)\s*:\s*CollectLaneWrite\s*\{[ \t]*$/m);
    const post = postSlice(code(ROUTES));
    expect(post, 'the POST registration is gone — this scan is over nothing').toContain("app.post('/api/coord/collect-lane'");
    expect(count(post, /\bsetCollectLane\s*\(/g), 'the routes.ts call is not in the POST handler').toBe(1);
    expect(count(bodyAfter(code(EXECUTOR), /^export function collectRetireLatch\(/m), /\bsetCollectLane\s*\(/g),
      'the executor file’s call is not in the latch helper').toBe(1);
  });

  it('appendGeneration is defined once, in the adapter, and called once, in setCollectLane', () => {
    expect(sitesOf(/\.appendGeneration\s*\(/g), 'a second caller of the append').toEqual([`${STORE}:1`]);
    expect(count(bodyAfter(code(STORE), /^[ \t]*setCollectLane\s*\(/m), /\.appendGeneration\s*\(/g),
      'the store’s append is not inside setCollectLane').toBe(1);
    expect(SERVER.filter((f) => /\bappendGeneration\b/.test(stallCode(f))).map(rel).sort(),
      'a second file defines or names the append').toEqual([LANE, ADAPTER, STORE]);
    const lane = code(LANE);
    const port = bodyAfter(lane, /^export interface CollectLaneJournal\b/m);
    expect(count(port, /\bappendGeneration\b/g), 'the L1 port no longer declares the append').toBe(1);
    expect(count(lane, /\bappendGeneration\b/g), 'collectLane.ts names the append outside the port it declares').toBe(1);
    expect(count(code(STORE), /\bappendGeneration\b/g), 'the store names the append other than by its one call').toBe(1);
    expect(count(code(ADAPTER), /\bappendGeneration\b/g), 'the adapter does not define the append').toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_BASENAME has one definer, and the quoted basename stands on no other TS or TSX code line', () => {
    const BASENAME = 'collect-lane-generation.log';
    expect(stallCodeText(`  // ~/.ccrc/${BASENAME}\n   * ${BASENAME}`).includes(BASENAME), 'CONTROL: a comment line is not a spelling')
      .toBe(false);
    expect(stallCodeText(`const p = '${BASENAME}';`).includes(BASENAME), 'CONTROL: a code line is').toBe(true);
    expect(definers(DEF_VAL('COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_BASENAME')), 'a second definer').toEqual([ADAPTER]);
    expect(ALL.filter((f) => stallCode(f).includes(BASENAME)).map(rel).sort(), 'the basename spelled outside its definer')
      .toEqual([ADAPTER]);
    expect(code(ADAPTER).split(BASENAME).length - 1, 'the definer spells it more than once').toBe(1);
    expect(code(ADAPTER)).toMatch(/^export const COLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_BASENAME = 'collect-lane-generation\.log';$/m);
  });

  it('collectLaneEffective is defined in collectLane.ts and called only in collectTempRoot and collectLaneView', () => {
    expect(definers(DEF_FN('collectLaneEffective')), 'a second definition').toEqual([LANE]);
    expect(definers(DEF_VAL('collectLaneEffective')), 'a definition as a value').toEqual([]);
    const calls = CALL('collectLaneEffective');
    expect(sitesOf(calls).map((s) => s.slice(0, s.lastIndexOf(':'))), 'a caller outside the executor and the view')
      .toEqual([LANE, EXECUTOR]);
    const lane = code(LANE);
    const view = bodyAfter(lane, /^export function collectLaneView\(/m);
    expect(count(view, calls), 'collectLaneView does not resolve the switch').toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(count(lane, calls), 'collectLane.ts calls the resolver outside collectLaneView').toBe(count(view, calls));
    const exec = code(EXECUTOR);
    const job = bodyAfter(exec, /^export async function collectTempRoot\(/m);
    expect(count(job, calls), 'the executor does not resolve the switch').toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(count(exec, calls), 'collectTempRoot.ts calls the resolver outside the executor').toBe(count(job, calls));
  });

  it('collectRetireLatch is called only by the executor and the pass', () => {
    expect(definers(DEF_FN('collectRetireLatch')), 'a second definition').toEqual([EXECUTOR]);

    expect(sitesOf(calls), 'a third caller, or a second call').toEqual([`${EXECUTOR}:1`, `${WATCH}:1`]);
    expect(count(bodyAfter(code(EXECUTOR), /^export async function collectTempRoot\(/m), calls),
      'the executor file’s call is not in collectTempRoot').toBe(1);
    expect(count(bodyAfter(code(WATCH), /^[ \t]*private async collectPass\(/m), calls),

  });

  it('the marker’s holders are still exactly the definer and the executor', () => {
    const WRITE = /\b(?:writeFile|appendFile|rename|symlink|copyFile|mkdir|truncate|unlink|rm)(?:Sync)?\s*\(|\.write\w*\s*\(/;
    expect(ALL.filter((f) => stallCode(f).includes('collect-lane-live')).map(rel).sort(), 'the marker spelled outside its definer')
      .toEqual([LANE]);
    expect(ALL.filter((f) => stallCode(f).includes('COLLECT_LANE_LIVE_MARKER')).map(rel).sort(), 'a third holder of its constant')

    expect(code(EXECUTOR), 'the executor appends to the journal itself').not.toMatch(/\.appendGeneration\s*\(/);
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Create `server/test/collect-lane-writers.test.ts`**

```ts
// Child reclamation wave 10 (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.9: "Exactly one database writer and one journal append
// adapter exist; only POST and automatic latch call the writer"). The SQL half of that sentence, read as TEXT: every
// statement in server/src that writes `collect_lane_settings` is either the migration's one seed INSERT in schema.ts or
// the one UPDATE inside `CoordStore.setCollectLane`. single-definition.test.ts's wave-10 block holds the TypeScript
// half: the writer's callers, the one append adapter and the one resolver. Comments are dropped (`codeOnly`) and
// strings kept, because the SQL lives in strings. A statement is attributed to the writer by brace-matching the
// method's body over the text with comments and strings blanked (positions kept), so a brace in a quote or a comment
// cannot move the body's end; the body is then sliced from the raw text, so its SQL strings survive.
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync, readdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { codeOnly } from './sourceScan.js';

const srcRoot = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..', 'src');

/** Every .ts/.tsx under `dir`. `__`-prefixed entries are skipped: `boot.test.ts` writes a transient verbatim copy of
 *  index.ts as `server/src/__boot_control_mutant__.ts`, which would read as a second builder of the journal adapter
 *  (single-definition.test.ts's `sources` states the same guard). */
const sourcesUnder = (dir: string): string[] =>
  readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((e) => {
    if (e.name.startsWith('__')) return [];
    const full = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) return sourcesUnder(full);
    return /\.tsx?$/.test(e.name) ? [full] : [];
  });

/** Blank out comments and string/template bodies, preserving byte positions and newlines:
 *  `stall-settings-route.test.ts`'s helper (itself `coord-caps-route.test.ts`'s), copied unchanged. */
function blankCommentsAndStrings(text: string): string {
  const out = text.split('');
  const blank = (a: number, b: number): void => {
    for (let k = a; k < b; k++) if (out[k] !== '\n') out[k] = ' ';
  };
  let i = 0;
  while (i < text.length) {
    const c = text[i];
    const d = text[i + 1];
    if (c === '/' && d === '/') {
      const j = text.indexOf('\n', i);
      const e = j < 0 ? text.length : j;
      blank(i, e); i = e;
    } else if (c === '/' && d === '*') {
      const j = text.indexOf('*/', i + 2);
      const e = j < 0 ? text.length : j + 2;
      blank(i, e); i = e;
    } else if (c === "'" || c === '"' || c === '`') {
      let j = i + 1;
      while (j < text.length) {
        if (text[j] === '\\') j += 2;
        else if (text[j] === c) break;
        else j++;
      }
      blank(i + 1, Math.min(j, text.length));
      i = Math.min(j + 1, text.length);
    } else i++;
  }
  return out.join('');
}

/** A statement that writes the table, DDL that alters or drops it included. Case-insensitive, because SQLite reads
 *  `update` as `UPDATE`. `CREATE TABLE` and `SELECT … FROM` are not writes. */
const WRITES_TABLE =
  /\b(?:INSERT(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?\s+INTO|REPLACE\s+INTO|UPDATE(?:\s+OR\s+\w+)?|DELETE\s+FROM|ALTER\s+TABLE|DROP\s+TABLE(?:\s+IF\s+EXISTS)?)\s+collect_lane_settings\b/gi;
/** Each write in the code of `text` (comments dropped), normalised to one upper-case spacing. */
const writes = (text: string): string[] =>
  [...codeOnly(text).matchAll(WRITES_TABLE)].map((m) => m[0].replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toUpperCase());

/** The `{…}` body of the first code match of `head`, brace-matched over the blanked text and sliced from the RAW
 *  text. '' when `head` matches no code. */
const bodyOf = (raw: string, head: RegExp): string => {
  const blank = blankCommentsAndStrings(raw);
  const at = blank.search(head);
  if (at < 0) return '';
  const open = blank.indexOf('{', at);
  if (open < 0) return '';
  let depth = 0;
  for (let i = open; i < blank.length; i++) {
    if (blank[i] === '{') depth += 1;
    else if (blank[i] === '}') {
      depth -= 1;
      if (depth === 0) return raw.slice(open, i + 1);
    }
  }
  return raw.slice(open);
};

describe('the switch’s SQL has one writer (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.9)', () => {
  const files = (): string[] => sourcesUnder(srcRoot);
  const read = (r: string): string => readFileSync(path.join(srcRoot, r), 'utf8');
  const WRITER_HEAD = /^[ \t]*setCollectLane\s*\(/m;

  it('CONTROL rows prove each scanner sees its definition', () => {
    expect(writes("this.db.prepare('UPDATE collect_lane_settings SET choice = ? WHERE id = 1').run(c);"))
      .toEqual(['UPDATE COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS']);
    expect(writes("db.exec('INSERT OR REPLACE INTO collect_lane_settings (id) VALUES (1)');"))
      .toEqual(['INSERT OR REPLACE INTO COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS']);
    expect(writes("db.exec('delete from collect_lane_settings');")).toEqual(['DELETE FROM COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS']);
    expect(writes('ALTER TABLE collect_lane_settings ADD COLUMN x INTEGER;')).toEqual(['ALTER TABLE COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS']);
    expect(writes("this.db.prepare('SELECT choice FROM collect_lane_settings WHERE id = 1').get();")).toEqual([]);
    expect(writes('CREATE TABLE collect_lane_settings (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1));')).toEqual([]);
    expect(writes('// UPDATE collect_lane_settings, in prose\n/* INSERT INTO collect_lane_settings */\n'),
      'a comment is not a write').toEqual([]);
    const planted = [
      'class S {',
      '  setCollectLane(req: R, at: number, journal: J): W {',
      "    const s = '}';",
      '    // } a brace in a comment',
      "    return tx(this.db, () => { this.db.prepare('UPDATE collect_lane_settings SET choice = ? WHERE id = 1').run(s); });",
      '  }',
      "  other(): void { this.db.prepare('UPDATE collect_lane_settings SET choice = ? WHERE id = 1').run('off'); }",
      '}',
    ].join('\n');
    expect(writes(planted), 'the planted file holds two writes').toEqual(['UPDATE COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS', 'UPDATE COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS']);
    expect(writes(bodyOf(planted, WRITER_HEAD)), 'the body ends at its own brace, past a quoted one and a commented one')
      .toEqual(['UPDATE COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS']);
    expect(bodyOf(planted, /^[ \t]*absentMethod\s*\(/m), 'an absent head reads as no body').toBe('');
    expect(files().length, 'the walk reached server/src').toBeGreaterThan(30);
    const body = bodyOf(read(path.join('coord', 'store.ts')), WRITER_HEAD);
    expect(body, 'setCollectLane is not a method of coord/store.ts — this scan is over nothing').not.toBe('');
    expect(body, 'the body found is not the writer: it never appends').toMatch(/\.appendGeneration\s*\(/);
    expect(codeOnly(read(path.join('coord', 'schema.ts'))), 'the table is not created in schema.ts')
      .toMatch(/\bCREATE TABLE collect_lane_settings\b/);
  });

  it('INSERT or UPDATE of collect_lane_settings stands only in schema.ts’s seed and inside setCollectLane', () => {
    const sites = files().flatMap((f) => {
      const w = writes(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'));
      return w.length === 0 ? [] : [`${path.relative(srcRoot, f)}: ${w.join(' | ')}`];
    }).sort();
    expect(sites, 'a second writer of the switch’s row').toEqual([
      `${path.join('coord', 'schema.ts')}: INSERT INTO COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS`,
      `${path.join('coord', 'store.ts')}: UPDATE COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS`,
    ]);
    expect(writes(bodyOf(read(path.join('coord', 'store.ts')), WRITER_HEAD)),
      'the store’s one write of the row is not inside setCollectLane').toEqual(['UPDATE COLLECT_LANE_SETTINGS']);
    expect(codeOnly(read(path.join('coord', 'schema.ts'))), 'the INSERT is not the singleton seed')
      .toMatch(/INSERT INTO collect_lane_settings\s*\([^)]*\)\s*VALUES\s*\(\s*1\s*,/);
  });

  it('the journal adapter is built once, in index.ts', () => {
    const CALL = /(?<!function\s+)\bcollectLaneJournalAt\s*\(/g;
    const planted = 'export function collectLaneJournalAt(logPath: string) {}\nconst j = collectLaneJournalAt(p);\n// collectLaneJournalAt(p)\n';
    expect([...blankCommentsAndStrings(planted).matchAll(CALL)].length, 'CONTROL: a call, not the declaration or a comment')
      .toBe(1);
    const sites = files().flatMap((f) => {
      const n = [...blankCommentsAndStrings(readFileSync(f, 'utf8')).matchAll(CALL)].length;
      return n === 0 ? [] : [`${path.relative(srcRoot, f)}:${n}`];
    }).sort();
    expect(sites, 'a second journal adapter instance').toEqual(['index.ts:1']);
    expect(blankCommentsAndStrings(read(path.join('coord', 'collectLaneJournal.ts'))))
      .toMatch(/^export function collectLaneJournalAt\(/m);
  });

  it('the journal path is composed once, in index.ts, and only the adapter and db.ts hold its basename', () => {
    // One append adapter is one writer only while no other file can reach the file by name. A second composition of
    // the path, or a file joining the basename to a directory, could truncate or rebuild the journal without ever
    // calling appendGeneration (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.2: the journal is never reconstructed from the row).
    // db.ts holds the basename for its restore wording only (Task 13).
    const PATH_CALL = /(?<!function\s+)\bdefaultCollectLaneJournalPath\s*\(/g;
    const planted = 'export function defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(d: string) {}\nconst p = defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(d);\n// defaultCollectLaneJournalPath(d)\n';
    expect([...blankCommentsAndStrings(planted).matchAll(PATH_CALL)].length, 'CONTROL: a call, not the declaration or a comment')
      .toBe(1);
    const sites = files().flatMap((f) => {
      const n = [...blankCommentsAndStrings(readFileSync(f, 'utf8')).matchAll(PATH_CALL)].length;
      return n === 0 ? [] : [`${path.relative(srcRoot, f)}:${n}`];
    }).sort();
    expect(sites, 'a second composition of the journal path').toEqual(['index.ts:1']);
    const ALLOWED = [path.join('coord', 'collectLaneJournal.ts'), path.join('coord', 'db.ts')];
    const holders = files()
      .filter((f) => /\bCOLLECT_LANE_JOURNAL_BASENAME\b/.test(blankCommentsAndStrings(readFileSync(f, 'utf8'))))
      .map((f) => path.relative(srcRoot, f));
    expect(holders, 'the definer no longer holds the basename: this scan is over nothing')
      .toContain(path.join('coord', 'collectLaneJournal.ts'));
    expect(holders.filter((h) => !ALLOWED.includes(h)), 'a file that could join the basename to a directory').toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

### Task 11: The PWA's data: the client, the shared not-available helper, the read hook and its readers, and the words

**Model routing:** **`sonnet`, effort `high`**. This task adds no destructive path. It adds the PWA's read of the switch and the words the Task 12 section renders. Two of its rules are about safety: a reader refuses a view it cannot read whole instead of folding it, and an answer from the server that the switch is not available, or cannot be measured, removes a view that already landed.

**Why:**
- **R12 and R26: the PWA counts nothing.** `CollectLaneView.attention` carries the server's counts, and `null` means not measured yet. No file here reads an attention item, an attention word or the coord frame's attention list.
- **R13: the PWA.**
  - The not-available line is exactly "Not available on this server."
  - "Pause all cleanup" names every lane it stops: child reclamation, archived-workspace expiry, the dead-coordinator lane and this collector.
  - The 404/501 decision is shared with the stall section through one helper, with no change to stall behaviour.
  - No announcement goes in the apply sheet or the rollout report. This task touches neither.
- **R32: the PWA's details.**
  - Off is disabled whenever `marker.latch` is not `set`, and its note follows the listing. A latch that did not read (`unmeasured`: the row or the journal is unmeasurable, so the lane is safety-stopped and the legacy file arms nothing) gets the unmeasured line whatever the listing shows, never the spec's "still controls" sentence (`collect-off-note-unmeasured-latch-claims-no-control`).
  - "Confirm Live again" is offered for a stored Live for another node, or for a control mismatch.
  - The shared helper lives at `pwa/src/lib/notAvailable.ts`.
- **R38: the GET's answers.**
  - The GET answers 503 `state-unmeasurable` only for an absent row, so the hook reads that 503 as its own failure kind, with the server's detail.
  - `CollectLaneView.stored` has no `absent` arm, so a view that carries one is refused.
  - Malformed and unreadable are never folded.
- **R25 and R34.** The 409 confirm body's `facts` are the sheet's projection: node id and `measuredAt`, both capabilities, the pause, the marker, the repair and the counts. They carry no nonce and no epoch. `notice` is `null` on the GET and is a string on a 200 POST.
- **Spec §5.7.** The six Now lines, the recreated-file sentence and the pre-latch Off sentence are copied exactly. The PWA never spells the marker's name, and no string names a device.
- **Task 12 edits no words file.** Every sentence the section, its sheet, its write flow and its pause control render lands here: the legend, the radio labels, the read lines, the unanswered-write line, the unknown-refusal template and the pause control's passing labels included. Task 12 imports these by Task 11's exported names and never adds a word or keeps a words table of its own (`collect-words-carry-the-sections-copy`).

```ts
  ['404 not-found', new ApiError(404, { ok: false, error: 'not-found' }), 'not-configured'],
  ['501 with another code', new ApiError(501, { ok: false, error: 'unsupported' }), 'failed'],
  ['501 carrying the 404 code', new ApiError(501, { ok: false, error: 'not-found' }), 'failed'],
  ['404 carrying the 501 code', new ApiError(404, { ok: false, error: 'not-configured' }), 'failed'],
```

```tsx
// useCollectLaneView — the Temp root collector section's own read of GET /api/coord/collect-lane (path-identity spec
// 2026-10-12 §5.6, §5.7), its two client methods, and the readers the section shares with it:
//
//  • asCollectLaneView: a view the section cannot render WHOLE is a failure, never a state. Nothing is dropped and
//    nothing is defaulted: a section built from part of a safety view would understate a stop.
//  • asCollectLaneConfirm: the 409 body, confirm-required or confirm-stale, accepted only whole.
//  • collectLanePostRefusal: a write's rejection read as a confirm, a refusal whose detail is never blank, or an
//    unconfirmed write (a network failure, which may have landed).
//
// The hook drops a landed view when the server answers that the switch is not available (404/501, the shared helper)
// or cannot be measured (503 state-unmeasurable). A read that did not land keeps the last good view.
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { act, cleanup, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react';
import { COLLECT_LANE_REFUSALS, type CollectLaneConfirmRequired, type CollectLaneView } from '../../shared/api';
import { ApiError, api, createApi } from '../src/lib/api';
import { settingsReadFailure } from '../src/lib/notAvailable';
import {
  COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS, asCollectLaneConfirm, asCollectLaneView, collectLanePostRefusal, useCollectLaneView,
} from '../src/fleet/useCollectLaneView';

const setVisibility = (v: DocumentVisibilityState): void => {
  Object.defineProperty(document, 'visibilityState', { value: v, configurable: true });
};

afterEach(() => {
  cleanup();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  vi.useRealTimers();
  Reflect.deleteProperty(document, 'visibilityState');
});

const jsonResponse = (status: number, body: unknown): Response =>
  new Response(JSON.stringify(body), { status, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' } });

const view = (over: Partial<CollectLaneView> = {}): CollectLaneView => ({
  stored: { read: 'row', choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: 'node-a', markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 1, updatedAt: 1_000 },
  journal: { read: 'ok', max: 1 },
  control: { state: 'coherent', bootstrap: false },
  effective: { state: 'live', armedBy: 'both' },
  marker: { listing: 'stands', latch: 'unset' },
  node: { state: 'known', nodeId: 'node-a', measuredAt: 5_000, stored: 'this' },
  caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true },
  attention: { wouldCollect: 2, held: 1, boxLines: 0 },
  remedy: null,
  notice: null,
  ...over,
});

const confirmBody = (over: Record<string, unknown> = {}): CollectLaneConfirmRequired => ({
  ok: false,
  error: 'confirm-required',
  confirmKey: '0a1b2c3d',
  facts: {
    node: { nodeId: 'node-a', measuredAt: 5_000 },
    caps: { collect: true, reclaimPause: true },
    paused: false,
    marker: 'stands',
    repair: null,
    attention: { wouldCollect: 2, held: 1, boxLines: 0 },
  },
  ...over,
} as CollectLaneConfirmRequired);

const withFacts = (over: Record<string, unknown>): CollectLaneConfirmRequired =>
  confirmBody({ facts: { ...confirmBody().facts, ...over } });

/** One poll interval, flushed. */
const tick = async (): Promise<void> => {
  await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS); });
};

describe('api.collectLane and api.setCollectLane (path-identity spec §5.6)', () => {
  it("GET's URL with no init", async () => {
    const answer = view();
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(jsonResponse(200, answer));
    const client = createApi(fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch);
    expect(await client.collectLane()).toEqual(answer);
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const [url, init] = fetchImpl.mock.calls[0] as [string, RequestInit | undefined];
    expect(url).toBe('/api/coord/collect-lane');
    expect(init).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("POST's method, headers and exact body, with no mail-token header", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(jsonResponse(200, view()));
    const client = createApi(fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch);
    await client.setCollectLane({ choice: 'live', confirm: '0a1b2c3d' });
    await client.setCollectLane({ choice: 'off' });
    expect(fetchImpl).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    const first = fetchImpl.mock.calls[0] as [string, RequestInit];
    const second = fetchImpl.mock.calls[1] as [string, RequestInit];
    for (const [url, init] of [first, second]) {
      expect(url).toBe('/api/coord/collect-lane');
      expect(init.method).toBe('POST');
      const headers = new Headers(init.headers);
      expect(headers.get('content-type')).toBe('application/json');
      expect(headers.get('accept')).toBe('application/json');
      expect(headers.get('x-ccrc-mail-token')).toBeNull();
    }
    expect(JSON.parse(first[1].body as string)).toEqual({ choice: 'live', confirm: '0a1b2c3d' });
    expect(JSON.parse(second[1].body as string)).toEqual({ choice: 'off' });
  });

  it("a truncated 2xx is 'unreadable': the write may have landed", async () => {
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({
      ok: true, status: 200, json: () => Promise.reject(new Error('truncated')), text: () => Promise.resolve(''),
    });
    const client = createApi(fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch);
    await expect(client.setCollectLane({ choice: 'off' })).resolves.toBe('unreadable');
  });

  it('a 409 rejects with its body, which collectLanePostRefusal reads as a confirm', async () => {
    const body = confirmBody();
    const fetchImpl = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(jsonResponse(409, body));
    const client = createApi(fetchImpl as unknown as typeof fetch);
    const err = await client.setCollectLane({ choice: 'live' }).catch((e: unknown) => e);
    expect(err).toBeInstanceOf(ApiError);
    expect((err as ApiError).status).toBe(409);
    expect((err as ApiError).body).toEqual(body);
    expect(collectLanePostRefusal(err)).toEqual({ kind: 'confirm', confirm: body });
  });
});

      ['attention missing a count', { ...v, attention: { wouldCollect: 1, held: 0 } }],
      ['known with no nodeId', { ...v, node: { state: 'known', measuredAt: 5_000, stored: 'this' } }],
      ['known with an empty nodeId', { ...v, node: { state: 'known', nodeId: '', measuredAt: 5_000, stored: 'this' } }],
      ['known with no measuredAt', { ...v, node: { state: 'known', nodeId: 'node-a', stored: 'this' } }],
      ["known with the unknown arm's stored word", { ...v, node: { state: 'known', nodeId: 'node-a', measuredAt: 5_000, stored: 'set' } }],
      ["unmeasured with the known arm's stored word", { ...v, node: { state: 'unmeasured', stored: 'other' } }],
      ['an unknown node state', { ...v, node: { state: 'unknown', stored: 'none' } }],
      ['a non-string remedy', { ...v, remedy: 5 }],
      ['a missing remedy', { ...v, remedy: undefined }],
      ['a non-string notice', { ...v, notice: false }],
      ['a stored absent, which the route answers 503 for', { ...v, stored: { read: 'absent' } }],
      ['a stored row with a non-string choice', { ...v, stored: { ...v.stored, choice: 1 } }],
      ['a stored row with an empty node', { ...v, stored: { ...v.stored, fleetNodeId: '' } }],
      ['a stored row with a zero latch', { ...v, stored: { ...v.stored, markerRetiredAt: 0 } }],
      ['a stored row with a negative generation', { ...v, stored: { ...v.stored, generation: -1 } }],
      ['a stored row with no updatedAt', { ...v, stored: { ...v.stored, updatedAt: undefined } }],
      ['an unknown journal read', { ...v, journal: { read: 'gone' } }],
      ['an ok journal with no max', { ...v, journal: { read: 'ok' } }],
      ['a coherent control with no bootstrap flag', { ...v, control: { state: 'coherent' } }],
      ['a mismatch with no side', { ...v, control: { state: 'mismatch' } }],
      ['an unknown marker listing', { ...v, marker: { listing: 'gone', latch: 'unset' } }],
      ['a boolean latch', { ...v, marker: { listing: 'stands', latch: true } }],
      ['caps null', { ...v, caps: null }],
      ['a non-boolean capability', { ...v, caps: { collect: 'yes', reclaimPause: true } }],
    ];
    for (const [name, raw] of cases) expect(asCollectLaneView(raw), name).toBeNull();
  });

  it("a raw stored 'shadowed' passes: any stored token reads, and arms nothing", () => {
    for (const choice of ['shadowed', 'LIVE', 'toString', '']) {
      const v = view({
        stored: { read: 'row', choice, fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 1, updatedAt: 1 },
        effective: { state: 'shadowed', armedBy: 'neither' },
      });
      expect(asCollectLaneView(v), choice).toBe(v);
    }
  });

  it('confirm-required and confirm-stale with whole facts are confirm; partial facts are refused', () => {
    const accepted = [
      confirmBody(),
      confirmBody({ error: 'confirm-stale', confirmKey: 'ffffffff' }),
      withFacts({ repair: 'journal-ahead', attention: null, paused: true, marker: 'absent' }),
      withFacts({ repair: 'journal-behind', caps: { collect: false, reclaimPause: false } }),
    ];
    for (const body of accepted) {
      expect(asCollectLaneConfirm(body), JSON.stringify(body)).toBe(body);
      expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new ApiError(409, body))).toEqual({ kind: 'confirm', confirm: body });
    }
    const refused: Array<[string, unknown]> = [
      ['not an object', 'confirm-required'],
      ['another code', confirmBody({ error: 'conflict' })],
      ['ok true', confirmBody({ ok: true })],
      ['no key', confirmBody({ confirmKey: undefined })],
      ['an uppercase key', confirmBody({ confirmKey: '0A1B2C3D' })],
      ['a 7-character key', confirmBody({ confirmKey: '0a1b2c3' })],
      ['a 9-character key', confirmBody({ confirmKey: '0a1b2c3d4' })],
      ['a numeric key', confirmBody({ confirmKey: 12345678 })],
      ['no facts', confirmBody({ facts: undefined })],
      ['a node with no id', withFacts({ node: { measuredAt: 5_000 } })],
      ['a node with an empty id', withFacts({ node: { nodeId: '', measuredAt: 5_000 } })],
      ['a node measured at a string', withFacts({ node: { nodeId: 'node-a', measuredAt: '5000' } })],
      ['caps missing reclaimPause', withFacts({ caps: { collect: true } })],
      ['no pause fact', withFacts({ paused: undefined })],
      ['an unmeasured marker', withFacts({ marker: 'unmeasured' })],
      ['an unknown repair', withFacts({ repair: 'ahead' })],
      ['a negative count', withFacts({ attention: { wouldCollect: -1, held: 0, boxLines: 0 } })],
    ];
    for (const [name, raw] of refused) {
      expect(asCollectLaneConfirm(raw), name).toBeNull();
      expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new ApiError(409, raw)).kind, name).toBe('refused');
    }
  });

  it('a TypeError is unconfirmed', () => {
    expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'))).toEqual({ kind: 'unconfirmed' });
    expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new Error('aborted'))).toEqual({ kind: 'unconfirmed' });
  });

  it("a refusal carries L0's code when the server sent one, and a detail that is never blank", () => {
    for (const code of COLLECT_LANE_REFUSALS) {
      const got = collectLanePostRefusal(new ApiError(400, { ok: false, error: code, detail: `because ${code}` }));
      expect(got, code).toEqual({ kind: 'refused', code, detail: `because ${code}` });
    }
    expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new ApiError(409, { ok: false, error: 'marker-still-controls' })))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'refused', code: 'marker-still-controls', detail: 'marker-still-controls' });
    expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new ApiError(400, { ok: false, error: 'toString', detail: 'x' })))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'refused', code: null, detail: 'x' });
    expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new ApiError(503, { error: '' })))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'refused', code: null, detail: 'HTTP 503' });
    expect(collectLanePostRefusal(new ApiError(502, 'Bad Gateway')))
      .toEqual({ kind: 'refused', code: null, detail: 'request failed (502)' });
  });
});

describe("useCollectLaneView — the section's own read (path-identity spec §5.6, §5.7)", () => {
  it('polls at mount and then every COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS (60 s)', async () => {
    expect(COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS).toBe(60_000);
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const spy = vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane').mockResolvedValue(view());
    renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView());
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS - 1); });
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1); });
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('404 or 501 is not-configured, replacing a landed view', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    for (const err of [new ApiError(404, { ok: false, error: 'not-found' }), new ApiError(501, { ok: false, error: 'not-configured' })]) {
      const landed = view();
      vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane').mockResolvedValueOnce(landed).mockRejectedValueOnce(err);
      const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView());
      await act(async () => {});
      expect(result.current.view).toBe(landed);
      expect(result.current.failure).toBeNull();
      await tick();
      expect(result.current.view, `${err.status}: a landed Live view never outlives a not-available answer`).toBeNull();
      expect(result.current.failure).toEqual({ kind: 'not-configured' });
      unmount();
      vi.restoreAllMocks();
    }
  });

  it("a 503 {error:'state-unmeasurable', detail} is its own failure, with its detail, replacing a landed view", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const landed = view();
    const fresh = view({ attention: null });
    vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane')
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(landed)
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new ApiError(503, { ok: false, error: 'state-unmeasurable', detail: 'the switch row is absent' }))
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new ApiError(503, { ok: false, error: 'state-unmeasurable' }))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(fresh);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView());
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(result.current.view).toBe(landed);
    await tick();
    expect(result.current.view).toBeNull();
    expect(result.current.failure).toEqual({ kind: 'state-unmeasurable', detail: 'the switch row is absent' });
    await tick();
    expect(result.current.failure, 'no detail: the code names it, never a blank')
      .toEqual({ kind: 'state-unmeasurable', detail: 'state-unmeasurable' });
    await tick();
    expect(result.current.view).toBe(fresh);
    expect(result.current.failure).toBeNull();
  });

  it('a 503 without that error, and any other failure, is failed; the shared helper is unchanged', async () => {
    const cases: unknown[] = [
      new ApiError(503, { ok: false, error: 'write-failed', detail: 'x' }),
      new ApiError(503, 'Service Unavailable'),
      new ApiError(500, { ok: false, error: 'state-unmeasurable' }),
      new ApiError(404, { message: 'Route GET:/api/coord/collect-lane not found', error: 'Not Found', statusCode: 404 }),
      new TypeError('Failed to fetch'),
    ];
    for (const err of cases) {
      vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane').mockRejectedValue(err);
      const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView());
      await act(async () => {});
      expect(result.current.view, String(err)).toBeNull();
      expect(result.current.failure, String(err)).toEqual({ kind: 'failed' });
      unmount();
      vi.restoreAllMocks();
    }
    expect(settingsReadFailure(new ApiError(503, { ok: false, error: 'state-unmeasurable', detail: 'x' }))).toBe('failed');
  });

  it('the last good view survives a failed read', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const good = view();
    const fresh = view({ attention: { wouldCollect: 0, held: 0, boxLines: 1 } });
    vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane')
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(good)
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce({ ...good, caps: null } as unknown as CollectLaneView)
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(fresh);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView());
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(result.current.view).toBe(good);
    expect(result.current.failure).toBeNull();
    await tick();
    expect(result.current.view).toBe(good);
    expect(result.current.failure).toEqual({ kind: 'failed' });
    await tick();
    expect(result.current.view, 'a view it cannot read whole is a failure, not a state').toBe(good);
    expect(result.current.failure).toEqual({ kind: 'failed' });
    await tick();
    expect(result.current.view).toBe(fresh);
    expect(result.current.failure).toBeNull();
  });

  it('settle beats an older in-flight poll', async () => {
    const stale = Promise.withResolvers<CollectLaneView>();
    const before = view();
    const written = view({
      stored: { read: 'row', choice: 'off', fleetNodeId: null, markerRetiredAt: 7, generation: 2, updatedAt: 9 },
      effective: { state: 'shadowed', armedBy: 'neither' },
    });
    vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane').mockResolvedValueOnce(before).mockReturnValueOnce(stale.promise);
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView());
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(result.current.view).toBe(before);
    act(() => { result.current.reload(); });          // a poll in flight when the write's reply arrives
    act(() => { result.current.settle(written); });
    expect(result.current.view).toBe(written);
    expect(result.current.failure).toBeNull();
    await act(async () => { stale.resolve(before); await stale.promise; });
    expect(result.current.view, 'the stale poll lands after the write and is dropped').toBe(written);
  });

  it('pollMs <= 0 is the injected mode — no request, no interval, no listener; settle still installs', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    const spy = vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane').mockResolvedValue(view());
    for (const pollMs of [0, -1]) {
      const { result, unmount } = renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView(pollMs));
      setVisibility('visible');
      act(() => { document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')); });
      await act(async () => { await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS * 3); });
      act(() => { result.current.reload(); });
      expect(spy, `pollMs ${pollMs}`).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(result.current.view).toBeNull();
      expect(result.current.failure).toBeNull();
      const written = view();
      act(() => { result.current.settle(written); });
      expect(result.current.view).toBe(written);
      unmount();
    }
  });

  it('re-polls once when the page becomes visible, and not when it is hidden', async () => {
    const spy = vi.spyOn(api, 'collectLane').mockResolvedValue(view());
    renderHook(() => useCollectLaneView());
    await act(async () => {});
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    setVisibility('hidden');
    await act(async () => { document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')); });
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    setVisibility('visible');
    await act(async () => { document.dispatchEvent(new Event('visibilitychange')); });
    expect(spy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});
```

```ts
// sentences are pinned exactly. Every warn line is pinned to exactly the condition that states it. The source scans
// hold the spec's "no string names a device" and "the PWA never spells the marker's name", and the rule that the PWA
// counts nothing: no file here reads an attention word.

  collectConfirmLines, collectCountLine, collectNowLines, collectOffNote, collectOffersReconfirm, collectStateHead,
  collectUnmeasurableLines,
} from '../src/fleet/collectLaneWords';

const view = (over: Partial<CollectLaneView> = {}): CollectLaneView => ({
  stored: { read: 'row', choice: 'live', fleetNodeId: 'node-a', markerRetiredAt: null, generation: 1, updatedAt: 1_000 },
  journal: { read: 'ok', max: 1 },
  control: { state: 'coherent', bootstrap: false },
  effective: { state: 'live', armedBy: 'both' },
  marker: { listing: 'stands', latch: 'unset' },
  node: { state: 'known', nodeId: 'node-a', measuredAt: 5_000, stored: 'this' },

  remedy: null,
  notice: null,
  ...over,
});

const facts = (over: Partial<CollectLaneConfirmRequired['facts']> = {}): CollectLaneConfirmRequired['facts'] => ({

  paused: false,
  marker: 'stands',

});

const warns = (v: CollectLaneView): string[] => collectNowLines(v).filter((l) => l.tone === 'warn').map((l) => l.text);
```

```ts
// One decision, shared by the Settings sections that read a route of their own (the stall-watch section and the temp
// root collector section, path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.7): which failed read means "not available on this
// server". Pure; it imports only the client's error class.
import { ApiError } from './api';

/** Why a Settings section's read produced no view. `not-configured` is a server with nothing to offer for that
 *  section (no coordination database, or an older build without the route), which the section renders INSTEAD of any
 *  view that landed; `failed` is every other read that did not land. */
export type SettingsReadFailure = 'not-configured' | 'failed';

/** The two answers that mean "not available on this server", each status with its own code: 501 `not-configured` (no
 *  coordination database) and 404 `not-found` (the server's `/api/*` not-found answer, from an older build that lacks
 *  the route: the stall section's departure `older-server-404-reads-not-configured`). A 404 or 501 carrying any other
 *  body is a read that failed, Fastify's own default 404 body included: folding it in would overload one value with
 *  two conditions a section renders differently. A route's other refusals (the collector's 503
 *  `state-unmeasurable`) are `failed` here; a section that has one reads it itself. */
const NOT_CONFIGURED_ANSWERS: ReadonlyArray<readonly [number, string]> = [[501, 'not-configured'], [404, 'not-found']];

const isObject = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);

/** The status AND its code, both: a status alone is not an answer this helper may read. */
export function settingsReadFailure(err: unknown): SettingsReadFailure {
  if (!(err instanceof ApiError)) return 'failed';
  const body = err.body;
  if (!isObject(body)) return 'failed';
  const code = body.error;
  return NOT_CONFIGURED_ANSWERS.some(([status, want]) => err.status === status && code === want)
    ? 'not-configured'
    : 'failed';
}
```

(d) Create `pwa/src/fleet/useCollectLaneView.ts`:

```ts
// The Temp root collector section's own read of `GET /api/coord/collect-lane` (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.6,
// §5.7), and the three pure readers its writes need: the wire guard for the view, the guard for a 409 confirm body,
// and the reading of a write's rejection.
//
// The hook has `useStallWatchView`'s shape:
// - the newest issued request is authoritative;
// - the page becoming visible re-polls;
// - `pollMs <= 0` is the injected mode;
// - `settle(view)` installs a write's reply and moves the request generation on, so a poll issued before the write
//   that lands after it cannot put the old choice back.
// It differs in one rule, on purpose. Some answers from the SERVER drop the view that landed before:
// - this switch is not available here: 404 `not-found` or 501 `not-configured`, decided by the shared
//   `settingsReadFailure`;
// - its state cannot be measured: a 503 `state-unmeasurable` from the GET, where there is no row to read.
// So a Live radio from before a rollback, or from before a lost row, never stays on screen. A read that did not land,
// or an answer this guard cannot read whole, keeps the last good view beside its failure.
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  isCollectLaneRefusal,
  type CollectArmedBy, type CollectLaneConfirmRequired, type CollectLaneRefusal, type CollectLaneView,
} from '../../../shared/api';
import { ApiError, api, apiErrorText } from '../lib/api';
import { settingsReadFailure, type SettingsReadFailure } from '../lib/notAvailable';

/** The read's cadence, the stall section's: 60 s. */
export const COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS = 60_000;

/** Why the latest poll produced no view: the shared helper's two words, plus the one answer this route alone gives
 *  (a 503 `state-unmeasurable` from the GET: the switch's row is absent, spec §5.6), with the server's bounded detail. */
export type CollectLaneReadFailure =
  | { kind: SettingsReadFailure }
  | { kind: 'state-unmeasurable'; detail: string };

export interface CollectLanePoll {
  /** The LAST GOOD answer. A failed read keeps it; a not-available or unmeasurable answer drops it. */
  view: CollectLaneView | null;
  /** The latest poll's failure; null after a good answer or a settle. */
  failure: CollectLaneReadFailure | null;
  /** One poll now, fire-and-forget, under the same newest-issued guard. A no-op in the injected mode. */
  reload: () => void;
  /** Install a write's reply (already through `asCollectLaneView`) and drop every poll issued before it. */
  settle: (view: CollectLaneView) => void;
}

type View = CollectLaneView;
type KnownNode = Extract<View['node'], { state: 'known' }>;
type OtherNode = Exclude<View['node'], { state: 'known' }>;
type Facts = CollectLaneConfirmRequired['facts'];

const isObject = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> =>
  typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v);
const isNum = (v: unknown): v is number => typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v);
const isCount = (v: unknown): v is number => Number.isSafeInteger(v) && (v as number) >= 0;
const isNonEmpty = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0;
const isTextOrNull = (v: unknown): boolean => v === null || typeof v === 'string';
/** Membership by `includes`, never `in` or a map lookup: `'toString' in` any object literal is true. */
const isOneOf = <T extends string>(list: readonly T[], v: unknown): v is T =>
  typeof v === 'string' && (list as readonly string[]).includes(v);
/** A union's members, spelled as a total Record, so a member added to L0 and not here is a compile error. */
const keysOf = <K extends string>(table: Record<K, true>): readonly K[] => Object.keys(table) as K[];

const STORED_FAULTS = keysOf<Exclude<View['stored'], { read: 'row' }>['read']>({ malformed: true, unreadable: true });
const JOURNAL_FAULTS = keysOf<Exclude<View['journal'], { read: 'ok' }>['read']>(
  { missing: true, malformed: true, unreadable: true, 'not-regular': true });
const MISMATCH_SIDES = keysOf<Extract<View['control'], { state: 'mismatch' }>['journal']>({ ahead: true, behind: true });
const EFFECTIVE_STATES = keysOf<View['effective']['state']>({
  live: true, shadowed: true, paused: true, 'safety-stopped': true, 'not-running': true, 'unknown-fleet': true,
});
const ARMED_BY = keysOf<CollectArmedBy>({ settings: true, 'legacy-marker': true, both: true, neither: true });
const MARKER_LISTINGS = keysOf<View['marker']['listing']>({ stands: true, absent: true, unmeasured: true });
const MARKER_LATCHES = keysOf<View['marker']['latch']>({ set: true, unset: true, unmeasured: true });
const KNOWN_STORED = keysOf<KnownNode['stored']>({ none: true, this: true, other: true, unread: true });
const OTHER_NODE_STATES = keysOf<OtherNode['state']>({ unmeasured: true, collision: true });
const OTHER_STORED = keysOf<OtherNode['stored']>({ none: true, set: true, unread: true });
const CONFIRM_ERRORS = keysOf<CollectLaneConfirmRequired['error']>({ 'confirm-required': true, 'confirm-stale': true });
const CONFIRM_MARKERS = keysOf<Facts['marker']>({ stands: true, absent: true });
const REPAIRS = keysOf<NonNullable<Facts['repair']>>({ 'journal-ahead': true, 'journal-behind': true });
/** The key a re-POST sends back: 8 lowercase hex (spec §5.6). */
const CONFIRM_KEY = /^[0-9a-f]{8}$/;
/** The one GET refusal this hook reads as its own kind, typed by L0's refusal union so a rename there is a compile
 *  error here. */
const UNMEASURABLE: CollectLaneRefusal = 'state-unmeasurable';

const isCounts = (v: unknown): boolean =>
  isObject(v) && isCount(v.wouldCollect) && isCount(v.held) && isCount(v.boxLines);
const isCaps = (v: unknown): boolean =>
  isObject(v) && typeof v.collect === 'boolean' && typeof v.reclaimPause === 'boolean';

/** The stored row as read. `choice` is the RAW token and any string reads (spec §5.2: a future token is readable and
 *  arms nothing). There is no `absent` arm: the route answers 503 for an absent row, so a view carrying one is refused. */
const isStored = (v: unknown): boolean => {
  if (!isObject(v)) return false;
  if (v.read !== 'row') return isOneOf(STORED_FAULTS, v.read);
  const { choice, fleetNodeId, markerRetiredAt, generation, updatedAt } = v;
  return typeof choice === 'string'
    && (fleetNodeId === null || isNonEmpty(fleetNodeId))
    && (markerRetiredAt === null || (isCount(markerRetiredAt) && markerRetiredAt > 0))
    && isCount(generation) && isCount(updatedAt);
};
const isJournal = (v: unknown): boolean =>
  isObject(v) && (v.read === 'ok' ? isCount(v.max) : isOneOf(JOURNAL_FAULTS, v.read));
const isControl = (v: unknown): boolean =>
  isObject(v) && (
    v.state === 'coherent' ? typeof v.bootstrap === 'boolean'
      : v.state === 'mismatch' ? isOneOf(MISMATCH_SIDES, v.journal)
        : v.state === 'unmeasurable');
/** `armedBy` is `neither` exactly when the state is not `live` (spec §5.5). A view that says otherwise names a source
 *  for a lane it does not call live, or no source for one it does, and is refused rather than shown. */
const isEffective = (v: unknown): boolean =>
  isObject(v) && isOneOf(EFFECTIVE_STATES, v.state) && isOneOf(ARMED_BY, v.armedBy)
  && (v.state === 'live') === (v.armedBy !== 'neither');
const isMarker = (v: unknown): boolean =>
  isObject(v) && isOneOf(MARKER_LISTINGS, v.listing) && isOneOf(MARKER_LATCHES, v.latch);
const isNode = (v: unknown): boolean => {
  if (!isObject(v)) return false;
  if (v.state === 'known') return isNonEmpty(v.nodeId) && isNum(v.measuredAt) && isOneOf(KNOWN_STORED, v.stored);
  return isOneOf(OTHER_NODE_STATES, v.state) && isOneOf(OTHER_STORED, v.stored);
};

/**
 * The wire guard (spec §5.6). It returns null unless the section can render ALL of the view. Nothing is dropped and
 * nothing is defaulted, for two reasons:
 * - a section built from part of a safety view would understate a stop;
 * - an unknown word read as a known one is the fold the spec forbids ("it never folds malformed, unreadable and absent
 *   into one value").
 * A well-formed answer comes back as the same object.
 */
export function asCollectLaneView(raw: unknown): CollectLaneView | null {
  if (!isObject(raw)) return null;
  const whole = isStored(raw.stored) && isJournal(raw.journal) && isControl(raw.control)
    && isEffective(raw.effective) && isMarker(raw.marker) && isNode(raw.node) && isCaps(raw.caps)
    && (raw.attention === null || isCounts(raw.attention))
    && isTextOrNull(raw.remedy) && isTextOrNull(raw.notice);
  return whole ? (raw as unknown as CollectLaneView) : null;
}

/** The 409 body's guard (spec §5.6). It accepts `confirm-required` or `confirm-stale`, with an 8-lowercase-hex key and
 *  the sheet's facts readable WHOLE. A sheet built from part of the facts would ask the operator to confirm less than
 *  the server measured. Anything else is an ordinary refusal (`collectLanePostRefusal`). */
export function asCollectLaneConfirm(raw: unknown): CollectLaneConfirmRequired | null {
  if (!isObject(raw) || raw.ok !== false || !isOneOf(CONFIRM_ERRORS, raw.error)) return null;
  if (typeof raw.confirmKey !== 'string' || !CONFIRM_KEY.test(raw.confirmKey)) return null;
  const facts = raw.facts;
  if (!isObject(facts)) return null;
  const node = facts.node;
  const whole = isObject(node) && isNonEmpty(node.nodeId) && isNum(node.measuredAt)
    && isCaps(facts.caps) && typeof facts.paused === 'boolean' && isOneOf(CONFIRM_MARKERS, facts.marker)
    && (facts.repair === null || isOneOf(REPAIRS, facts.repair))
    && (facts.attention === null || isCounts(facts.attention));
  return whole ? (raw as unknown as CollectLaneConfirmRequired) : null;
}

/** A write's rejection, read. It is one of three:
 *  - the confirm the sheet shows;
 *  - a refusal, with L0's code when the server sent one (the section's words table keys on it) and a detail that is
 *    never blank;
 *  - an answer that never arrived. That one may have stored the write, so it is never called a refusal. */
export type CollectLanePostRefusal =
  | { kind: 'confirm'; confirm: CollectLaneConfirmRequired }
  | { kind: 'refused'; code: CollectLaneRefusal | null; detail: string }
  | { kind: 'unconfirmed' };

/** A string with something in it, trimmed; anything else is null. */
const nonBlank = (v: unknown): string | null => (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim().length > 0 ? v.trim() : null);

/** The detail, from the first source that is not blank:
 *  1. the server's own `detail`;
 *  2. Fastify's `message`;
 *  3. the error's own text;
 *  4. the HTTP status.
 *  So a line that shows it never renders an empty slot. */
const detailOf = (err: ApiError): string => {
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = isObject(err.body) ? err.body : {};
  return nonBlank(body.detail) ?? nonBlank(body.message) ?? nonBlank(apiErrorText(err)) ?? `HTTP ${err.status}`;
};

/** A confirm needs BOTH the 409 status and a body `asCollectLaneConfirm` reads whole. Every other `ApiError` is a
 *  refusal: the server answered, so nothing was written. A rejection that is not an `ApiError` is a network failure,
 *  and the POST may have left before it, so it is `unconfirmed`. */
export function collectLanePostRefusal(err: unknown): CollectLanePostRefusal {
  if (!(err instanceof ApiError)) return { kind: 'unconfirmed' };
  const confirm = err.status === 409 ? asCollectLaneConfirm(err.body) : null;
  if (confirm !== null) return { kind: 'confirm', confirm };
  const body: Record<string, unknown> = isObject(err.body) ? err.body : {};
  const code = isCollectLaneRefusal(body.error) ? body.error : null;
  return { kind: 'refused', code, detail: detailOf(err) };
}

/** A read's rejection. The shared helper decides 404/501 first. This route's 503 `state-unmeasurable` is then its own
 *  kind, carrying the server's bounded detail. Everything else is `failed`. */
const readFailureOf = (err: unknown): CollectLaneReadFailure => {
  if (settingsReadFailure(err) === 'not-configured') return { kind: 'not-configured' };
  if (err instanceof ApiError && err.status === 503) {
    const body: Record<string, unknown> = isObject(err.body) ? err.body : {};
    if (body.error === UNMEASURABLE) return { kind: 'state-unmeasurable', detail: detailOf(err) };
  }
  return { kind: 'failed' };
};

/**
 * `GET /api/coord/collect-lane` every `pollMs` and whenever the page becomes visible. The newest ISSUED request is
 * authoritative: an older in-flight answer, good or bad, never overwrites a newer request's answer, nor a settled
 * write's. `pollMs <= 0` is the injected mode: no request, no interval, no listener; `settle` still installs.
 */
export function useCollectLaneView(pollMs: number = COLLECT_LANE_POLL_MS): CollectLanePoll {
  const [state, setState] = useState<{ view: CollectLaneView | null; failure: CollectLaneReadFailure | null }>(
    { view: null, failure: null });
  const issued = useRef(0);
  const loadRef = useRef<() => void>(() => {});

  useEffect(() => {
    if (pollMs <= 0) return undefined;   // an injected consumer never polls
    let live = true;
    const load = (): void => {
      const mine = ++issued.current;
      void api.collectLane().then(
        (raw) => {
          if (!live || mine !== issued.current) return;
          const view = asCollectLaneView(raw);
          setState((prev) => (view === null ? { view: prev.view, failure: { kind: 'failed' } } : { view, failure: null }));
        },
        (err: unknown) => {
          if (!live || mine !== issued.current) return;
          const failure = readFailureOf(err);
          // The server saying the switch is not here, or cannot be measured, drops the landed view; a read that did
          // not land keeps it.
          setState((prev) => ({ view: failure.kind === 'failed' ? prev.view : null, failure }));
        },
      );
    };
    const onVisible = (): void => {
      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') load();
    };
    loadRef.current = load;
    load();
    const t = setInterval(load, pollMs);
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
    return () => {
      live = false;
      loadRef.current = () => {};
      clearInterval(t);
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisible);
    };
  }, [pollMs]);

  const reload = useCallback(() => { loadRef.current(); }, []);
  const settle = useCallback((view: CollectLaneView) => {
    issued.current += 1;   // every poll issued before this write now lands stale
    setState({ view, failure: null });
  }, []);
  return { view: state.view, failure: state.failure, reload, settle };
}
```

(e) Create `pwa/src/fleet/collectLaneWords.ts`:

```ts
// The Temp root collector section's words (path-identity spec 2026-10-12 §5.7). These are pure tables and line
// builders over the server's view, with no state of their own:
// - Each table is a `Record` over its whole union, so a state the server learns is a compile error here until it has
//   words (`collect-lane-words.test-d.ts` pins that).
// - The section shows what the server measured and decided. Nothing here counts or reads attention items: the
//   server's counts arrive on the view.
// - The spec's own sentences are copied exactly; the rest are this wave's.
// - No sentence names a device, and none names the fleet box's legacy file by its file name.
import {
  isCollectLaneChoice,
  type CollectArmedBy, type CollectLaneConfirmRequired, type CollectLaneRefusal, type CollectLaneView,
} from '../../../shared/api';
import { elapsedWords } from '../lib/elapsed';

export type CollectEffectiveState = CollectLaneView['effective']['state'];
type MarkerListing = CollectLaneView['marker']['listing'];
type StoredFault = Exclude<CollectLaneView['stored'], { read: 'row' }>['read'];
type Line = { text: string; tone: 'head' | 'note' | 'warn' };

/** The section's frame, controls and write lines. `notAvailable` is the spec's exact sentence for an older server.
 *  `unanswered` is a write that never reached an answer; `refused` is a refusal whose code this build does not know,
 *  with one `{detail}` slot for the server's detail. */
export const COLLECT_SECTION_TEXT = {
  title: 'Temp root collector',
  notAvailable: 'Not available on this server.',
  unread: "The collector's state could not be read; the section will re-check.",
  stale: 'The latest read did not arrive; this is the last answer that did.',
  legend: 'Choice',
  off: 'Off',
  live: 'Live',
  reconfirm: 'Confirm Live again',
  confirmTitle: 'Set the temp root collector to Live?',
  confirmLabel: 'Set Live',
  unanswered: 'The server did not answer, so the choice may or may not have been saved; the section re-read it.',
  refused: 'Nothing was changed: {detail}',
} as const;

/** The six Now lines, the spec's exact labels and lines (§5.7). */
export const COLLECT_STATE_TEXT: Readonly<Record<CollectEffectiveState, { readonly label: string; readonly line: string }>> = {
  live: { label: 'Live', line: 'removes an orphaned temp root only after two licensed observations.' },
  shadowed: { label: 'Shadowed', line: 'reports what it would remove and removes nothing.' },
  paused: { label: 'Stopped - cleanup paused', line: 'the broad cleanup pause stands.' },
  'safety-stopped': { label: 'Safety-stopped', line: 'collector control state cannot be proved coherent; removes nothing.' },
  'not-running': { label: 'Not running', line: 'the fleet box lacks collect-v1 or reclaim-pause-v1.' },
  'unknown-fleet': { label: 'Unknown fleet', line: 'the registry, connection epoch or current node cannot be measured.' },
};

/** The Armed by line (§5.7): Settings, the fleet box's legacy file, both during handoff, or neither. */
export const COLLECT_ARMED_BY_TEXT: Readonly<Record<CollectArmedBy, string>> = {
  settings: 'Armed by: Settings.',
  'legacy-marker': "Armed by: the fleet box's legacy file.",
  both: "Armed by: both Settings and the fleet box's legacy file, during the handoff.",
  neither: 'Armed by: neither.',
};

/** The warn lines. `recreated` is the spec's exact sentence; `mismatch` is its sentence, as a sentence. */
export const COLLECT_WARN_TEXT = {
  recreated: "The fleet box's legacy file was re-created; this server no longer honours it.",
  otherNode: 'Live was confirmed for another fleet node; it needs confirming again for this one.',
  mismatch: 'The collector is safety-stopped because its database and monotonic journal disagree.',
  unknownChoice: 'The stored choice is not one this build knows, so it arms nothing.',
} as const;

/** A stored row that did not read: two answers, never folded (§5.6). */
export const COLLECT_STORED_FAULT_TEXT: Readonly<Record<StoredFault, string>> = {
  malformed: 'The stored choice could not be read whole.',
  unreadable: 'The stored choice could not be read.',
};

/** Why Off is disabled before the latch, by what the latest listing showed. `stands` is the spec's exact sentence. */
export const COLLECT_OFF_NOTE_TEXT: Readonly<Record<MarkerListing, string>> = {
  stands: "The fleet box's legacy file still controls this lane. Remove it by hand before Settings can turn the collector off.",
  absent: "The fleet box's legacy file is gone; Settings can turn the collector off once the collector's next check records that.",
  unmeasured: "Whether the fleet box's legacy file still controls this lane cannot be measured now, so Settings cannot turn the collector off yet.",
};

/** A refused write, by the server's code. The detail the server sent is the section's to show beside it. */
export const COLLECT_REFUSAL_TEXT: Readonly<Record<CollectLaneRefusal, string>> = {
  'bad-request': 'The server could not read that choice. Nothing was changed.',
  'not-configured': COLLECT_SECTION_TEXT.notAvailable,
  'sign-in-unarmed': 'Live needs sign-in to be armed on this server. Nothing was changed.',
  'confirm-required': 'Live needs a fresh confirmation of what the server measured. Nothing was changed.',
  'confirm-stale': 'What the server measured changed before the confirmation arrived. Nothing was changed.',
  'marker-still-controls': COLLECT_OFF_NOTE_TEXT.stands,
  conflict: 'The stored choice changed while this one was on its way. Nothing was changed; the section re-reads it.',
  'state-unmeasurable': "The collector's state cannot be measured safely now. Nothing was changed.",
  'write-failed': 'The server could not prove the choice was stored; the section re-reads what stands.',
};

/** The adjacent "Pause all cleanup" action (§5.4, §5.7). It names every lane the switch stops, and offers Pause only:
 *  resuming stays on Runs, so the switch keeps one resume door. */
export const COLLECT_PAUSE_TEXT = {
  label: 'Pause all cleanup',
  stops: 'Pauses all cleanup: child reclamation, archived-workspace expiry, the dead-coordinator lane and this collector. Resume it from the cleanup row on Runs.',
  paused: 'All cleanup is paused. Resume it from the cleanup row on Runs.',
  pausing: 'pausing…',
  unconfirmed: 'unconfirmed — check /runs',
} as const;

/** The Live confirm sheet's fixed lines (§5.7). The node and freshness line is composed in `collectConfirmLines`. The
 *  checklist restates README's "Before arming it" list. */
export const COLLECT_CONFIRM_TEXT = {
  staleLead: 'What the server measured changed since the sheet opened; these are the fresh facts.',
  capsBoth: "The fleet box's ccd lists collect-v1 and reclaim-pause-v1.",
  capsNoCollect: "The fleet box's ccd does not list collect-v1: the collector will not run until it does.",
  capsNoReclaimPause: "The fleet box's ccd does not list reclaim-pause-v1: the collector will not run until it does.",
  capsNeither: "The fleet box's ccd lists neither collect-v1 nor reclaim-pause-v1: the collector will not run until it does.",
  paused: 'All cleanup is paused now: the collector removes nothing until the pause is lifted on Runs.',
  markerStands: "The fleet box's legacy file stands. Until this server records its removal it also arms the lane; once that is recorded, only this setting does, and a re-created file is ignored.",
  markerAbsent: "The fleet box's legacy file is gone, so this setting alone arms the lane.",
  repair: "This also repairs the collector's control state: its database and monotonic journal disagree.",
  checklist: [
    "Read the collector's shadow rows in the feed before arming it.",
    'Every would-collect should name an orphan whose run is closed.',
    'No box-wide line should stand in the cleanup row on Runs, except the one for temp roots the coordination database cannot vouch for.',
  ],
} as const;

export const COLLECT_COUNT_TEXT = {
  unmeasured: 'Counts are not measured yet.',
} as const;

/** One state's Now line, as the spec writes it: "Label: line". */
export function collectStateHead(state: CollectEffectiveState): string {
  const t = COLLECT_STATE_TEXT[state];
  return `${t.label}: ${t.line}`;
}

/** The Now block, top to bottom. First the state's head and the Armed by line. Then each warn line whose condition
 *  the view states:
 *  - a re-created file after the latch;
 *  - a stored Live for another node;
 *  - a stored token this build does not know, or a stored row that did not read;
 *  - a mismatch;
 *  - the server's remedy. */
export function collectNowLines(v: CollectLaneView): { text: string; tone: 'head' | 'note' | 'warn' }[] {
  const lines: Line[] = [
    { text: collectStateHead(v.effective.state), tone: 'head' },
    { text: COLLECT_ARMED_BY_TEXT[v.effective.armedBy], tone: 'note' },
  ];
  const warn = (text: string): void => { lines.push({ text, tone: 'warn' }); };
  if (v.marker.listing === 'stands' && v.marker.latch === 'set') warn(COLLECT_WARN_TEXT.recreated);
  const stored = v.stored;
  if (stored.read === 'row') {
    if (stored.choice === 'live' && v.node.state === 'known' && v.node.stored === 'other') warn(COLLECT_WARN_TEXT.otherNode);
    if (!isCollectLaneChoice(stored.choice)) warn(COLLECT_WARN_TEXT.unknownChoice);
  } else {
    warn(COLLECT_STORED_FAULT_TEXT[stored.read]);
  }
  if (v.control.state === 'mismatch') warn(COLLECT_WARN_TEXT.mismatch);
  if (v.remedy !== null) warn(v.remedy);
  return lines;
}

/** A GET that answered 503 `state-unmeasurable` (the switch's row is absent) reads as Safety-stopped, with the
 *  server's bounded detail: the section shows no choice it could write over. */
export function collectUnmeasurableLines(detail: string): { text: string; tone: 'head' | 'note' | 'warn' }[] {
  return [
    { text: collectStateHead('safety-stopped'), tone: 'head' },
    { text: `The server could not measure the collector's state: ${detail}`, tone: 'warn' },
  ];
}

/** Why Off is disabled, or null when it is enabled. Off is enabled only once the latch is SET; before that the note
 *  follows the latest listing: the spec's sentence while the file stands, a pending line once it is gone, and an
 *  unmeasured line otherwise (path-identity spec §5.4). */
export function collectOffNote(v: CollectLaneView): string | null {
  if (v.marker.latch === 'set') return null;
  // A latch that did not read is no proof that the legacy file controls anything: the row is unmeasurable and the lane
  // is safety-stopped, so the note says control cannot be measured, whatever the listing shows.
  if (v.marker.latch === 'unmeasured') return COLLECT_OFF_NOTE_TEXT.unmeasured;
  return COLLECT_OFF_NOTE_TEXT[v.marker.listing];
}

/** "Confirm Live again" is offered for a stored Live confirmed for another, measured node, and for a control mismatch
 *  (which a fresh confirmed Live repairs, §5.6). Never otherwise: an unmeasured node is the server's to measure. */
export function collectOffersReconfirm(v: CollectLaneView): boolean {
  if (v.control.state === 'mismatch') return true;
  return v.stored.read === 'row' && v.stored.choice === 'live' && v.node.state === 'known' && v.node.stored === 'other';
}

/** The would-collect, held and box-wide counts, as the server counted them, or the not-measured line. */
export function collectCountLine(a: CollectLaneView['attention']): string {
  if (a === null) return COLLECT_COUNT_TEXT.unmeasured;
  return `${a.wouldCollect} would be collected, ${a.held} held, ${a.boxLines} box-wide ${a.boxLines === 1 ? 'line' : 'lines'} on Runs.`;
}

/** The confirm sheet's lines, from the 409's facts, in this order:
 *  1. the stale lead (only when stale);
 *  2. the node and how fresh its measurement is;
 *  3. the capabilities;
 *  4. the pause (only when it stands);
 *  5. the counts;
 *  6. the before-arming checklist;
 *  7. the legacy file;
 *  8. the repair (only when there is one).
 *  `now` is the viewer's clock, for `elapsedWords`. */
export function collectConfirmLines(facts: CollectLaneConfirmRequired['facts'], stale: boolean, now: number): string[] {
  const t = COLLECT_CONFIRM_TEXT;
  const caps = facts.caps.collect
    ? (facts.caps.reclaimPause ? t.capsBoth : t.capsNoReclaimPause)
    : (facts.caps.reclaimPause ? t.capsNoCollect : t.capsNeither);
  return [
    ...(stale ? [t.staleLead] : []),
    `Fleet node ${facts.node.nodeId}, measured on this server's current connection ${elapsedWords(now - facts.node.measuredAt)} ago.`,
    caps,
    ...(facts.paused ? [t.paused] : []),
    collectCountLine(facts.attention),
    ...t.checklist,
    facts.marker === 'stands' ? t.markerStands : t.markerAbsent,
    ...(facts.repair !== null ? [t.repair] : []),
  ];
}
```

### Task 12: The PWA section: the Settings mount, the confirm sheet, the pre-latch Off policy and "Pause all cleanup"

**Model routing:** **`opus`, effort `high`**. The confirm sheet and the pre-latch Off policy are safety copy. This section is the only place an operator arms the collector's unattended deletion, so every word it shows comes from the server's view.

**Why:**
- **Spec §5.7.** The section is a separate "Temp root collector" section in `pwa/src/fleet/CollectLaneSection.tsx`, mounted after stall watch. It shows:
  - one of six Now lines and an Armed by line;
  - the re-created-file line, the other-node line and the mismatch line;
  - Off disabled before the latch, with the spec's text;
  - "Pause all cleanup";
  - a Live confirm sheet that names the node, the freshness, both capabilities and the before-arming facts;
  - the counts, decided by the server;
  - for an older server's 404, "Not available on this server.";
  - no string that names a kind of screen or pointer.
- **R13.**
  - The older-server line is exact.
  - Off is disabled before the latch.
  - "Pause all cleanup" names all four lanes and offers Pause only. Resume stays on /runs.
  - The 404/501 decision is shared through Task 11's helper.
  - No announcement goes in the update apply sheet or the rollout report. `UpdateMoveSheet.tsx` and `ccd/ccrc` are untouched.
- **R32.**
  - Off is disabled whenever `marker.latch` is not `set`, and its note follows the listing, or is the unmeasured line when the latch did not read (`collectOffNote`).
  - "Confirm Live again" is offered for another node's Live or a mismatch (`collectOffersReconfirm`).
- **R34.** The 200's `notice` is shown. It is `null` on every GET, so the next poll clears it.
- **R38.** A GET 503 `state-unmeasurable` (an absent row) is drawn as Safety-stopped with the server's detail, never as a generic failure, and it offers no radio.
- **The server decides the confirm** (the stall section's rule):
  - Live goes out as exactly `{choice:'live'}`.
  - A 409 `confirm-required` or `confirm-stale` opens the sheet from the server's facts.
  - Set re-posts `{choice:'live', confirm: confirmKey}`.
  - `QuickConfirm` closes on confirm, so a `confirm-stale` answer re-opens the sheet through `pending`. That is the stall section's way.
- **Nothing here counts or names the legacy file.** Words come from Task 11's `collectLaneWords.ts`. The marker's name appears on no line, because the wave 9 single-definition marker pin scans `pwa/src` code lines.
